bluejetty:00157834:ios.summary: You've done this before. You started strong, you missed a Tuesday, and the app made sure you knew it. The number went back to zero, and you stopped opening it a few days later. That's not a discipline problem. That's an app that only knew h
bluejetty:00157834:ios.description:
You've done this before. You started strong, you missed a Tuesday, and the app made sure you knew it. The number went back to zero, and you stopped opening it a few days later. That's not a discipline problem. That's an app that only knew how to keep score.
HabitScript keeps the whole picture instead. The water you drank. The ten minutes on the mat. The twenty pages before bed, the phone left in the kitchen. Miss a Tuesday and Tuesday is just a day — everything else you did is still there, still yours, still visible.
AS MANY HABITS AS YOUR LIFE HAS
Other apps let you have three, maybe five, then ask for money. HabitScript doesn't count your habits. Add the one you're serious about and the small one you're embarrassed about. Add the one you'll drop in a week. Free means free.
NOTHING TO PROTECT, NOTHING TO LOSE
There's no fragile number you owe the app. Nothing scolds you, nothing resets to zero, and nobody's disappointed in you on Thursday morning. Come back after a bad week and you'll find the good weeks still sitting there.
IT'S YOURS, AND IT STAYS YOURS
No account. No sign-up, no email, no password to forget. Your habits live encrypted on your phone.
HOW IT ACTUALLY WORKS
• Some things you just do — tap once and it's done
• Some you count — a glass of water at a time, until you've had eight
• Some you sit down for — ten minutes of stretching, timed in the app
• Pick the days that are real for you: every day, weekdays, or three times a week
• Want a plan instead of a blank page? Answer a few questions and HabitScript builds you a routine — mornings, fitness, focus, reading, less phone
Give it a few weeks and something quiet happens: the months behind you fill in with color, and you can see, without counting, that you've been doing this.
PERFECT FOR
• Anyone who has deleted three habit apps already
• People who want the proof without the pressure
• Anyone starting over — again — and hoping it holds this time
SUBSCRIPTION & PURCHASE OPTIONS
Auto-renewal: subscriptions automatically renew unless disabled 24 hours before the period ends. Manage subscription in Account Settings.
Trial Information: The trial converts to a subscription unless canceled 24 hours before the trial ends.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula
Privacy Policy: https://primepeak.io/products/habitscript/privacy
GET STARTED
Add one habit. Do it today. Then do it tomorrow, or don't — it'll still be here either way.

bluejetty:00114895:android.summary:
WORLD TV – All Channels & Videos 🌍🎬

Whether you want to watch live news, entertainment, sports, or play your own video files, WORLD TV
bluejetty:00114895:android.description:
WORLD TV – All Channels & Videos 🌍🎬
One simple app to explore all publicly available TV channels and enjoy your personal media in one place!
Whether you want to watch live news, entertainment, sports, or play your own video files, WORLD TV gives you everything in a clean and modern interface.
🌟 Main Features
• All world channels — Watch live TV from publicly available IPTV-Org playlists.
• Play your own videos — Supports MP4, HLS, and DASH formats.
• Add favourites — Bookmark channels with custom title, image, and User-Agent if needed.
• Picture-in-Picture (PiP) — Multitask while watching.
• Smooth playback — Fast loading, stable streaming, and no interruptions.
• Chromecast support — Cast to your TV and enjoy on the big screen.
• Notification controls — Play, pause, and stop directly from your status bar.
• Lightweight and battery-friendly — Optimized for speed and efficiency.
• Personal library — Play your local videos or network streams.
📘 How to Use
1️⃣ Open the app and browse categories containing channels from the public IPTV-Org project.
2️⃣ Tap a channel to watch instantly, or press ➕ Add to insert your own stream URL.
3️⃣ Manage favorites, toggle full screen, or cast to TV for a better experience.
⚠️ Important Disclaimer
• WORLD TV does not host, store, or own any media content.
• All channel links come from the public open-source project iptv-org/iptv

bluejetty:00017349:ios.description:
This app is a virtual remote that allows you to control your Smart TV from your iPhone.
works with Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Panasonic,TCL Roku,Roku sticks,Hitachi, Telefunken, Grundig, Continental Edison TV and more...
To use this remote control, your iPhone must be on the same Wi-fi network as your TV.
Detection of your TV will be automatic and depending on the model of your TV, you will have to accept the message that will appear on your TV screen.
The app works through WIFI, so you do not have to be close to the TV to make it works.
With a realistic design, you can use all the functions of the original remote control very easily.
This app supports the most famous TV brands like Samsung Smart TV, LG Smart Tv and LG Web OS, Sony Bravia, Philips, Panasonic viera, Telefunken, Grundig, Hitachi and Continental Edison.
We have integrated the most useful commands, the features are listed below:
-Change the volume
-Change the channel number
-Use navigation pad
-Video control (Play/Pause/Stop...)
-Menu, Options, Info, Tools
-Power off
If you have any suggestions, feel free to contact us.
Disclaimer:
This application is not an official app of Samsung,LG,Sony,Philips,Panasonic,Telefunken,Grundig,Continental Edison nor are we affiliated with these company.
SUBSCRIPTION:
We offer auto-renewing subscription:
- Length: Yearly-Monthly-Weekly
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- You will be able to access the Premium features of the app for the duration of the subscription
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
- The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your Apple account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039 for more information on how to proceed.
- You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your Apple Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
- Any unused portion of a free-trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy : https://www.universal-tvremote.com/privacy.html
Terms of Use : https://www.universal-tvremote.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00130835:ios.description:
Find the on-screen reading settings that suit you.
For dyslexic and ADHD readers, children and adults alike — and for anyone who tires quickly on screen.
This app is a settings lab: experiment with fonts (including OpenDyslexic), text size, letter and line spacing, and colors on a sample text — and see the result instantly.
IMPORTANT — This app is not a screening or diagnostic tool. Dyslexia is diagnosed by a qualified professional (speech-language pathologist). This app only helps you explore display preferences.
WHY SPACING MATTERS
In a controlled study published in PNAS (Zorzi et al., 2012), increasing the space between letters immediately improved reading accuracy in children with dyslexia — with no training. Effects vary from reader to reader, which is exactly why testing your own settings matters.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Try different fonts and compare them on the same text
- Adjust text size, letter spacing and line spacing
- Test text and background colors for your visual comfort
- Send feedback and suggest new settings
Once you know what works for you, apply your preferences in our other apps (Scandys, Navidys, School tool) or in your device's accessibility settings.

bluejetty:00183395:ios.description:
Welcome to the best-selling guide to the hit TV show Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives. 1000+ Diners locations. No other app has every location like we do. UPDATED weekly with each new episode and from user updates. 
Track where you've been and where you still need to go. In-app Purchase for $0.99 yearly.
******
Added from Season 27: Episode 13; Barbecue, Batter and Beer Can Chicken
Restaurants Added:
Three's Bar and Grill, Kihei, HI
Horse Thief BBQ, Los Angeles, CA
BatterFish, Los Angeles, CA
*****
This app has all the locations visited by Guy Fieri on the show, geo-located around you wherever you are. Great for travelers looking for a good meal around the country.
The Unofficial Guide to Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives has been one of the top 10 apps in the Food & Drink category almost every day for the last 6 months and was #1 for two weeks running. 80,000 users can't be wrong.
We've collected all the locations for you, geo-located them, and organized them by season and state. Every venue from the show is in the app, including the closed locations or those that have changed hands and names. 
Some of the restaurants have closed over the years. We've left them in the directory, but added the word *Closed* to the name of each so you don't waste your time trying to go there. 
Major features: 
► 980 Locations (as of 8/5/2017) and updated every week after the new episode airs, which is more than every other app – including the Food Network's own Food on the Road app (because we own them all and we check each week). Also, we regularly update closed or new addresses as we're informed by users.
► All locations are sortable by distance, alphabet, season, and state:
► Links to 456 recipes (so far) featured on the show (which you can also use as Guy's eating list)
► A Near Me map that lets you see as many or as few locations as you want 
► Recipes are sortable by season or by type of dish (main, side, breakfast, etc). 
► Post your visits to your Facebook or Twitter account.
► Leave comments about why you love each location for others to see.
► Update button if you find a mistake or a closed location
► Facebook, Twitter and Yelp links for every location that has them
-------------------
Subscription - Track where you've been and where you haven't for $0.99/year reoccurring.
- Checkin subscription is $0.99 annually, letting the user track which locations they've been to, and which ones they haven't.
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew annually unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
Terms of Service - http://bit.ly/gla-terms
This app is not affiliated with the Food Network or Guy Fieri, but created using publicly available information about the locations highlighted in the Diners, Drive-ins and Dives TV show. 
GoLocalApps designs travel and wine region apps and this one was a labor of love as we enjoy the show and wanted to find the diners as we traveled around the country. So we did this for ourselves and are sharing it with you. 
If you have any problems with the app, or have suggestions use the support link or email us at support@golocalapps.com. We'll be happy to help you troubleshoot any issues. 
Content by Ross Rojek

bluejetty:00037824:ios.summary: Looking for a cycling app to make route planning and navigating easier? Our cycle route planner offers personalised routes based on your bike type and cycling preferences. Discover safe and enjoyable cycle routes intuitively plotted on our
bluejetty:00037824:ios.description:
Looking for a cycling app to make route planning and navigating easier? Our cycle route planner offers personalised routes based on your bike type and cycling preferences. Discover safe and enjoyable cycle routes intuitively plotted on our detailed cycling maps. Enjoy turn-by-turn voice navigation designed specifically for cyclists and record your rides to keep a log of all your favourite days on the bike!
YOUR PERSONALISED BIKE ROUTE PLANNER
 ▪ Our intuitively mapped routes cater specifically to your wants or needs from a ride, making us the go-to bike route planner for personalised cycle routes.
 ▪ Instantly discover quiet and safe routes whether you ride a road bike, e-bike, mountain bike, city bike or hybrid.
 ▪ Specify your preferences and find routes that avoid hills, traffic, main roads or poor road surfaces.
 ▪ Our bike ride planner helps you find inspiration for A to B cycle routes to your required destination or circular routes to explore the area.
MULTIPLE ROUTE OPTIONS
 ▪ With no limiting libraries, our cycle planner offers unlimited journey options and intuitively maps new routes for you instantly with each search. 
 ▪ Find 3-5 new inspired route options per search to choose from for maximum enjoyment on your bike with minimal effort to plan.
 ▪ Simply swipe through the suggested routes to easily compare journeys on our high-quality cycle map.
 ▪ Review detailed information on traffic stress, safety, elevation, and surface of your selected route.
 ▪ Choose your preferred cycle route from the fastest to the safest, or compromise between the two.
 ▪ Map a circular route to ride without having to provide any waypoints or having prior knowledge of the area - we’re the only cycle journey planner that intuitively plans this type of a route for you from scratch.
FIND YOUR MATCH
 ▪ Discover the route that best fits your requirements with Match - a clear rating showing the percentage to which each route meets your preferences.
 ▪ Pick from the closest matched, fastest, or on a balanced alternative route. 
 ▪ The Match score can be easily viewed and compared to help you choose your preferred route for that day.

Overdrive – Ninja Shadow Revenge is a action platformer in the shadow theme with a futuristic story-line.
More than 4 million players around the world have been enjoying the sci-fi design, let’s join them!
In the future, a strong, outstanding species is created from the combination of humans, technology and black metal. The government names them “shadow cyborg” and allows every sector to have their own shadow security force (S.E.F), all of which have to be controlled by the Headquarter based in Century city.
Everything seems so perfect, ‘til the day Headquarter is under attacked by a Dark Clan.. Hacked, the Lord Commander of S.E.F slays his soldier and replace them by new shadow cyborg generation to take over the government. CORE, a senior cyborg soldier discovers the plot too late. After the attack, CORE joins the rebel and heads to the city seeking revenge for his comrades and destroying the Dark Clan. 
Starting from the Dark Forest, you will face dangerous enemies and traps. In the fight, use your skill to avoid attack and make extraordinary combos.
AMAZING FEATURES of the game:
- Tutorial for newbie makes sure every player can learn how to play 
- Playable OFFLINE, so no more worries of no Internet
- Smooth game control experience
- Heroes to be upgraded, customised & equip with epic weapons & armor suits and more!
- Ultra-stunning sci-fi graphic & effects 
- Giant boss with unique attack.
- Various weapons ( Sword, Buster Sword, Spear,...) with their perfect combos make the unforgettable experience. Upgrade them to unlock new stronger combos!
Are you gonna be the world saviour? Enjoy now!
Have any question or feedback to make the game better? Please let us know.

bluejetty:00187215:ios.description:
App offers a convenient way of controlling finances and additional services.
We are ČSOB and we bring you the ČSOB SmartBanking application, which is the gateway to the smart world. You will find the solutions that we ourselves, as clients, expect from a bank – understandable, safe and comfortable.
Our app offers a number of functions for comfortable and secure financial management – from payments, to the possibility of setting up an investment in it in a few clicks or applying for a loan. But you will also find what you would not expect from a bank in the ČSOB SmartBanking app. For example, you can set up insurance through it, buy a ticket for public transport or parking, or save all important information about your car.
Yes, we know that this goes beyond the boundaries of banking as we know it. But we want your every day to be smart.
Have you become our client or just changed your smartphone and want to activate our ČSOB SmartBanking app? It's easy and you can activate it in a few minutes:
1. Prepare your IPPID and PIN. These are the same as those you use to log in to MojaČSOB internet banking.
2. After entering them into the application, confirm activation via the ČSOB SmartToken app, which you also need.
3. When using the application in the future, only your PIN or biometrics will be sufficient. You can change your PIN at any time in the app or via MojaČSOB internetbanking.
4. You can customize the application and its parameters as you need in the Settings section.
Are you interested in our application and are not yet a ČSOB client? Download it and try out its functions in the public section, which is also available without logging in.
If you have any questions, this SmartBanking - ČSOB subpage can help you with the answers, and our colleagues are also available at +421259668844 or info@csob.sk.
©2011 ČSOB Slovensko

bluejetty:00019369:ios.description:
Welcome to the epic world of crazy 3d wrestlers and fighters!
Do you like fighting and boxing? Then you can't ignore this tag team action packed ring fight.
This super game is designed for crazy players like you. It leads the road of the world's best Championship League. Real Wrestling Revolution is free and easy to play. It is the best combat sports game ever with multiple wrestlers, game modes, and customization.
GAME MODULES
This game is designed for wrestle mania fighting and wrestling lovers. This game has several modes to play which boost your interest level for the further levels. In this game, the superstar wrestler’s challenges will drive you to take risky shots in the ring. Upgrade your wrestler power and strength and smackdown your rivals with your full power.
EASY
Game starts with quick play. Easy module is a quick play in which you don't need any professional expertise. Wrestlers which are easy to pick up and fun to play. Just target your rivals and do not give them any chance to make you lose.
MEDIUM
Complete the 10 levels of easy module and select the medium mode to clarify your moves. Upgrade your wrestler to enjoy the professional experience of fighting with no limit of time.
HARD 
Then after practicing, Be ready to enter the devastating world of wrestling realm fight. Previous level drills you to modify your different techniques and tactics which helps you to defeat your opponent in very unique ways.
HELL
This module makes you feel like a real life wrestling fight. Use your expert techniques and aim at your rivals' weakest point and hit them hard to win. It's Hard but you can do it. Do not let them take you down. Defend yourself and flick him atrociously.
AUTHENTIC ACTION WITH REALISTIC MOVES
 Use your expert fighting moves to Knockout your enemies. Strike hard to defeat them. The game offers multiple fighting styles like punch boxing, karate, kicks, martial arts, and much more. Pick a style you think best suits your player. Win each round and get rewards.
BELT CHAMPIONSHIP
After beating all universal champions of this PRO fighting game. If playing wrestling revolution in the ring isn't enough, engage yourself in more action by continuing the matches in different challenges. Compete with the world's most powerful and dangerous wrestlers according to your choice and show them who is a PRO by winning a gold belt.
BOOST-UP PLAYERS STAMINA
Upgrade your player's power, strength and stamina and make them more powerful and perilous. And be ready to smackdown your rival in a royal rumble fight with your full energy and power.
IDEAL REWARDS PLUS STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS
 The game has 3D animations along with awesome background music that will keep you energized during the fight. HD graphics will give you a more authentic feel of real-life wrestling.
SMOOTH UI CONTROL WITH INTERESTING BACKGROUND
 Amazingly designed 3D high-definition graphics and animation, intuitive touch controls, and different modes of game-play create a unique fighting experience.
REAL WRESTLING FIGHTING GAME FEATURES
-Multiple male wrestlers to choose for fight
-Different fighting styles, pick any style you like to fight in
-Super & Ultimate wrestling knockout mode, to bring rivals down
-Authentic actions and realistic wrestling moves will give you real-life action feels
-Career Mode to fight with world wrestlers, pick an opponent of your choice
-3D animations, realistic quality sound, and easy to use UI controls
- Awesome graphics with wonderful background music will boost your energy
-Intuitive touch controls and HD graphics to keep you engaged
SUPPORT
If you want to play some more fun based games, then feel free to visit our account “Hamza Khalid” on App-Store. Challenge your friends to download and prove to them who is the best wrestler
Here the privacy policy link:https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FdXzuVGi480OVnRiMgVql2R9DZB1GqGAWNtOyVQdnag/edit

Latest Sports News
From the news section, you can easily access Fanatik's homepage and all
bluejetty:00039591:ios.description:
Renewed Fanatik allows you to follow the latest sports news, live match results, real-time score predictions, and personalized news with Süpertüyo.
Latest Sports News
From the news section, you can easily access Fanatik's homepage and all sports news related to your favorite teams. You can read the latest comments from columnists for free. Stay updated with countless news and breaking developments in football, basketball, volleyball, and all other sports categories. Follow match results and news from leagues such as the Turkish Süper Lig, Champions League, English Premier League, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A, Ligue 1, Basketball Süper Lig, EuroLeague, NBA, and many more—all in the palm of your hand.
Live Match Results
From the matches section, you can track live, past, and upcoming match scores for all leagues and teams on a single screen.
Personalized News and Sports Updates
As a Fanatik member, you can personalize your app experience by adding your favorite teams, leagues, or sports to your favorites. You can follow your favorite content and matches from the "MY PAGE" section. It's easy to receive personalized notifications about the sports columnist, football team, league, or sports category you follow. On league and team pages, you can access news, standings, fixtures, and statistics for your selected league or team.
The newest feature in the Fanatik app is Fanatik Süpertüyo. So, what is Fanatik Süpertüyo?
With Fanatik Süpertüyo, you can access recommended betting odds for upcoming matches based on statistics and analysis of teams' past performances.
Live Match Predictions and Analysis
In the Analysis and Predictions section, you can view betting recommendations for the week's standout matches, selected by our betting experts. With Fanatik Süpertüyo, you can follow football and basketball match predictions, review news, and make accurate analyses.
Live Match Scores in Your Pocket
In Live Analysis, you can easily access and follow real-time predictions and analysis, along with their betting odds, during the hottest moments of the match. Preparing the day's bulletin with match results and live scores is now easier and more enjoyable.
Match Simulations!
With the simulation feature, before the match starts, you can set your own criteria, prepare a personalized analysis, and simulate the match outcome. Through match simulation, you can access predictions and recommendations such as the first-half result, match result, card information, and goal predictions, along with their betting odds. This way, you can make more consistent predictions in betting games.
Fanatik Super App: Access Multiple Tools with a Single Click
With the Super App interface in the Fanatik app, you can access many useful features with just one click. Features of Fanatik Super App include:
• Prayer Times, Qibla Compass, and Quran
• On-Duty Pharmacies
• Puzzles
We continue to improve our app based on your feedback to provide you with the best experience. To share any issues or suggestions, you can email us at uyelik@fanatik.com.tr. Make sure you have the latest version of the app installed and notifications enabled to enjoy the best experience on Fanatik and Fanatik Süpertüyo.

bluejetty:00094956:ios.description:
Turn Your Phone into a Smart Car Dashboard
Car Connect transforms your iPhone or iPad into a complete driving assistant — no need for built-in car systems. With real-time navigation, music control, calls, and live updates all in one place, it's the perfect dashboard experience for any car, directly on your device.
Drive smarter with an all-in-one solution that works fully on your phone or tablet. Just mount your device and go.

- Smart dashboard interface designed for iPhone and iPad
- Turn-by-turn navigation with voice guidance
- Use either Google Maps or Apple Maps
- Live traffic data and satellite view
- Real-time estimated arrival time

- Play local music through the Apple Music app
- Quick access to your contacts and calling features
- Real-time weather updates while driving

- Compatible with both iPhone and iPad
- Clean, distraction-free layout for safe driving

✓ Dark theme mode is perfect for you to play Word Brick-Word Search Puzzle before bed.
✓ Autosave if you leave the puzzle incomplete.
✓ Multiple language support in our puzzle game.
Train your brain anytime and anywhere in with Word Brick-Word Search Puzzle. If you like Word Brick-Word Search Puzzle and playing word games, come and try it out. bluejetty:00145268:ios.description:
Track your long and intermittent fasts with clarity and science.
Whether you follow a 16:8 routine or a 5-day water fast, this app helps you stay on track, motivated, and in control. Designed for beginners and experienced fasters alike, it adapts to your goals and helps you fast smarter.
Intermittent Fasting Made Simple
- Choose from popular presets like 16:8, OMAD, or create your own
- Track fasting and eating windows with real-time timers
- Get reminders when to start or stop fasting
Long-Term Fasting Support
- Start fasts of 2, 3, 5 or more days
- View time spent in ketosis and autophagy (estimated)
- Stay focused with a clean and distraction-free experience
Follow Your Progress
- Timeline of all fasts with duration and timestamps
- Clear statistics to measure consistency and improvement
Stay on Track
- Optional notifications for each fasting and eating phase
- Works offline and syncs automatically when connected
Take control of your health and build sustainable habits, one fast at a time.

bluejetty:00112193:android.summary:

The Mobile App, nor the W
bluejetty:00112193:android.description:
efoBus 2.0 is a most comprehensive information system that provides real-time public transport information in your area, and enables future trip planning to be made.
Currently , the only supported area is Israel.
The Mobile App, nor the Wear OS app, do not provide any information for any other region in the world.
efoBus 2.0 is suitable for people who use public transport on a regular basis, and also for those who use it occasionally.
In addition to the version for Android based mobile devices, there is a special version for Wear OS based Watches.
The version for Ear OS based watches, enables the users to see real time info for buses selected by the phone app and also it enables the users to see the real time location of the buses on the map displayed on the watch's screen.
At the click of a button you will receive:
- Full schedule of every route alternative
- Route maps with stops
- Real time view of all public transport vehicles positions on a map
- Real time estimate of actual arrival times based on vehicle position
efoBus 2.0 provides all relevant and available public transport information for selected areas. Among other things, it provides:
- Buses, subways, rails and trains in your area
- Real time estimates of arrival times
- Show vehicles locations on map
- Trip planning
- Schedules
- List all nearby stops and routes
- Map view of all nearby stops
- Show all routes maps
- and more...
In order to provide you with all public transport information, efoBus 2.0 makes use of publicly available information provided by selected public transport providers. This information includes:
- Static info about Routes and stops, as well as schedules for the routes.
- Real time vehicles locations

bluejetty:00128782:ios.description:
Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra es una app de noticias locales en español, clima y alertas para la comunidad hispana de Boston, Massachusetts y Nueva Inglaterra. Mantente informado con noticias de última hora, pronósticos, radar en vivo, alertas meteorológicas, cobertura electoral y transmisiones en vivo.
Recibe cobertura local confiable en una sola app. Sigue noticias de Boston, Worcester, Cambridge y Springfield, además de inmigración, política, elecciones, tráfico, seguridad pública, nieve, tormentas y clima severo.
Personaliza tus alertas de noticias, clima y elecciones según tu zona.
¿Por qué usar la app de Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra?
Si vives en Boston, Massachusetts o Nueva Inglaterra, Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra te ayuda a estar informado de noticias locales, clima, inmigración, elecciones, nieve y radar en vivo.
¿Qué puedes hacer con la app de Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra?
Sigue noticias locales
* Recibe alertas locales, nacionales e internacionales
* Sigue inmigración, política, seguridad pública y tráfico
* Lee artículos y mira videos de Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra
Sigue las elecciones
* Obtén cobertura de elecciones locales y estatales
* Sigue elecciones de Massachusetts y Nueva Inglaterra
* Infórmate sobre primarias, elecciones de medio término y presidenciales
* Consulta candidatos, medidas electorales, información para votantes y resultados
Consulta el tiempo para Boston
* Mira condiciones actuales y alertas meteorológicas
* Accede al pronóstico de 10 días
* Consulta pronósticos por hora
Usa los widgets del tiempo
* Agrega widgets a tu pantalla de inicio
* Ve condiciones actuales según tu zona
* Toca el widget para ver el pronóstico completo
Sigue el tiempo con radar en vivo
* Accede a radar en tiempo real
* Sigue cambios del tiempo en Boston y Nueva Inglaterra
* Guarda zonas y configura alertas meteorológicas
* Consulta alertas de nieve, tormentas, calor e inundaciones
Mira Telemundo Nueva Inglaterra en vivo
* Ve noticieros y cobertura en vivo
* Accede a videos locales y entretenimiento
* Mira streams de eventos importantes
Mantente informado durante eventos importantes
* Sigue nieve, tormentas, inundaciones, calor y emergencias
* Recibe actualizaciones de tráfico y seguridad pública
* Mira conferencias de prensa y cobertura en vivo
Consulta Telemundo Responde
* Accede a investigaciones y reportajes locales

bluejetty:00126628:ios.description:
This app made it easy to measure distance on the map. Useful for route planning, finding shortest distance, traveling, and much more. 
Distance is accurately calculated base on the earth curvature.
Tracking mode allows user to measure distance handed-free. The app will auto follow current device's location to keep measuring distance.

- Coordinates list editor
- Export coordinates list to GPX file

"DistanceCalculator - Map tool" is completely free to use with all features. You can subscribe to this application to remove ads.
Device subscriptions are available in these plan and will renew automatically each month, six months or year, unless cancelled.

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase or by clicking the “Purchase / Manage Subscription. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Subscription cannot be cancelled during the active subscription period

bluejetty:00085817:ios.description:
MyJDownloader Remote allows you to remotely control your JDownloader, anywhere, anytime.
Out on the go and you need to download something on your work or home PC, ready for when you get back? No problem.
MyJD Remote allows you to:
• View the status of any connected JDownloader
• Start, Pause or Stop any connected JDownloader
• Check progress of downloads
• Reset, stop or change the priority of your downloads
Upgrade to unlock the ultimate JDownloader companion:
• Receive push notifications for almost anything, including download finished, JDownloader updates and new captchas
• Solve captchas and answer JDownloader dialogs from anywhere
• View, manage and add links to your JDownloader from anywhere
• Change lots of JDownloaders settings remotely including speed limits and max downloads per host
• Use a widget to see the progress of your downloads without having to open the app
• Keep your JDownloader up to date by remotely triggering updates
• When you're on the same network as your JDownloader you will connect to it directly for a much faster and more fluid experience
• View and manage accounts you've linked to JDownloader
• Open DLCs from other apps and send to any online JDownloader
• Use the share sheet in other apps to send links to your JDownloader
• Change the way MyJD looks by changing the colour scheme

bluejetty:00077205:ios.name: ExplorOz Traveller
bluejetty:00077205:ios.summary:
ExplorOz Traveller is an all-in-one Australia-wide mapping app to explore tracks and trails, plan and track your trips, and find camps and places along the way.
Built on EOTopo, a high-detail topographic map of Australia, Traveller clearly
bluejetty:00077205:ios.description:
ExplorOz Traveller is an all-in-one Australia-wide mapping app to explore tracks and trails, plan and track your trips, and find camps and places along the way.
Built on EOTopo, a high-detail topographic map of Australia, Traveller clearly shows tracks, trails and terrain so you can understand where you are and where you’re going — purpose-built for exploring beyond mobile coverage, and equally effective in towns and cities.
Download the full Australia-wide map to your device and use it anytime — online or offline — without relying on map streaming or ongoing data use.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy the App (one-time purchase) Install ExplorOz Traveller on your iPhone or iPad.
2. Choose Your Map Access (in-app) Traveller is designed for use with EOTopo offline maps.
Choose ONE option to unlock offline maps:
ExplorOz Pro Access (Best Value)
* Annual subscription (auto-renewing)
* Includes latest EOTopo maps (always up to date)
* Includes advanced features:
 * Live tracking & sharing
 * Traveller Web-App (plan on your computer)
 * GPX export and extended data features
EOTopo Annual Access
* Annual subscription (auto-renewing)
* Includes latest EOTopo maps
* No advanced features
EOTopo 4-Year Access
* One-time purchase (not a subscription)
* Single map edition (no updates)
* Works offline for up to 4 years
FIND CAMPS, SERVICES AND PLACES
* 100,000+ places across Australia
* Campsites, caravan parks and overnight stops
* Fuel, water, toilets, dump points and essential services
* Trailheads, lookouts, recreation areas, historic sites and ruins
Community-powered content:
* Read reviews, tips and updates from other travellers
* View photos to help choose camps and stops
* Contribute your own reviews, photos and updates
All places are built into the same detailed map, so you can see exactly where they are in relation to tracks, terrain and access — even when offline.
BUILT FOR OFFLINE TRAVEL
Download EOTopo maps to your device and use Traveller without mobile signal:
* Australia-wide offline mapping
* Route guidance and trip planning
* GPS tracking and trip recording
* 100,000+ camps and places
MAP DETAIL THAT MATTERS
* Named roads, tracks, hiking trails and MTB trails across Australia
* Clear visual distinction between sealed roads, unsealed roads and 4WD-only tracks
* Dedicated styling for hiking trails, MTB trails and shared paths
* Colour-coded MTB trails with graded difficulty (green, blue, black)
* Track access information including permits, restrictions, gates and closures
In towns and built-up areas:
* Detailed street mapping including service roads, carparks and infrastructure
* Buildings, facilities and key points of interest
In regional and remote areas:
* Extensive coverage of tracks and routes across Australia, including many remote and lesser-known tracks
* Terrain detail including contours, valleys, escarpments and sand dunes
* Remote infrastructure such as airstrips, bores, water sources and communications sites
BATTERY & LOCATION USE
Uses GPS for positioning and tracking. Continued use of GPS may reduce battery life.
IMPORTANT
* App purchase is a one-time cost (platform specific) with support for Family Sharing.
* EOTopo maps are required for offline use and purchased in-app
* Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled in your App Store account settings

bluejetty:00037243:ios.description:
Play Backgammon Online instantly — challenge real players, unlock new boards, collect daily rewards, and enjoy classic backgammon in a modern mobile format.
Backgammon Online brings the timeless board game to your iPhone and iPad with quick online matches, smooth gameplay, beautiful boards, and simple controls. Play when you have a few minutes, compete with players worldwide, or practice offline against AI.
Key features:
• Online multiplayer
Play backgammon in real-time matches and test your strategy against other players.
• Play with friends
Enjoy a local game on one device or invite a friend for a match.
• Offline mode
Practice your moves and improve your skills against AI anytime.
• New boards to unlock
Progress through the game and open beautifully designed boards with different styles and themes.
• Daily rewards
Collect coins, bonuses, and special rewards every day.
• Mini games and prizes
Try the wheel of fortune and get extra rewards for your next match.
• Rankings and competition
Climb daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards and prove your skill.
• Avatars and customization
Choose avatars and checker styles to make the game feel yours.
• Fair dice rolls
Every roll is random, so each match depends on strategy, timing, and a bit of luck.
Whether you are new to backgammon or already know the game well, Backgammon Online gives you a fast and easy way to play classic backgammon anywhere.
Download Backgammon Online and start your next match today.

bluejetty:00143903:ios.name: WOWPASS: Go Cashless in Korea
bluejetty:00143903:ios.summary:
[Pay Like a Local in Korea!]
WOWPASS is an all-in-one prepaid card for foreign travelers in Korea, covering money exchange, payment, transportation, and brand rewards. Use the app to enjoy the full benefits of WOWPASS!
● WOWPASS Usage Gui
bluejetty:00143903:ios.description:
[Pay Like a Local in Korea!]
WOWPASS is an all-in-one prepaid card for foreign travelers in Korea, covering money exchange, payment, transportation, and brand rewards. Use the app to enjoy the full benefits of WOWPASS!
● WOWPASS Usage Guide
- View a detailed introduction and user guide to the WOWPASS service such as how to get a card issued. 
● Reserve WOWPASS Airport Package 
- Reserve WOWPASS Card + SIM Card + Tmoney balance in a single package at discounted prices, and pick it up at major airports in Korea.
● Check Card Balance
- Add your WOWPASS card on the app to check the balance, which is also shown in your preferred foreign currency. 
● Check Tmoney Balance
- You can check the Tmoney balance of your WOWPASS card.
● Real-time Push Alerts
- Receive push alerts and view the exact payment amount in KRW in real-time. 
● Payment History
- Check your payment history including the categories of merchants, time of payment, etc. 
- View the total amount you spent during travel, making your travel budgeting easier. 
● Special rewards only in WOWPASS
- Download various discount coupons provided only by the WOWPASS app.
- Receive up to 20% cashback on payments made to Korean brands in real-time. 
● Lock your card
- In case of loss, you can pause your card on the app to prevent anyone else from using your balance. 
- If you find your card back, you can unpause it to start using it again. 
- If you cannot find your card, you can visit the WOW Exchange machine to reissue a new card that contains your old card's balance. 
● Self-verification
- You need to verify your card ownership via the mobile app to withdraw the card balance in cash or reissue a card. 
● Find WOW Exchange machines
- Search on a map for nearby WOW Exchange machines located around Korean subways, hotels, and hotspots. 
● Exchange Rate Calculator
- Check the real-time exchange rate for topping up on WOWPASS. 
- Use the calculator to calculate any KRW payment amount to your preferred currency conveniently. 
● (NEW) Invitation Event
- Invite your friends and receive cashback up to 1 million KRW. Invitees will receive 0.5% cashback benefits, too.
● You can trust WOWPASS!
- WOWPASS is operated by 'Orange Square, Inc', an officially licensed Electronic Financial Service Provider recognized by the FSS, the Korean financial authority (Registration No: 02-002-00084).
- WOWPASS service is officially endorsed by Korea's Financial Services Commission as an Innovative Financial Service (Nov 12th, 2021)
- WOWPASS is an official partner of Seoul Metro, which runs Seoul's subway system, and Tmoney, the largest transportation card provider in Korea. 
- The creator of WOWPASS, Orange Square, has served over 300,000 foreign tourists through its currency exchange service.
● Contact us for questions
- Email: cs@orangesquare.kr 
- Phone: +82-1833-5508 
- Chat: www.wowpass.io

Photo Booth Studio: Your Ultimate Photo Booth Experience
Transform ordinary moments into extraordinary memories with Photo Booth Studio. Whether you're capturing fun at a party, cherishing family time, or just snapping a selfie, Photo Booth Studio brings the magic of a photo booth to your fingertips.
Features:
• Design your own templates
• Sharing options (email, AirDrop, WhatsApp, iMessage)
• Many layouts to choose from
• Connect to an AirPrint printer so your guests can print their photos
• Hundreds of stickers to use with your templates
• Large catalog of fonts
• Event mode with password locking
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• Support for portrait and landscape mode (iPad)
Perfect for Every Occasion
• Parties & Celebrations
• Weddings & Anniversaries
• Everyday Fun
Photo Booth Studio turns moments into memories. Whether it's a silly face, a sweet smile, or a stunning pose, we’ve got everything you need to make your photos unforgettable.
Download Photo Booth Studio now and make every shot your best shot!

Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal, Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Learn cryptic crosswords consists of six chapters that take you step by step through every aspect of solving cryptic clues.
How each type of clue works is clearly explained and supported by examples, with simple diagrams to illustrate key ideas.
Each topic is followed by interactive exercises and practice clues designed to reinforce the learning points, and each chapter ends with a practice puzzle to consolidate your learning.

Cryptic crosswords are fun to do and give the brain a good work out, exercising the memory and thinking skills, making new connections and extending vocabulary and general knowledge. 
Learn cryptic crosswords will lead you to an enjoyable and stimulating new pastime.

EXPLORE A WORLD OF PUZZLES
Hundreds of Levels: Dive into a vast collection of spot the difference puzzles that will keep you entertained for hours.
Challenging Differences: Test your observation skills by finding subtle and elusive differences in each pair of images.
Various Themes: Enjoy a wide range of themes including nature, animals, architecture, food, and more.
RELAXING AND MINDFUL GAMEPLAY
No Time Limits: Play at your own pace without any pressure or timers.
Calming Music: Unwind with soothing background music and sound effects.
Eye-Friendly Mode: Switch to dark mode for a comfortable experience during nighttime or low-light conditions.

Unlimited Hints: Use hints whenever you need a little help finding a tricky difference.

bluejetty:00091082:ios.description:
Play these great adventure games! You need to find hidden treasures and win hidden objects games full of puzzles, brain teasers, and other fun mini-games to become a hero!
A famous Secret City collector Cassan died in a plane crash, and his unique collection of artifacts was brought to the Secret City Museum. The artifacts start to affect the residents in an awful manner! The residents lose their magic skills and go insane. You find out that this is a part of Cassan’s plan, who turned out to be alive and vengeful. When Cassan was young, he wasn’t talented with magic abilities, and many Lakrians mocked him. Now he’s up to assemble the most powerful artifact to deprive the Secret City residents of magic skills and subdue their minds! 
· DON’T LET THE SECRET CITY BE REVEALED TO HUMANS IN THE BONUS CHAPTER! 
Play the bonus chapter to solve more logic puzzles, brain teasers, and hidden objects free for iPad & iPhone!
· SOLVE MINI-GAMES, PUZZLES, AND SOPHISTICATED RIDDLES!
Replay your favorite detective games, logic puzzles, brain teasers, and search for the objects needed to get achievements! Are you capable enough?
· LOOK FOR CLEVERLY HIDDEN COLLECTIBLES!
Are you attentive enough to gather your own wonderful collection? Complete brain teasers and find hidden pictures to challenge yourself! 
· USE A HANDY STRATEGY GUIDE!
It’s easy to get stuck finding hidden objects⋅. We have a guide to help you find the way!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.

bluejetty:00015651:ios.description:
Access the world’s largest library of Bible study video resources with the RightNow Media app. Stream content for small groups, find shows for kids, and download helpful guides for leaders. All of it available anytime, anywhere.
Available for free to anyone with a RightNow Media subscription through their organization.
FEATURES
• Streaming Library – Watch 25,000+ videos anytime, anywhere.
• In-App Study Guides – Follow along while watching RightNow Media Original series.
• Bible Access – Read on your own or while watching videos. Available in 16 translations. **For church and ministry accounts.
• Multi-Language Support – Content available in up to 12 languages (includes audio dubs and subtitles).
• Offline Playback – Temporarily access content when you’re not near an internet connection.
• Audio-Only Mode – Listen to content without video—great for commutes, working out, etc.
• Manage Content – Add videos to My Saved to watch later. Pick up where you left off with Keep Watching.
• Browse & Search – Browse topical libraries. Use keyword search and advanced filters.
• Interactive Content & Assignments – View and complete assigned content on the go.
• Share & Invite – Share content and RightNow Media access with others.
• TV Casting – Stream content from your device to your TV with Chromecast, Roku, etc.
• Content Recommendations – Receive notifications about new and relevant content.
• User-Friendly Design – Light and dark modes; easy access to your organization’s library; updated navigation.
WATCH CONTENT FROM TRUSTED LEADERS
• Francis Chan
• Jennie Allen
• Tony Evans
• J.D. Greear
• Tony Dungy
• James Brown
• Patrick Lencioni
• Henry Cloud
• Jon Acuff
• Nona Jones
• Sadie Robertson Huff
RightNow Media subscriptions are exclusively available through churches, schools, businesses, and other organizations. Want more information about giving access to everyone in your organization? Learn more: www.rightnowmedia.org

bluejetty:00087229:ios.description:
Are you worried about your content being flagged as AI-generated? Look no further! Our cutting-edge AI detection tool scans your text or add it and reveals whether it was crafted by a human or generated by AI. Designed for content creators, marketers, and educators, our tool ensures your writing remains authentic and undetectable by major AI detection systems.
Key Features:
 - AI or Human?: Instantly analyze your text to determine if it’s AI-generated or human-written, giving you peace of mind.
 - Humanize Your Text: If your content is flagged as AI, click ‘Humanize Now’ to adapt your writing to natural human patterns, making it indistinguishable from authentic text.
 - User-Friendly Interface: Easily paste your text or upload documents for quick scanning and feedback.
SUBSCRIPTIONS:
- You can subscribe to a PRO account
- Subscription options are 1-month, and one week
- Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original, "one-month", "one-week" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
We sometimes offer Free Lifetime offers. If you notice a charge by Apple, we recommend checking your purchase history at reportaproblem.apple.com and contacting Apple to request a refund if necessary.
- Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/bypassai-detector/accueil

bluejetty:00016102:ios.name: Brutal Street 2
bluejetty:00016102:ios.summary:
Brutal Street's sequel has finally come to fruition!

bluejetty:00016102:ios.description:
Brutal Street's sequel has finally come to fruition!
After 5 years of waiting, the most thrilling gangster battle returns!
This isn't just some casual game to kill time. Nor is it one of those pay-to-win games that have been flooding the market.
What we offer is a single guarantee—that this is THE game that'll revive all those nostalgic memories and allow you to relive the classic arcade games you grew up on!
Playing in 2P Mode, shooting barrels, picking up HP potions and weapons, and, of course, kickin' some serious enemy butt!
From Hong Kong all the way to the US of A, the fights just don't stop! It's time to assemble—all 8 heroes are ready for action!
We offer you unique, creative gameplay:
Weapon ultimates, dual-weapon setting, skill point allocation for equipment sets, and a deep connection between players and the scenes on-screen.
We also offer you an authentic arcade-style experience in our designs:
Tough "kouha" manga art style, destructible battlefield items,
thugs lying and waiting in corners, vans coming out of nowhere, enemies arriving by subway, bonus stages involving a thief,
100+ skills, 6000+ pieces of equipment,
moving, dodging, tossing people up in the air, taking on strong bosses...
You name it! We have it all!
[Original Brutal Street Achievements]
- 5M+ downloads across platforms
- Ranked No.1 over 25 countries 
[Game Features]
- Simple, classic controls have been made even better!
 Move, dodge, and attack enemies via simple "tap-and-slides".
 Using skills has also become more free, more agile, and more accurate—whether they affect a circle, straight line, or fan-shaped area!
- Classic arcade elements are back!
 Thugs chillin' in corners will suddenly come out and kick you.
 Enemies will arrive in vans, subways, or even from the sky! They'll jump you when you least expect it.
 Remember to destroy obstacles on the battlefields and pick up HP potions and weapons.
 Don't let the masked thief get away! He doesn't show up very often, but when he does, show him who's in charge! Plenty of great equipment awaits!
- 8 characters for you to choose from, dozens of active skills, and 100+ passive skills!
 5 major blocks, 3 different difficulty levels, and 80+ stages!
 Protect Hostages, Survival Mode, Limited-Time Missions—various game modes, unlimited fun!
- 2P Mode—collaborative teamwork where you fight the boss together! It's the kind of fun that brings you back to the good ol' 90s!
- Unique and original weapons' ultimate skill system!
 Your character will have different ultimates when equipped with different weapons.
 More powerful attack skills? More stalwart defense skills? AoE or single-target skills? Protecting allies or further enhancing your attack? Well, we'll leave the choice for you, the players, to decide!
- Another unique system: Dual-Weapon Setting
 Each hero has 2 different kinds of weapons. Choosing different weapons will change your character's normal attacks, ultimates, and even their appearance!
 Gloves or knuckles? Dual guns or a shotgun? Tachi or blades? They don't just look different, they come with whole different attack methods!
- Accumulate skill points to activate set skills.
 There are a total of more than 50 sets, each with more than 3 varieties. Choose your own combinations freely and activate more than 100 different set skills!
- Evolved avatar system—change costumes from head to toe!
 Gangster outfit, ninja suit... every kind you can think of!
- Tougher bosses & more distinguished enemies!
 A grandpa who knows Wing Chun, a heavy-built local gangster, the leader of Bosozoku... More than 10 cunning bosses will stop you from conquering their streets!
- Smoother action and more breathtaking close-up shots of ultimate skills!
- The highly-acclaimed talent point allocation system with its high degree of freedom has returned, only even better!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BlackPearlGames

bluejetty:00098933:ios.summary: Welcome to Color Bus Trip, a fun and strategic puzzle game where your job is to manage colorful buses and their passengers! Tap to move buses to upper stations, drop off mismatches, and pick up stickmen of the correct color to complete each
bluejetty:00098933:ios.description:
Welcome to Color Bus Trip, a fun and strategic puzzle game where your job is to manage colorful buses and their passengers! Tap to move buses to upper stations, drop off mismatches, and pick up stickmen of the correct color to complete each bus route.
Gameplay:
Tap to Move: Tap a bus to send it to the nearest empty station.
Drop & Pick: Non-matching stickmen get off; same-colored ones hop on.
Complete and Exit: When the bus is fully loaded with the right color, it departs from the area.
Plan Your Taps: Avoid traffic and match colors efficiently to keep the flow going!
Features:
Smart Sorting: A satisfying mix of color logic and passenger management.
Colorful Visuals: Bright buses and animated stickmen bring the city to life.
Progressive Difficulty: More complex bus and station setups as you level up.
One-Tap Gameplay: Easy to play, challenging to master.
Download Color Bus Trip now and become the ultimate bus route master!

bluejetty:00083923:ios.summary:
Free your thoughts with Supernotes, the fast, lightweight notes app. Write beautiful notecards that are perfect for personal, work, and educational use – all your ideas, meeting, and lecture notes at your fingertips.
CREATE NOTECARDS THAT
bluejetty:00083923:ios.description:
Free your thoughts with Supernotes, the fast, lightweight notes app. Write beautiful notecards that are perfect for personal, work, and educational use – all your ideas, meeting, and lecture notes at your fingertips.
CREATE NOTECARDS THAT POP
Tired of scrolling up and down long notes? Break down your ideas with Supernotes notecards – keeping you organized. Add colors, tasks, bold, italics, lists, equations, images, code snippets, and more. Want more? Connect a bluetooth keyboard, and harness the full extent of our Markdown and LaTeX editor.
POWER UP WITH AI
Try our thoughtful approach to AI. We call them Superpowers that help automate arduous tasks, such as tagging your cards, as well as train you to become a better writer, highlighting grammatical errors and offering rewording suggestions. 
ORGANIZE YOUR KNOWLEDGE
Categorize your notecards using tags, reference popular cards with card links, and pop related notecards inside a parent card to build a network of interconnected knowledge. Multi-select, and edit notes in bulk, in the Table layout. Visualize your notes in both 2D and 3D graph layouts, helping you discover existing and new connections. Build your dream Zettelkasten system.
REMEMBER WHERE YOU WROTE THEM
Only on Supernotes, view all your notecards on a geographic Map. Opt-in to location sharing to automatically assign locations to notes when you create them to see where you had the most inspiring ideas or the most meetings! Or manually assign locations for trips, restaurant recommendations and more.
BUILT-IN SPACED REPETITION

bluejetty:00073587:ios.description:
stoic is your mental health companion – it helps you understand your emotions and provides insights on how to be happier, more productive, and overcome obstacles.
At its heart, stoic helps you prepare for your day in the morning and reflect on your day in the evening. In the process, we also guide you to journal with thought-provoking prompts, build better habits, track your moods, and more.
** ‘Featured App of the Day’ - Apple **
* Join over 4 million stoics bettering their lives *
“I have never used a journal app that has impacted my life so much. It's my best friend.” – Michael
MORNING PREPARATION & EVENING REFLECTION:
• Start the perfect day with our personalized daily planner. Prepare your notes and to-do list so nothing can surprise you during the day.
• Track your mood throughout the day and do bite-sized mental health exercises if you need them.
• Reflect on your actions with our habit tracker in the evening to grow as a human and get better every day.
GUIDED JOURNALS:
Whether you're a journaling pro or new to the practice, stoic offers a welcoming space with guided journals, suggestions, and prompts to inspire reflection and cultivate the habit. If writing is not your cup of tea, you can also journal with voice notes and pictures/videos of your day.
Choose from topics in productivity, happiness, gratitude, stress & anxiety, relationships, therapy, self-discovery, and much more. Stoic also has templates to help you with a variety of situations like preparing for a therapy session, CBT-based thought dumps, dream & nightmare journal, etc.
Journaling is a therapeutic tool for clearing the mind, expressing thoughts, setting goals, practicing gratitude, emotional wellbeing, and promoting self-reflection.
MENTAL HEALTH TOOLS:
stoic provides you with the tools you need to feel better, reduce stress & anxiety, manage ADHD, be mindful and more.
• Meditation – unguided or guided sessions to help you meditate with background sounds and timed chimes.
• Breathing – science-backed exercises to help you relax, focus, feel calm, sleep better and more.
• Stoic Shield - block distracting apps and reduce screen time.
• Sleep Better - journal your dreams, nightmares, and overcome insomnia with lessons by Huberman and Sleep Foundation.
• Quotes & Affirmations – read up on stoic philosophy and better your mood.
• Therapy Notes – prepare for your therapy sessions, track your progress, and reflect on them.
• Daily Prompts - thought-provoking prompts to help you journal better.
AND SO MUCH MORE:
• Privacy – protect your journal with a passcode, TouchID, or FaceID.
• Streaks & Badges – stay motivated on your journey with our habit tracker.
• Journey – reflect on your history, search based on prompts, see how your responses changed over time and see your growth.
• Trends – visualize metrics that matter to you including mood, emotions, sleep, health, writing, and more.
• Export – share your journal diary with your therapist.
• iCloud Sync – seamlessly sync your journal across your iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch and safely backup stoic on your personal iCloud storage.
• Siri Shortcuts – start a journal by simply asking Siri.
• Health App Integration – track your mindful minutes, sleep and more in Trends.
We’re constantly adding more mental health tools to help you overcome more obstacles and situations. You can also join our supportive community on Discord and leave your suggestions in our feedback board.
STOIC PREMIUM:
• Enjoy unlimited access to premium features on a subscription basis.
• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• You can easily manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in Apple's settings.
• Read our Terms & Conditions at https://getstoic.com/terms-and-conditions
If you choose not to purchase stoic Premium, you can still journal with stoic for free.

bluejetty:00018608:ios.description:
DASH Diet App - get healthy, feel good, and lower blood pressure. Our app is your ultimate companion in adopting a flexible, heart-friendly diet for health benefits and blood pressure reduction, combining our successful meal plans with over 200k happy customers! 
The Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) Diet App is designed to help you realize the health benefits of one of the world’s most celebrated diets to help treat high blood pressure through clean eating in 2024. This app offers hundreds of heart-friendly recipes, diet tips, and guidance right at your fingertips. If you are looking to eat healthy, increase your longevity, or reduce blood pressure and your risk of heart disease, stroke, congestive heart failure, or kidney disease, our app makes meal planning and grocery shopping effortless, all in the palm of your hand! Tracking and shopping for food has never been so easy - simply type the name, or follow your customized meal plan, tailored to to promote a healthy lifestyle and balanced diet!
Get Your Customized Meal Plan and Start Your Journey to Eating Well!
Key Features:
- Customizable Ketogenic Diet Plans: Tailor your DASH diet experience with our simple clean-eating meal plans. Whether you desire less carbs or wish to focus on a diverse combination diet, our app adapts to your dietary preferences for optimal wellness management.
- Recipe Flexibility for Every Mood and Occasion: Easily swap out recipes in your daily diet plan to suit your mood, occasion, or dietary requirements. Ideal for those with food allergies or aversions, our extensive recipe library ensures healthy eating is always enjoyable and stress-free.
- Hundreds of Healthy Recipes at Your Fingertips: Explore a variety of Ketogenic diet and recipes, or create and save your favorites, featuring fruits, vegetables, low fat milk, whole grains, fish, poultry, beans, and nuts, while reducing sodium, foods and beverages with added sugars, and red meat.
- Personalized Diet Counseling with Kelly: Get expert advice and personalized support from Kelly, our in-house diet counselor. Whether you're new to the DASH diet, stopping Hypertension, or looking to refine your meal plans, Kelly is there to assist you on your journey to wellness.
How It Works:
- Effortless Planning: Our app customizes your meal plans for breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks each week.
- Streamlined Grocery Lists: Automatically generated shopping lists make your grocery trips more efficient.
- Flexible Serving Sizes: Adjust serving sizes to feed your family or plan for leftovers, fitting your busy lifestyle.
- Quick and Easy Meals: Simplify your cooking with easy-to-follow recipes and healthy meal options.
Subscription Information:
Download the DASH Diet App for free, including a trial period. Upgrade to Premium for full access to all features and professional support. Subscription details are available within the app.
Privacy Policy: http://healthyhappysmart.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://healthyhappysmart.com/terms-conditions/
Sources: https://www.hsph.harvard.edu/nutritionsource/healthy-weight/diet-reviews/dash-diet/
Contact Us:
Have questions or feedback? Contact us at http://www.healthyhappysmart.com/contact.html. 
Don't forget to share your app experience with friends and diet buddies!

bluejetty:00073241:ios.description:
Obey Me! Nightbringer
From the otome game series with over 8 million downloads that took the world by storm comes the latest installment, Obey Me! Nightbringer!
In an all-new story, take on adventures in the Devildom with seven unique ikemen demon brothers and try to find a way back to the world from once you came!
Laugh, cry and sometimes pull out your whip on the seven hot but quirky demon brothers and their unique band of friends in this otome anime dating game.
Who will you choose to stan and become your anime boyfriend?
・A Portal Into Another World
Open up your Devildom D.D.D. smartphone to find yourself staring into a portal to another world! With the introduction of hot ikemen demons into your life, things just got a whole lot more interesting!
・Story 
You wake up to find a world you once knew...a little different.
You are in the magical world of the Devildom right after the Great Celestial War. 
With the help of an old companion, you masquerade as a demon and become the brand new attendant to seven demon brothers.
To return to the world you came from, you must form pacts with the seven devilishly good-looking young men and complete your lessons at school
But it won't be an easy task as they each have their own unique...traits.
Introducing Obey Me! Nightbringer! An otome game for the ages!
Tackle your lessons in a rhythm game as you make the boys; obey you!
 ・What is Obey Me! Nightbringer? 
▷Choose the path, change the world!
Your choices have a direct impact on how the story plays out! 
In addition to chatting and making phone calls, enjoy participating in online meetings! 
That's not all though, cheer on your favorite characters' videos and strengthen their cards for battle! Your decisions in the Devildom matter, so choose wisely!
▷Follow characters on social media!
Go even further and post comments on your favorite videos of the ikemen demons! 
Share your love via a comment or add an effect to cheer them on! 
▷Rhythm game quests!
As you make your way through the episodic stories in the Devildom, you will encounter rhythm game quests! 
Polish your skills and use items and cards found in the Devildom to master the rhythm game!
And what's more, all the songs you hear are sung by the ikemen demons themselves.
■ Official Website
https://shallwedate.jp/obeyme-nightbringer
■ Support
Contact us about any bugs, feedback or comments at:
https://shallwedate.jp/en/obeyme_support_nightbringer.html
■ Social Media 
-Twitter: https://twitter.com/ObeyMeNB
App Requirements:
-iOS 14 or later
Recommended System Requirements:
-An internet connection with a download speed of of 2 Mbs or more.
-A device with 2 GB or more of RAM.
*The app may not run properly even if you fulfill the recommended system requirements due to issues with device performance and specifications as well as the status of the app on the device.
*Please be advised that we cannot provide support for performance issues if your device does not fulfill the recommended system requirements.
Privacy Policy: http://www.nttsolmare.com/e/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://shallwedate.jp/en/fb/terms_of_use_obeyme_nightbringer.html

-Those who like isekai, magic, and demons, magicians, butlers and black cats.
-Those who enjoy free, easy-to-play music and rhythm games.
-Those who like otome games with great anime voice acting.
-Those who like RPGs, anime boys and ikemen idols.
-Those who want a game with an anime.
-Those who like romance manga, anime and dramas and want an exciting, intimate, sexy story.
-Those who want to see conflict and friendship between ikemen boys.
-Those who like ikemen harem, love triangles and intimate scenes with pretty anime boys.
-Those who are looking for the latest otome game.
-Those who are tired of plain old romance games.

bluejetty:00029775:ios.description:
webook.com is Saudi Arabia’s ultimate super-app for entertainment, travel, and lifestyle. It is the one-stop platform to discover and book concerts, sporting events, cultural shows, flights, hotels, restaurants, memorabilia, auctions, and more. Whether you are in Riyadh, Jeddah, the Eastern Province, or anywhere else in the Kingdom, webook.com connects you to everything exciting. With updated listings, verified bookings, and a simple interface, having fun and planning trips has never been easier.
Events & Tickets: Book tickets for concerts, festivals, sports matches, comedy shows, exhibitions, and cultural events across Saudi Arabia. From headline concerts at Riyadh Season and football games in the Roshn Saudi League to family attractions in Jeddah or workshops in Dammam, if you can book it, it is here. Follow artists, athletes, and venues to get notifications on new events. All tickets are official with no markups, and you can resell securely if plans change. Skip scalpers and queues – your tickets live safely on your phone, ready to scan at the gate.
Flights & Hotels: Plan your travel with ease. Book flights with top airlines, compare schedules, and reserve hotels or resorts at great rates through our partner almosafer. Whether flying Riyadh–Dubai, a business trip to Jeddah, or a weekend staycation in Abha, webook.com makes it simple. Filter by price, rating, or location. Choose luxury resorts, city hotels, or budget stays – all with secure payments and instant confirmation. With integrated flights and hotels search, planning your trip has never been smoother.
Restaurants & Dining: Turn outings into complete experiences by reserving tables at top restaurants. Discover Saudi Arabia’s best dining, from fine dining in Riyadh to cafés in Jeddah and trendy spots in Khobar. With integration from Servme, when you book a concert or football match you will get recommendations for nearby restaurants. Pair your event with the right meal – a romantic dinner, family lunch, or casual hangout. Book events and restaurants together in one app.

bluejetty:00037046:ios.description:
Hills of Steel is probably the most addictive physics based tank action game! And it’s free!
Race your way through the hills and crush your enemies with steel. Collect loot from your fallen enemies and boost your vehicles with the best upgrades and special weapons you can find. Unlock new customizable tanks and brawl your way heroically from one battlefield to another all the way to the futuristic Moon. Earn your stripes by winning one tank battle at a time and climb up the ranks to become the greatest war marshal the world has ever seen!
If you love driving with heavy armored vehicles and shooting waves of relentless enemies, this is your game!
Features:
- Destroy! - Shoot physics based weapon projectiles!
- Unlock! - Try out all of the tanks and special abilities!
- Upgrade! - Move faster, do more damage & armor up!
- Adventure! - Roll out your tank and collect war loot!
- Arcade! - Fight against endless waves of tanks and bosses in the Survival mode!
- Versus! - Defeat your rivals in online modes!
- Events! - Play weekly challenges for prizes!
- Rank up! - Do you have what it takes to become a General?
- Leaderboards! - Compete to be the best!
- Clans! - Create or join a clan with your friends!
Roll out your tank now and play for free!
Hills of Steel is a fun and free-to-play warfare game, but there are optional in-app purchases available for players who want to take the fight even deeper into hostile territory.

bluejetty:00129633:ios.description:
Have fun and sharpen your brain with Word Search 2 - Hidden Words, the brand new word search game from the makers of Garden of Words, Star of Words and Wordox! Complete thousands of word search puzzles. It's so addictive and relaxing at the same time!
Show your talent and connect letters to find every word from the list hidden in the grid and unlock awesome rewards and backgrounds. Train your brain and improve your memory by finding the words related to the theme in classic board levels or challenge yourself with exclusive daily grids, bonus levels and quiz!
Compete in free Tournaments every weekend to compare your skills with other players and earn rewards. It brings a word hunt feeling to the game for who like challenges and competition.
FEATURES:
- LEARN WHILE PLAYING: Find the words, relax and have lots of fun. Challenge yourself with harder puzzles to earn stars and unlock BEAUTIFUL ANIMATED BACKGROUNDS.
- THOUSANDS OF LEVELS: Play 4,200+ levels (more to come).
- FIND BONUS WORDS: Earn more stars by finding bonus words.
- POWER-UPS: Earn and use the Hint, Magnifier or Triple Hint to get a little help when needed.
- REWARDS EVERYDAY: Prize Wheel, Stars Meter, Daily Missions, Goals or Rewarded Ad video. Many ways to earn rewards in Word Search 2 - Hidden Words.
- FREE TOURNAMENTS. Find every word to score a maximum of stars every weekend. Earn your spot on the highest places of the rankings and get rewards.
- RELAX AND SHARPEN YOUR BRAIN (LEXICAL IQ). Play to stimulate your brain. Improve your observation, spelling and vocabulary skills.
- FREE AND NO WIFI NEEDED.
& Play exclusive bonus levels and game modes for even more incredible rewards!
WHY PLAY WORD SEARCH 2 - HIDDEN WORDS:
This fun word search game lets you show your word finding skills by exploring unique levels with a variety of themes. It's easy, just search and swipe them right, left, up, down or in diagonal to earn special rewards.
Exercise your spelling and observation by finding all the words in the grid. Have fun improving your memory and expanding your vocabulary.
Word lovers, are you ready? Word Search 2 - Hidden Words is awaiting for you! Words are hidden in a grid, will you find them?

bluejetty:00171494:ios.name: Metalstorm: Modern Air Combat
bluejetty:00171494:ios.summary: Metalstorm is an online competitive shooter where matches are decided by skill, positioning, and team coordination. Jump into real-time multiplayer battles against real players, master distinct combat roles and jets, and compete in fast-pac
bluejetty:00171494:ios.description:
Metalstorm is an online competitive shooter where matches are decided by skill, positioning, and team coordination. Jump into real-time multiplayer battles against real players, master distinct combat roles and jets, and compete in fast-paced air combat built for serious PvP players. Played by millions of players worldwide, Metalstorm delivers modern warfare for competitive shooter fans.
Master your role, win the fight, and climb toward ace status.
COMPETITIVE 5V5 MULTIPLAYER COMBAT
Metalstorm is built for skill-based PvP and team coordination.
- Online 5v5 Battles: Fight with your squad in real-time multiplayer modes like Team Deathmatch, Air Superiority, and Elimination
- Fast Matchmaking: Jump into quick 6-minute matches with real players in seconds.
- Global Rankings: Climb the global leaderboards and prove your status as a legendary ace in our PvP modes
- Team-Based Air Combat: Master your guns and own the sky in a game built for action, not simulation
DISTINCT COMBAT ROLES & JET ABILITIES
Every aircraft in Metalstorm fills a unique combat role. Choose your playstyle and adapt your strategy with 5 distinct class roles and over 42 authentic jets to choose from like: 
- Frontline Tank (A-10 Thunderbolt): Tank damage and dominate close-range combat with iconic guns
- Stealth Assassin (JAS39 Gripen): Ambush enemies with precision strikes and vanish
- Recon Scout (F-35 Lightning): Provide overwatch for your team with battlefield intel
- Sharpshoot Sniper (F-14 Tomcat): Control airspace with multi-lock missile systems
- Tactical Support (Rafale): Disrupt enemy targeting with advanced electronic warfare
BUILD, UPGRADE, AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR ARSENAL
Progress through a deep upgrade system designed for long-term mastery and competitive balance. Modify your fleet like a real warfare strategist to fit the needs of your multiplayer team:
- Jet Stats: Upgrade speed, durability, and guns across 20 levels
- Mods: Customize jets with damage resistance, gun boosts, and high-skill maneuvering upgrades
- Unique Ability: Unlock powerful ultimate abilities that can change the course of battle
- Licensed Aircraft: Fly officially licensed aircraft from Lockheed Martin, Boeing, and Northrop Grumman, including the F-16 Fighting Falcon, F-22 Raptor, F/A-18 Super Hornet, and F-14 Tomcat
LIVE EVENTS, SEASONS & REGULAR UPDATES
The action never stops. Metalstorm is a live multiplayer game with constant new content and limited-time challenges.
- Seasonal Battle Pass: Complete missions to unlock customizations and upgrade resources
- Weekly & Limited-Time Events: Experience rotating game modes and special challenges
- Black Market: Prepare for new jet releases with squad-based challenges and event rewards
SQUAD UP WITH FRIENDS
Join a Squadron of warriors and compete together in the most social online multiplayer game on mobile. Chat strategy with teammates and climb the Squadron Leaderboards together. Whether you’re a casual action fan or a hardcore competitive shooter, Metalstorm offers a social multiplayer experience built around teamwork and progression.
EPIC MAPS & OPTIMIZED PERFORMANCE
Battle across dynamic maps designed for tactical air combat. Use terrain, cover, and altitude to outplay opponents across environments like icy arctic battlefields and high-risk nuclear facilities. Enjoy high-definition visuals and smooth performance optimized for mobile devices.
Download Metalstorm: Modern Air Combat now and experience one of the most competitive online jet PvP shooters. Jump in the cockpit and earn your place among the world’s top aces.
STAY CONNECTED:
Discord: http://discord.gg/metalstorm
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playmetalstorm
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playmetalstorm
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/playmetalstorm
Twitter: https://twitter.com/playmetalstorm
YouTube: https://youtube.com/@playmetalstorm
Need help? Reach us at: https://support.playmetalstorm.com/hc/en-us
