今日热榜，追踪全网热点！
提供各站热榜聚合：微信、今日头条、百度、知乎、V2EX、微博、贴吧、豆瓣、天涯、虎扑、Github、抖音、淘宝、京东... 追踪全网热点、简单高效阅读。
支持 iPhone、iPad、Mac 全平台，配合桌面小组件，热点触手可及。
「今日热榜」背景介绍
经常看到大家在讨论推荐个看新闻的 App，受够了今日头条、网易新闻等全面智能推荐类的新闻 App，我自己本人也有这样的苦恼。
以前必备的网易新闻自从机器推荐后就卸载了，后续用了一段时间的即刻 App，自从即刻社交化后也慢慢渐行渐远了，一直找不到好的替代品，用了一段时间微博国际版客户端，感觉也有点偏娱乐类的。
最后只好自己造轮子，做了今日热榜，告别各种智能推荐，更好的关注热点和管理自己的信息流。
目前今日热榜已经完成 网站、iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 客户端的全面覆盖，欢迎大家体验。
「今日热榜」内容源
1、聚合各平台网站榜单
2、全网原创中文独立博客Rss聚合
3、全网热点日历事件服务
4、全网刷屏热词新梗查询
5、开放型平台 - 支持导入RSS、OPML批量导入、自定义节点。
......等更多功能
「今日热榜」内容展现形式
1、订阅自己感兴趣的榜单或内容节点，每个平台支持查看上榜历史数据。
2、支持聚合订阅的榜单生成信息流
3、实时榜中榜
4、每日热门话题聚合，类似Readhub
5、Tophub Alerts追踪器「PRO用户专享」
6、Tophub Filter 过滤器「PRO用户专享」
7、App Alerts 追踪器「PRO用户专享」
......等更多功能
「今日热榜」App独享功能
1、App 支持白天、傍晚、夜晚、深夜等皮肤
2、App 支持本地记录浏览历史和 收藏夹服务器保存
3、App 支持删除账号功能
4、App 支持换图标，提供多种风格图标
5、支持 Handoff 接力及其他浏览器实验室功能
6、支持桌面小组件：「今日热榜」「我的订阅」「我的追踪」小组件，iOS 17+ 支持单榜热榜、关键词追踪、淘宝热卖榜、京东热卖榜、GitHub Trending 等可配置小组件，支持点击跳转与手动刷新
7、支持 Mac Catalyst：专用侧边栏、顶部工具栏、多窗口浏览、右键菜单等桌面级体验
8、优化 iPad 大屏体验：分屏侧边栏宽度可调、Split View 下页面打开逻辑优化、列表标题换行与高度计算改进
9、优化网页浏览体验：支持用系统浏览器打开、进度条与标题同步、前进/后退按钮样式优化

We're not just a course provider; we're your career accelerator, pushing you to new heights in the design field.
Our Diverse Offerings:

You can also master the art of UI/UX Design, crafting visually captivating and user-friendly interfaces that resonate with modern audiences. With Pro-Mentor, you get to experience the future of design with our innovative AI design modules.

Download ProApp now and embark on your journey of becoming a Pro Designer with us!
Connect with us at:
Email: support@proapp.design
Website: https://proapp.design/
Together, we're not just designing better; we're revolutionizing the design world! Let's design better together!

bluejetty:00062599:ios.description:
Let your young artist color in these enchanting princesses and heroines from here favorite stories and she will enter a world of beauty and magic.
Benefits: 
◦ Teaching children simple arithmetic. Addition and subtraction
◦ Coloring by geometrical figures and pictograms
◦ Coloring by letters
◦ Very simple program interface that any child can master 
◦ Easy-to-use palette that allows you to put together your own unique set of colors
◦ High-quality drawings of all pictures 
◦ Visual effects and sound effects 
◦ Pleasing background music 
◦ Colored pictures automatically saved on closing the program
◦ And many other useful features that make coloring entertaining
Paint by numbers - an interactive coloring book for children. This mathematical game teaches children to recognize numbers and solve simple mathematical examples. In addition, this program develops memory, attention, imagination, and logical abilities.
Boys and girls of all ages love to color. The simple coloring mode is suitable for the smallest of children, including those of kindergarten and preschool age. These include simple and recognizable images that are easy to color. If the child selects the wrong shape, then they will be prompted with the correct number. Therefore, the picture will always be colored correctly, and the child will quickly memorize the numbers. Children can choose to color by geometrical figures and pictograms in addition to numbers. A child can easily distinguish a square from a circle, diamond, and triangle.
School-age children will enjoy the complex coloring mode. Here the picture is divided into a large number of elements, thus making it difficult at first to determine what it depicts. Older children can complicate the task by adding addition and subtraction tasks. Now children will need to solve the examples and choose the correct answers in order to color the picture. This will teach the child how to quickly do arithmetic in their mind.
Those who are learning the alphabet can choose to color by letter. Coloring by letters will be useful for children preparing to enter primary school.
To make the coloring process more interesting and fun, you can change any of the preset colors. To do this, press and hold the jar of paint and a palette will open. Then you can choose your favorite color. Thus, all the shaded areas of the image can be changed in the coloring by number mode. You can have fun by changing the color scheme to suit your taste. Try the program right now!

bluejetty:00169419:ios.name: Maze of Realities - Symphony
bluejetty:00169419:ios.summary: Unlock the doors to otherworldly point and click adventure! "Maze of Realities: Symphony of Invention" offers a captivating blend of technology, magic, mystery and puzzles, inviting players to unlock the secrets of otherworldly dimensions.
bluejetty:00169419:ios.description:
Unlock the doors to otherworldly point and click adventure! "Maze of Realities: Symphony of Invention" offers a captivating blend of technology, magic, mystery and puzzles, inviting players to unlock the secrets of otherworldly dimensions. Immerse yourself in this seek and find adventure with hidden objects, where every discovery brings you closer to the heart of an impending cosmic crisis. Are you ready to face the challenges and save the worlds from the brink of extinction?
So you’ve opened the door to other worlds! And turns out that means so many new discoveries! For example, your friend Dr. Charles Michaelson got an invitation from the world of Innovatrix to exchange knowledge and meet the most advanced AI in the universe – Omnira. And since he invites you to come along, you become a witness to its superior intellect. But is it you or Omnira’s creator, Conrad, who has some dangerous plans on his mind? The more you get to know him and the tragic circumstances of his past, the more you suspect that a catastrophe of galactic proportions is imminent… But can you stop it? Or the worlds around you will cease to exist? 
· EXPLORE DIVERSE WORLDS!
Traverse the realms of Innovatrix and beyond, encountering unbelievably cute robots, high-tech puzzles, and magical brain teasers. The journey will challenge your intellect and entertain your senses as you delve into the intricacies of a world shaped by innovation and mystery.
· JOIN FORCES!
You won't face the impending catastrophe of the adventure alone. Form alliances with Leah, Conrad's daughter harboring her own personal mystery, and Fabian, a knowledgeable scholar from the world of Chronologists. Together, tackle challenging puzzle games, gather information, and find out hidden objects to save the worlds!
· COLLECT COLORFUL TRINKETS!
Delight in the diverse and innovative trinkets scattered throughout the various worlds of the seek-and-find mystery quest. Collect these unique hidden objects to unravel the deeper layers of the narrative and add a touch of color to your adventure! 
· DISCOVER BONUS CHAPTER!
Dive deeper into the narrative of the point and click episode with the bonus chapter, where you'll encounter Miranda, a brilliant yet grief-stricken Chronologist. Unravel her story, solve additional puzzle games, and gain insights of the story's rich and immersive world!
The Maze of Realities awaits – are you ready to shape the destiny of multiple worlds? Play the free trial version, then unlock the full adventure through an in-app purchase.
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00178890:ios.description:
Build your own hotel empire and become a tourism tycoon!
Are you ready to become rich by managing your hotel chain?
Start running a small hotel and work hard to make your business grow. Improve every detail and turn your modest installations into a five-star resort. 
Enlarge your hotel rooms, add luxury furniture and beautiful decoration, enhance all the amenities and comforts and make your guests happy offering the best leisure activities. 
Run all possible types of hotels and spend your revenue strategically to make your empire bigger. Set up the perfect hotel staff and manage more and more efficient services. 
Be the perfect host to your clients and customize your facilities, offer delicious meals and drinks, expand the swimming pool, keep the rooms clean and build competitive suites. Take advantage of your idle activity and reinvest your earnings with a business vision. 
Be in charge of the human resource department and manage your staff efficiently: hire lifeguards for your swimming pool, provide drivers or masseurs for your VIP clients, employ porters, cooks or bartenders and recruit maintenance workers and cleaning service. Choose carefully your business decisions and form a solid work team in your hotel empire to refine your growth strategy. 
Take the lead in free time activities to entertain your guests. Organize scuba diving courses, ski lessons, spa sessions and sightseeing tours around the premises. Don’t forget to enhance the comfortability inside your hotel walls. Give the best possible room service, decorate your hall properly, improve the resting area, offer the best catering and buffet in town, or tender your laundry service to your visitors during the cleaning time. 
Start in a small hotel and grow your business opening an alpine hotel, a luxurious bed & breakfast, an exotic lodge, or an apartment complex. Enjoy all kinds of accommodations and furnish them with every detail from the reception desk until the bedrooms and suites. Your guests would want to stay forever! Provide them single, double, triple or even King and Queen rooms. 
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy Hotel Empire Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to grow a hotel business with profitable results. Improve your hotel empire starting from a small and modest place and unlock visible progress in your premises. Transform your small business into the best accommodation in the world and become attractive to VIP guests!

bluejetty:00166128:ios.description:
As a Poshmark reseller, growing your closet means daily tasks pile up fast.
Manual sharing, offers, and upkeep don’t scale as inventory grows. That’s where a reliable Poshmark bot and assistant become necessary.
Why use our Poshmark bot as your closet assistant?
Poshwatch is a Poshmark bot and closet assistant built to automate the daily work that keeps resale businesses running. 
From auto-sharing and sending offers to maintaining consistent closet activity, Poshwatch acts as an always-on sidekick, removing operational bottlenecks that limit what you can manage manually.
CLOSET AUTOMATION
Poshwatch is a Poshmark share bot that lets you schedule auto-sharing to keep your listings active without manual effort, and it runs in the background—keeping your closet active while you focus on sourcing and sales.
SEND OFFERS TO LIKERS AUTOMATICALLY
Don’t let buyer interest cool off. 
Set your discounts once, and our Poshmark bot automatically sends offers to likers. Choose categories, discount percentages, and price limits—your closet assistant handles the rest.
PRODUCT RESEARCH & INSIGHTS
Use real Poshmark data to uncover what’s selling.
Analyze brands, styles, and trends with Terapeak-style insights to support smarter sourcing decisions.
CLOSET REPORT & LISTING HEALTH
Run a full closet report to review the health of every listing in your Poshmark closet.
As your closet assistant, the Poshwatch Poshmark bot audits titles, descriptions, and pricing, then highlights what needs attention. Combined with other Poshmark bot features, these insights help keep your closet consistent and easier to manage as it grows.
TLDR;
Poshwatch is an all-in-one Poshmark bot built for resellers managing a growing Poshmark closet. 
It combines reliable auto-sharing and automated offers with Poshmark research insights, plus closet reports that review listing health across your closet.
Use the Poshwatch Poshmark bot to automate daily sharing and offers—without adding more hours or manual share work.
Start a free trial and set up closet automation in minutes.

bluejetty:00025746:ios.name: HomeBatteries for HomeKit
bluejetty:00025746:ios.summary:
HomeBatteries makes it super quick & easy to see all of your HomeKit accessory batteries in one location.
* As featured on HomeKit Insider, Shane Whatley & 9to5Mac *
If you have ever found yourself in the situation where a battery power
bluejetty:00025746:ios.description:
HomeBatteries makes it super quick & easy to see all of your HomeKit accessory batteries in one location.
* As featured on HomeKit Insider, Shane Whatley & 9to5Mac *
If you have ever found yourself in the situation where a battery powered HomeKit accessory has stopped working, then HomeBatteries can prevent it from happening again. HomeBatteries enables you to view all of your Apple Home device battery levels in one place and get notified before they run out of power.
HomeBatteries contains these great features:
BATTERY STATUS
View each accessoryʼs battery level as a percentage alongside a glyph which gets highlighted if it is running low. Selecting an accessory will let you see even more details about the device including charge status, trends and more.
NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified before an accessory runs out of battery with support for notifications. Notifications are fully customizable from the Settings screen.
BATTERY TRENDS
View a history of your accessory battery levels and see when it was last charged/replaced so you can determine how long a battery lasts.
WIDGETS
Add the Low Batteries & Batteries widgets to see the status of your accessories on your Home or Lock Screen.
SHORTCUTS
With deep support for Siri Shortcuts, you’ll be able to access and control many features of the app. Use your device, or even HomePod, to get battery levels, last charge date and see which accessories are running low.
APPLE WATCH
View all of your batteries at a glance with the companion Apple Watch app.
BATTERY TYPES
Set the battery type for each accessory from a preset list of options or choose your own so you know what you need when it comes to charging/replacing them. Battery types are suggested using a local database and the power of Apple Intelligence.
THIRD PARTY SERVICES
HomeBatteries supports integrating with Philips Hue, SwitchBot and SOMA, using their APIs, to pair devices with Apple Home accessories. This means devices added to Apple Home, often via Matter, can now display their battery level in HomeBatteries.
ICLOUD SYNC
Trend data and settings for all of your accessories sync over iCloud so you can access them from your other Apple devices.
UNIVERSAL PURCHASE
Get this app across multiple Apple platforms with a single purchase. Your HomeBatteries+ subscription works across devices too.
If you like this app, I’d really appreciate it if you could take the time to leave a positive review! Having issues? Please get in touch:
Email: support@adamfoot.dev
Website: https://adamfoot.dev
Please note that devices should have already been setup in the Apple Home app to use this app. Not all battery powered devices expose their battery level to HomeKit and will therefore not appear in HomeBatteries or the Home app. Notifications & widgets may not be up-to-date 100% of the time due to limitations with accessing HomeKit in the background but there is a Shortcuts Automation that can be enabled to improve this. Some features may require a HomeBatteries+ subscription which can be purchased in the app. You can cancel at anytime.
Terms: https://adamfoot.dev/terms-of-use

We support layers and animations and h
bluejetty:00023492:ios.description:
Pixel Studio is a new pixel art editor for artists and game developers. Simple, fast and portable. No matter whether you are a beginner or a professional. Create amazing pixel art anywhere and anytime!
We support layers and animations and have a ton of useful tools - all you need to create cool projects. Add music to your animations and export videos to MP4. Use Google Drive to sync your work between different devices. Join Pixel Network™ - our new pixel art community! Don't doubt, just try it and make sure you've chosen the best pixel art tool ever! Over 5.000.000 downloads around the world, translated to 23 languages!
Features:
• It's super simple, intuitive and user friendly
• Use it on mobile and desktop with Google Drive sync
• Use layers for advanced pixel art
• Create frame-by-frame animations
• Save animations to GIF or sprite sheets
• Extend animations with music and export videos to MP4
• Share arts with friends and Pixel Network community
• Create custom palettes, use built-in or download palettes from Lospec
• Advanced color picker with RGBA and HSV modes
• Simple zoom and move with gestures and joysticks
• Use Portrait mode for mobile and Landscape for tablets and PC
• Customizable toolbar and a lot of other settings
• We support Apple Pencil!
• We support all popular formats: PNG, JPG, GIF, BMP, TGA, PSP (Pixel Studio Project), PSD (Adobe Photoshop), EXR
• Autosave and backup - don't lose your work!
• Discover a ton of other useful tools and features!
More features:
• Shape Tool for primitives
• Gradient Tool
• Built-in and custom brushes
• Sprite Library for your image patterns
• Tile Mode for brushes
• Symmetry drawing (X, Y, X+Y)
• Dot Pen for precise drawing with a cursor
• Text Tool with different fonts
• Dithering Pen for shadows and flares
• Pixel art rotation with Fast RotSprite algorithm
• Pixel art scaler (Scale2x/AdvMAME2x, Scale3x/AdvMAME3x)
• Onion Skin for advanced animation
• Apply palettes to images
• Grab palettes from images 
• Mini-map and Pixel Perfect preview
• Unlimited canvas size
• Canvas resizing and rotation
• Customizable background color
• Customizable grid
• Multithreaded image processing
• JASC Palette (PAL) format support
• Aseprite files support (import only)
You can support us by purchasing PRO (it's one-time purchase):
• No ads
• Google Drive sync
• Dark Theme
• 256-color palettes
• Tile mode for making seamless textures
• Extended max project size
• Extra formats support: AI, EPS, HEIC, PDF, SVG, WEBP (cloud read only) and PSD (cloud read/write)
• Unlimited color adjustment (Hue, Saturation, Lightness)
• Unlimited export to MP4
• Extended storage in Pixel Network
System requirements:
• 2GB+ of RAM for large projects and animations
• Powerful CPU (AnTuTu score 100.000+)
Sample images made by lorddkno, Redshrike, Calciumtrice, Buch, Tomoe Mami are used under CC BY 3.0 license.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/Privacy-Policy
Terms of Use: https://github.com/hippogamesunity/PixelStudioHub/wiki/EULA

bluejetty:00162644:ios.description:
Discover the world of games and entertainment with the online store “Detsky Mir” in your smartphone!
Order favorite and essential products quickly and easily with the “Detsky Mir” app. Buy and get goods any time you like!
Here you will find all kinds of toys, children's clothing and shoes, educational and board games, vitamins for adults and children, children's and sports nutrition, products for pregnant women and newborns, art kits and gifts for every taste and budget.
The world's best brands are waiting for you. We warn you — this huge choice can make you dizzy!
And a little bit about our functional features:
1. “Detsky Mir” in your phone is a 24-hour children's store that is always at fingertips. Choose and order products at any time convenient for you.
2. Promotions, discounts and sales will not pass by — you will always be kept up to date with all current offers of the store.
3. Choose a convenient way to get your order: we offer delivery by courier, to the selected store or pick-up point closer to home.
4. Forget about plastic discount cards! The virtual bonus card will always be with you — just show the QR code from the app at the store's cash desk to add or spend bonuses.
5. Easily manage an assortment of more than 5 thousand items: use understandable filters to sort products by price, brand, category, gender, age and size and check their availability in the nearest store.
What we've improved to make your online shopping experience even more convenient:
1. Personal Account is renewed: edit your personal details, choose favorite stores, track your current bonus balance, watch order history.
2. Now you can add your favorite products to your “Favorites” and return to them at any time.
3. We also added the ability to track the order status — so you know exactly when you will get your purchases.
What is more, the app now has a button for “Zoozavr” online store, so you do not need to go to the store’s webpage anymore to buy cat food or other pet products!
Add necessary pet stuff, like dog food, cat toys or pet meds, to the shopping cart with kid’s roller skates and get a combined order in any way convenient for you.
Start an exciting journey into the children's world — both the child and his family will be excited!
Have a nice shopping time!

bluejetty:00031189:ios.description:
Click assistant can help you complete repeated clicks in playing games, auto-like, and automatically accept tasks.
The single-target click mode simulates manual clicking, but it is faster and more convenient than manual clicking. 
The multi-target click mode that supports taping multiple target points successively can help you complete complex tasks better. 
Adjustment of floating window size is according to click requirements, which won't block your phone screen.
CPS Test to calculate your click-through rate precisely, the outcome is more precise than manual operation.
It not only helps you complete fast clicks, but it also displays your click speed.
Record your historical click-through rate in detail to understand changes in your click speed.
After each test, you'll be able to see a click-through rate graph and freely select your speed level.
The online counter helps you track various numbers easily.
It supports several counters and custom counter names, values, and steps. 
Multi counter mode can display all counter values on a single page. Counter values can be reset individually or collectively.
Various color themes, Tap sound, and vibration feedback can be used. 
You can view the history of counters and output counter values and historical reports.
For left-handed users, there is a lefty mode. 
Automatic clicking solves the problem of slow and tiring repeated clicking by hand. GC Auto Clicker can help you solve the difficulties of clicking.
You can utilize your phone more quickly and effectively with GC Auto Clicker for iOS.

Meet also helps you get things done. It integrates with other Google Workspace apps like Gmail, Docs, Slides, and Calendar, and offers a number of features to help you run smooth and engaging meetings, like noise cancellation, in-call chat, recordings, and more.*
Features to look forward to:
Make spontaneous calls or host video meetings with your friends and colleagues, all in one app.
Enjoy one-on-one video calls for up to 24 hours and host meetings for up to 60 minutes and 100 people at no cost.
Follow along in your preferred language with real-time translated captions in over 70 languages.
Use in-call chat to share ideas, ask questions, or provide feedback without interrupting the flow of the conversation.
Make your calls more engaging with in-call emojis that allow you to express yourself seamlessly without interrupting the conversation.
Share visuals like photos, videos, and presentations during your call to collaborate or simply share memories from your recent vacation.
Make your calls with family and friends more fun with stackable effects that allow participants to add multiple backgrounds, filters, and animations, to create a personalized experience.
Use on-the-go mode for an audio-only experience with larger call controls, making it easier to take calls with fewer distractions while walking, driving, or using public transportation.
Access on any device: Meet works across mobile, tablet, web, and smart devices,** so everyone can join.

Are you ready to join the world's first social hustling community? Flip the script and find the know-how and community you need to take action and put more money in your pocket.
Founded by hustlers, for hustlers. Fud is a community that helps people find, learn, and execute on their hustles. We know how hard hustling is, so we designed a community to provide the know-how and support to keep you going. Whether you’re starting your own online business or investing in crypto, you learn straight from experts through live video, on-demand video, and social audio streams. Fud partners with proven content creators and trusted platforms to give you the know-how and the community, so that you can take action to learn, collaborate, and grow your hustles.
COMPANY MISSION:
Our mission is to empower everyone to succeed with their own hustles. We strive to support both new and experienced hustlers in elevating their hustles by building a community that shares know-how. Above all, we aim to support entrepreneurship, share knowledge, and encourage passion within our community of hustlers.
COMPANY VALUES:
We prioritize genuine relationships, openness, and inclusivity to give everyone the tools to build the hustle that matters most to you.
WHAT YOU GET:
Access to a community of like minded people.
Content from vetted content creators with proven experience in a specific hustle.
Introduction to leading companies in need of hard-working hustlers. 
Curated offers from proven companies presented in a seamlessly integrated way.
Personalized recommendations based on your interest, passion, resources, and skills.
Exposure to new ways to make money from freelancing to gig economy and entrepreneurship to alternative investments.
Ideas on how to be smarter with your money.
TOP FEATURES:
Live streams on your favorite hustles with the ability to engage with content creators and community in real-time.
On-demand video content to provide you with the right know-how at the right stage of your hustle. We will have content appropriate for beginners and experts.
Workflow tools and to-do lists to make sure you stay on track.
Tools for content creators to share their know-how.
HUSTLE CATEGORIES:
Fud will build communities around creator economy, e-commerce, freelancing, gig economy, investing, passion economy, reselling, and small business will add more as new ways to earn money arise. 
JOIN THE COMMUNITY:
We are dedicated to improving the lives of every Fustler and their families. We want to be a safe space for individuals at any stage of hustling, where anyone can pursue the hustles that matter most to them. 
Questions? Comments? Feedback? Feel free to contact us at help@joinfud.com. We want to know what you think, would love to hear from you, and work together and build transparently to help every Fustler meet their hustle goals. 
https://www.joinfud.com/community-guidelines

bluejetty:00114468:ios.description:
BUILD AND MANAGE YOUR DREAM ZOO IN THIS ULTIMATE ZOO SIMULATOR!
Welcome to the world of Zoo Island: Wild Family Park, a thrilling zoo simulation game, where you can design, build, and manage your own animal kingdom. Step into the wild and experience the joy of animal care, breeding cute animals, and running a bustling zoo park. If you love animal games and animal simulator games, where you can create your ideal zoo world, and manage an exciting zoo park, this game is for you!
GAME FEATURES
CARE FOR AMAZING ANIMALS
Fill your zoo with a wide variety of animals, from small cute animals to majestic wild animals. Feed, care for, and interact with your cute animals to keep them happy and healthy. Every animal in your zoo feels like part of your family.
BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE ZOO
Start with a blank canvas and build your dream zoo park. Customize every corner with habitats, facilities, and decorations to make your animal zoo truly unique. From lush landscapes to cozy corners, your creativity will bring your animal kingdom to life!
BREED AND RAISE CUTE BABY ANIMALS
Yes! You will breed your favorite animals, like in no other zoo game. Build and live the excitement of animal breeding and enjoy watching their cute babies grow. From baby steps to full-grown wild animals, your dedication to their care will make your zoo thrive.
VIEW ANIMALS IN STUNNING 3D
Immerse yourself in your zoo simulation with detailed 3D views of animals and their habitats. Watch them play, eat, and interact in their natural surroundings, bringing your animal kingdom to life.
DESIGN AND DECORATE YOUR ZOO
Unleash your creativity! Add unique decorations, items, and special features to customize your zoo park, making it a place where visitors can enjoy unforgettable moments.
CONNECT WITH FRIENDS
Visit friends’ zoos, share tips, and collaborate to improve your zoo management skills. Compete or work together to make your animal kingdom the best in the world!
EXCITING EVENTS AND REWARDS
Participate in special events to earn exclusive rewards, rare animals, and unique decorations. Complete challenges to enhance your zoo simulation experience and grow your zoo park.
COMPLETE QUESTS AND ACHIEVEMENTS
Take on quests and challenges to unlock new animals, habitats, and features. Achievements will help you expand and elevate your zoo management experience.
PLAY OFFLINE, ANYTIME, ANYWHERE
No internet? No problem! Enjoy this offline zoo game and manage your zoo world on the go.
WHY PLAY ZOO ISLAND: WILD FAMILY PARK?
Perfect for players of all ages who love animal games, animal care, and zoo simulation.
A captivating mix of zoo management, animal breeding, animal care, and creative building.
Beautiful 3D graphics bring your zoo world to life with realistic animations of cute animals.
Engaging gameplay filled with fun events and endless customization options.
Whether you’re an animal lover, a creative builder, or someone who dreams of running a thriving animal kingdom, Zoo Island: Wild Family Park offers a truly unique and fun experience. Dive into this exciting zoo simulator and let your imagination soar!
Download Zoo Island: Wild Family Park now and start building your ultimate zoo today!

bluejetty:00097023:android.description:
Capture photos and videos with location and time information using this GPS camera location app. It records GPS camera data when you shoot, helping you organize and view photos clearly on maps for travel, work, and daily records.
✨ Key features
• Capture photos and videos with GPS camera location and timestamp
• View your photo history on a GPS map with clear location pins
• Use GPS camera location stamps with built-in layout templates
• Import existing images and update EXIF location metadata
• In-app gallery to preview, sort, and manage photo albums
📍 Capture with GPS camera location
When you take a photo or video in the app, GPS camera location data such as coordinates, latitude, and time can be added based on device settings. When available, an approximate address may also be shown depending on network and location conditions.
🗺 View photos on a GPS map
Captured photos and videos are grouped by place in a map view. You can tap a location to preview items, review a travel route, or organize photos by area. The GPS map view provides a clear way to browse location-based photos.
🧩 Location stamp layouts (GPS map stamp)
Choose layout styles to display GPS camera location information, including text blocks, mini maps, or simple bars. Placement and appearance can be adjusted for travel photos, journey logs, or work documentation.
🖼 Import & geotag existing photos
Select photos from your device and add or update GPS location metadata (EXIF). This allows you to geotag photos taken earlier and keep location information consistent.
🔍 Additional details
• Supports common photo and video formats on Android
• Useful for travel photos, journey records, and outdoor activities
• Location data may include coordinates, latitude, and related map fields
🔒 Permissions and data use
The app requests permissions only for required features: Camera, Location, Photos/Media, and Microphone (optional). Permissions can be managed in system settings. This GPS camera location app is designed for creating and organizing location-based photos, not for tracking people.

bluejetty:00074336:ios.name: iPGMail
bluejetty:00074336:ios.summary: iPGMail is a complete OpenPGP client for iPhone and iPad. Encrypt, decrypt, and digitally sign email and files using the same RFC 9580 / RFC 4880 standard you already use with GnuPG, Mailvelope, Thunderbird, ProtonMail's PGP exports, and an
bluejetty:00074336:ios.description:
iPGMail is a complete OpenPGP client for iPhone and iPad. Encrypt, decrypt, and digitally sign email and files using the same RFC 9580 / RFC 4880 standard you already use with GnuPG, Mailvelope, Thunderbird, ProtonMail's PGP exports, and any other OpenPGP-compatible tool.
Bring your existing PGP identity to iOS or generate a new one in the app. Your private keys are stored in a private local database with the highest data-protection class and are unlocked only by Touch ID or Face ID. All cryptography runs locally — your keys and message content never leave your device.
CRYPTO & INTEROPERABILITY
• OpenPGP v4 and v6 (RFC 9580 / RFC 4880, RFC 6637) — fully interoperable with GnuPG, Mailvelope, Thunderbird, ProtonMail PGP exports, and any other compliant tool
• Post-quantum encryption (RFC 9980): import, encrypt to, and verify signatures from hybrid ML-KEM + ML-DSA keys, which pair NIST-standardized post-quantum algorithms with proven elliptic-curve cryptography
• Optional post-quantum key generation: create v6 ML-DSA-65 + ML-KEM-768 or ML-DSA-87 + ML-KEM-1024 keys (turn on in Settings › Advanced)
• Public-key algorithms: RSA, DSA, ECDSA, EdDSA (Ed25519, Ed448), ECDH (Curve25519, X448), ML-KEM, ML-DSA
• Symmetric ciphers including AES-256, with modern AEAD encryption on PGP v6 (SEIPDv2) messages
• PGP/MIME for encrypted email; standard ASCII-armored output for any plain-text channel
• Detached and inline signatures; sign-only mode for authenticated but readable messages
• Symmetric (password-based) file encryption
• Encrypt to multiple recipients in a single message, mixing classic and post-quantum keys
EMAIL
• Send encrypted email directly from the app via SMTP — works with iCloud, Gmail, Outlook / Hotmail, Yahoo, AOL, Fastmail, GMX, Yandex, mail.ru, QQ, Comcast, and any custom SMTP server
• Google OAuth2 for password-free Gmail authentication
• Reply with quoted plaintext ("> " prefix) so encrypted threads read like normal email
• Or hand off to your default mail app via the standard iOS share sheet
KEY MANAGEMENT
• Generate new keypairs in-app with strong defaults (ECC or RSA)
• Import existing public and private keys (ASCII-armored or binary)
• Search SKS / hkps key servers and Keybase to find recipient keys
• Attach your public key to outgoing messages so recipients can import it directly
• Inspect key flags, expiration, signatures, and user IDs
FILES
• Quick Look preview of decrypted content in-place
• Receive encrypted attachments directly from iOS Mail.app — no copy/paste required
• Read .pgp, .gpg, .asc, and .sig files from anywhere via the Files app, AirDrop, iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or the system clipboard
• Open URL handler for the x-ipgmail:// scheme so other apps can hand work to iPGMail
iPAD-OPTIMIZED
• Sidebar navigation and full keyboard shortcut support
• Optimized layouts for Split View and Stage Manager
PRIVACY POSTURE
• Private keys are stored locally in a secured private database and unlocked only by Touch ID / Face ID
• All encryption, decryption, signing, and verification happens on-device
• No account creation, no cloud middleman, no third-party access to your message content
• Open standard — your keys and messages stay portable to any other OpenPGP tool, on any platform
WHO IT'S FOR
Built for journalists, activists, security professionals, lawyers, developers, and anyone who already uses PGP on the desktop and wants the same workflow on iOS. Bring your existing key, decrypt your inbox, sign and send — without surrendering custody of your keys to anyone.

Can you beat the Idiot Test?
Think you’re good at solving riddles and spotting trick questions? Put your brain to the test with hundreds of questions designed to catch you out. The answers might seem obvious, but read carefully before you tap!
ONE SIMPLE RULE. ONE TRICKY CHALLENGE.
Answer 10 questions correctly in a row to complete a level and unlock the next one. Make a mistake and your run could be over. Can you keep your cool and get all 10?
WORK YOUR WAY THROUGH 16 LEVELS
Take on a mix of clever riddles, logic puzzles and unexpected questions. Some will make you think twice. Others will leave you wondering how you missed something so simple!
Every attempt shuffles the questions within your level, so stay sharp as you try to beat your personal best.
NEED A LITTLE HELP?
Stuck on a question? Use a hint to point you in the right direction, or try 50/50 to remove two wrong answers. Free players get one of each per round, so choose your moment wisely!
FEATURES
• Hundreds of tricky questions, riddles and brain teasers
• 16 levels to work through
• Get 10 correct in a row to unlock the next level
• Hints and 50/50 help when you need them
• Personal best scores for every level
Whether you’re playing for a quick brain break or determined to conquer every level, there’s always another question ready to catch you out.

bluejetty:00086506:ios.description:
استمتع بتجربة لعبة ممتعة وتحديات ذهنية مثيرة مع لعبتنا الجديدة! هذه اللعبة هي لعبة حل الألغاز الرائعة التي ستجعلك تستخدم ذكائك ومهاراتك في حل التحديات وفتح الألغاز.
استعد للاستمتاع بساعات من الترفيه والتسلية وأنت تحاول حل الألغاز المختلفة في كل مستوى. تحتوي اللعبة على مجموعة متنوعة من الألغاز والأحاجي الممتعة التي تتطلب تفكيرًا إبداعيًا واستخدام المنطق والمعرفة.
تعتمد اللعبة على نظام مبتكر حيث يجب عليك إيجاد الكلمات المفقودة أو ترتيب الأحرف بشكل صحيح أو حل الألغاز الرمزية. هناك تحديات متعددة ومستويات متقدمة تنتظرك، وكلما تقدمت في اللعبة، زادت صعوبة التحديات وتنوعها.
تتميز اللعبة بتصميم رائع ورسومات مبهجة تجعلك تستمتع بالمشاهدة أثناء حل الألغاز. كما تتوفر تلميحات مفيدة لمساعدتك في حال عجزت عن حل بعض التحديات. اختبر ذكائك وتحدى أصدقاءك وحقق أعلى النتائج.
مع لعبتنا، ستحظى بتجربة رائعة لحل الألغاز وتنمية مهاراتك العقلية. اجعل عقلك يعمل واستعد لمرح لا ينتهي مع هذه اللعبة المثيرة!

bluejetty:00020287:android.description:
We regret to announce the closure of this game on May 18, 2026. The game and all items can be used until the last day. Check in-game announcements for more info.
---------------------------------------------
A new mobile game based on My Hero Academia is here!
Check out a lot of exclusive illustrations of the Heroes and the Villains!
Recommend to you who want to enjoy strategic battles with their Quirks!
What you'll find in MY HERO ULTRA IMPACT:
- An explosive battle RPG with heroes and villains you know and love.
- Use your heroes’ iconic Quirks and let them shine!
- Climb the ranks to be the top hero!
▼ A casual 3-on-3 Quirk battle with your trained heroes and fierce opponents!
- Activate Quirks with the tap of a finger.
- Build skill chains with your heroes' Quirks!
- Break out your flashy Plus Ultra Moves for the final punch!
▼ It's on you to develop your favorite heroes' Quirks!
- Train up with U.A. High teachers and Pro Heroes at the Unforeseen Simulation Joint (USJ)
- Formidable enemies await at the never-before-seen VE Tower!
Put together your team of heroes, use the Quirks to your advantage, and stand bravely against the heinous pursuits of the villains looming ahead!
▼Relive the tale of My Hero Academia in the Main Quest!
The story begins with the meeting of the main character, Izuku Midoriya, and the Number One Hero, All Might.
Watch U.A. High Class 1-A learn and grow, and prepare for the looming threats of the League of Villains and the Shie Hassaikai!
Face off against Class 1-B in cross-class matches and get ready for the work studies at Endeavor Agency!
And prepare for the showdown against the League of Villains and Meta Liberation Army!
Relive beloved scenes from the anime as you strive to turn Deku and his friends into pro heroes!
▼ Check out a collection of exclusive illustrations!
- Display your favorite Ultra Rare character on your Home screen and watch them come alive with the “Cinemagraphy” feature!
- Train your characters to awaken them and unlock new original illustrations.
▼ Customize your Hero Base as U.A. High School, a villain hideout or more!
- Invite your heroes and villains to your space!
▼ Test your skills in Ultra Arena!
- Challenge other players and battle against their hero teams.
- Leverage the Quirks of your carefully trained heroes to win!
- Master the game and claim your spot at the top of the rankings.
▼Interact with other players in Clubs!
Use fun stickers made just for the app and chat with friends!

https://heroaca-ui.bn-ent.net/en/
· Official Facebook Page
https://www.facebook.com/MyHeroUltraImpact

bluejetty:00175601:ios.summary: Solitaire Dragons is a fantastic solitaire card game for you with a marvelous Dragon theme. Based on the solitaire card games, it is true to the spirit of the classic solitaire game (also known as Patience or Klondike) and it will help you
bluejetty:00175601:ios.description:
Solitaire Dragons is a fantastic solitaire card game for you with a marvelous Dragon theme. Based on the solitaire card games, it is true to the spirit of the classic solitaire game (also known as Patience or Klondike) and it will help you to train your brain.
Solitaire Dragons will take you to the magical world of the medieval island. You could play with the witch to go on adventures and encounter various kinds of dragons in the world of sword and magic. What’s more, you could create your paradise by collecting dozens of dragons there, for instance, torridity, foliage, aster, lava dragon, obsidian dragon, etc. It is not merely a solitaire game that makes your brain smart and active, but also a challenge for you to know more about the dragon and get along well with them in the game. Come with the witch and try the FREE solitaire game NOW!
- CREATIVE SOLITAIRE GAME
Based on the classic solitaire game (also known as Patience or Klondike), we've added a CREATIVE dragon world with different Medieval Creatures for you.
- UNEXPECTED SURPRISE IN DRAGON EGGS
Whenever you get a new dragon egg, you don't know what the dragon inside is. Let the witch use magic to speed up hatching. Get more kinds of dragons from dragon eggs!
- DELICATELY DESIGNED THEMES
Put your hatched dragons into the Dragon Island and let them grow up naturally, they will provide you with magic to purify the lifeless habitat, so you can decorate the Dragon Island more beautifully!
- THOUSANDS OF CHALLENGES
Together with Daily Challenges, there are over tens of thousands of classic solitaire challenges for you to play anytime and anywhere!
If you enjoy playing Patience or Klondike solitaire games, it is inevitably the GREAT classic solitaire game for you on mobile devices! You can train your brain and share it with your friends and family members! And if you also like dragons, don't hesitate to download and play this classic solitaire game NOW!

bluejetty:00161698:ios.description:
AppForType helps you create awesome designs for your favorite social networks easily and quickly. Add your own or readymade texts, stickers to pictures, and impress your friends with unique content.
You can work with readymade templates on AppForType or create your own collages for Instagram Stories or Feed. Make your Instagram Feed stand out using pictures, fonts, stickers, your own or readymade texts.
Add texts to your pictures. AppForType now has 60 fonts, half of them support cyrillic characters. You can also choose from 750 readymade texts and stickers for bloggers, travellers and lovers. We regularly add new goodies to our collection.
You can save time using Instagram Feed and Stories templates created by our designers. There are over 100 templates on the app ready for you to use.
Take a picture of your own text and add whatever you want to the app: calligraphy, drawing or even graffiti. You can put together your own collection of texts and try to create 3 stickers for free.
Share your creations to your Instagram Feed or Stories.
Artists from the USA, Canada and Russia cooperate with AppForType and expand collection of texts and fonts. To get inspiration and new ideas follow our profile on Instagram @appfortype, and also post pictures with #appfortype hashtag. For feedback and suggestions please contact us on appfortype@gmail.com.

You can go to your Settings > iTunes Account & App Store > Apple ID > Subscriptions to manage your membership and turn auto-renew off. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00187541:ios.description:
Applying for jobs just got even easier with JobSwipe - your smartest job search companion.
EXPLORE REMOTE WORK & NO / LOW EXPERIENCE OPPORTUNITIES
Discover a world of flexibility with our new feature that lets you search specifically for remote-only jobs. Starting your career or looking for a change? Filter for jobs that require no or low experience and step confidently into your professional journey.
THE TOOLBOX TO YOUR NEXT JOB - NOW MORE POWERFUL
JobSwipe is not just a job search app; it's a revolution in job hunting. With intelligent technology that gets smarter each time you use it, find your next job today - be it part-time, full-time, student, graduate, remote, or no/low experience.
START YOUR NEW JOB SEARCH WITH A BANG
Registering is a breeze. Create your work profile, upload your resume directly from your phone, add your industry information, and choose your preferred job titles. Whether you're looking for jobs nearby or remote opportunities, JobSwipe is here to simplify your search.
YOUR CAREER, SUPERCHARGED
Enhance your career directly from the app. Arm yourself with essential courses and skills to elevate your job prospects and stand out in the job market.
HOW IT WORKS - SMARTER, FASTER, EASIER
- Register and edit your work profile for a personalized job search experience.
- JobSwipe searches millions of jobs, finding matches near you or in your desired location.
- Swipe right to shortlist, left to delete, and tap for details.
- Our Adswipe intelligent search technology refines job matches based on your swipes.
- Upload your resume for a quicker, more efficient application process.
- Mistakes happen - easily review and reconsider deleted jobs.
APP FEATURES - TAILORED FOR YOU
- Enter search criteria once and let JobSwipe do the rest.
- Detect your location for nearby job opportunities, or set alternative locations.
- Shortlisted jobs are emailed for easy laptop applications.
- Stay updated with email and push notifications for new matches.
- Access previously deleted jobs and adjust your choices.
Find your new job today with JobSwipe. Upload your CV, tailor your profile, and dive into the world of part-time, full-time, student, graduate, remote, and entry-level jobs. Your job search becomes smarter and more enjoyable with every swipe. Say goodbye to recruitment woes and hello to your new career with JobSwipe, powered by Adswipe's Intelligent Search Technology [US Patent Pending].

bluejetty:00092527:ios.summary:
The Two Rivers mobile app is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances – anytime and anywhere.
Here’s what you can do with the Two Rivers
bluejetty:00092527:ios.description:
The Two Rivers mobile app is your personal financial advocate. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances – anytime and anywhere.
Here’s what you can do with the Two Rivers mobile app:
· Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
· Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
· Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
· Transfer money between your accounts.
· Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
· Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
· View and save your monthly statements.
· Find Two Rivers branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode or biometric on supported devices.

bluejetty:00031330:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00031330:ios.description:
Train Smarter. See Every At-Bat. Connect the Game.
The WIN app provides baseball and softball athletes at every level with 3 power tools to maximize training reps, accelerate development, and understand performance for every at-bat. 
 1. SwingAI | Analyze your swing using AI-powered insights 
 2. SmartPark | View live game data for every at-bat on SmartPark enabled fields nationwide 
 3. TrainVR | Take meaningful game-speed reps in a virtual environment
From practice reps to live competition, WIN helps players understand why performance happens — and how to improve it.
SwingAI: Turn your phone into a personal hitting coach.
 • Upload & analyze your swing in seconds: Receive instant AI-powered feedback in seconds across key mechanical dimensions.
 • Take action: Get personalized drills and improvement plans based on your feedback
 • See your swing improvement: Track your progress to see improvements over time
SmartPark: Live Game Data, Every At-Bat
View live game insights for pitch, swing, and ball on SmartPark-enabled fields nationwide.
Athletes, Coaches, Parents, and fans can all connect to the game from any location whether in the stands, dugout, or remotely with real-time performance insights directly from the WIN app. 
View live performance & game metrics including:
 • Pitch velocity & location
 • Spin rate & movement
 • Exit velocity & launch angle
 • Batted ball distance & outcomes
 • At-bat & game tracking
TrainVR: Companion Features for VR Users
 • Connects directly to TrainVR, the most trusted VR training system in baseball and softball.
 • Live Pitch lets parents and coaches choose pitch types, locations, and speeds to simulate real game scenarios and guide each hitter’s progress.
 • After each session, VR training data like swing timing, decision metrics, and exit velocity automatically syncs to the app.
One Connected Performance System
WIN connects practice and performance to power performance at every level. 
Built for the Entire Diamond Community
 • Players: Improve mechanics and translate reps to results
 • Parents: Understand performance without guesswork
 • Coaches: Guide development with objective data
Subscription Note
A WIN Reality subscription is required for full access to SwingAI and TrainVR features. Access to SmartPark data is free at all SmartPark-enabled fields. Find your SmartPark field at Winreality.com/join-the-smartpark-era. Learn more about WIN training solutions at winreality.com.
Privacy Policy: https://winreality.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://winreality.com/terms-of-service/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00019318:ios.description:
◆◆◆ PLAY THE HOTTEST SONGS. NO EXPERIENCE NECESSARY. ◆◆◆
Play timeless Piano classics and popular radio hits for free. No prior experience necessary!
Yokee’s Piano app is so easy to use, you’ll be playing like a pro within seconds.
Enjoy a rich songbook of songs across a wide variety of music genres like classical, popular hits, traditional and kids’ songs. With new free songs added daily you can learn new tunes, perfect your favorites, share them with the world and even challenge your friends to see who is the better pianist.
Key Features
- PLAY: Choose from a huge catalogue of songs and musicals across a variety of genres and themes.
- ACHIEVE: Once you’ve selected a song you can play it at the difficulty level of your choice (beginner, intermediate, advanced), practice the chords and create beautiful music. The better you play the song, the better your score.
- CHALLENGE: Once you achieve your best score, let the games begin by challenging your friends to play the same tune via Whatsapp, Facebook, Twitter, SMS, Email etc. and see who is the better pianist!
- IMPROVE: As you play more songs you progress in game levels. Play more songs and improve the quality of your play to reach top levels. Win coins, songs and game capabilities as you progress. Complete challenges and improve your skills to progress even faster. 
Plus, with our unique “duet style” feature, it’s the ONLY piano app where you can play one part of a tune while the app plays the accompanying melody.
Great selection of music:
- Variety of musical genres: Classical, traditional, Rock, Pop, Rap, Classics, Kids, Love songs and more.
- Pop songs:
 *Havana by Camila Cabello
 *Friends by Marshmello & Anne-Marie
 *Attention by Charlie Puth
 *Shape of you by Ed Sheeran 
 *Hello by Adele
 *Let It Go - Disney's Frozen
 *Love Yourself by Justin Bieber
 *Paparazzi by Lady Gaga
 *Rehab by Amy Winhouse
 *Counting Stars by OneRepublic
 *Halo by Beyonce
 *My Heart Will Go On by Celine Dion
 *Rihanna ft. Mikky Ekko - Stay
 *One Direction - Drag Me Down
- Rock songs:
 *Queen - We Are The Champions
 *The Cranberries - Zombie
 *Eric Clapton - Change The World
 *Janis Joplin - Me & Bobby McGee
- Country Songs
 *Florida Georgia Line - H.O.L.Y
 *Edwin Mccain - I'll Be
- Classical favorites: 
 *A Little Night Music by W.A. Mozart
 *Claire De Lune by C. Debussy
- All time classics:
 *Dionne Warwick - Walk On By
 *Andy Williams - Moon River
 *Joe Cocker - You Are So Beautiful
 *Etta James - At Last
More Highlights
-Easy-to-follow tutorial
-Select your favorite type of Piano from the collection of instruments
-More than 190 game levels 
-More than 35 skill challenges
-Full 88 keys keyboard 
-The more you play the more coins you can earn to unlock even more songs
-Preview of each song
-3 levels of difficulty for playing each song (beginner, intermediate, advanced)
UNLIMITED PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
-Subscribe for unlimited access to our VIP song catalog
-Subscriptions are $2.99 weekly and $7.99 monthly
-Play any of the songs including VIP songs as much as you like from any Apple device and enjoy an ad-free experience.
-Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
-Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
-Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
-Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
-No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period
-Private Policy - http://www.yokee.tv/privacy
-Terms of Use - http://www.yokee.tv/terms
*Price are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
Feedback
We’re continuously improving our Piano app. Contact us at support@yokee.tv

In a world where a terrifying sea monster, Kraken, has taken hold of the Caribbean, only the bravest pirates can de
bluejetty:00133580:ios.description:
Pirate Ships is the perfect game for those who want to experience the thrill of building and battling epic pirate vessels.
In a world where a terrifying sea monster, Kraken, has taken hold of the Caribbean, only the bravest pirates can defeat it.
Fight online alongside other pirate lords and thieves, or defeat them; take command of a beaten old schooner and upgrade it to the most powerful battleship on the seas!
At the heart of Pirate Ships is ship building.
Collect ships, cannons, and equipment, combine them in unique ways, and you’ll do more than just capture a fort or two; you’ll become a true pirate lord.
But don't get too comfortable, as you'll need to pay attention to the action to find out which parts of your ship require improvement.
With its unique blend of ship building and thrilling PvP battles, Pirate Ships offers endless hours of swashbuckling fun.
Whether you prefer to take on your rivals alone or team up with friends, there's no shortage of excitement to be had. So hoist the Jolly Roger and get ready to set sail in the ultimate pirate adventure!
Sail forth and free the Caribbean, fearless captain!
Features:
DESIGN YOUR OWN UNIQUE PIRATE SHIP
- Dozens of ship types, from schooners to battleships
- A ton of equipment for ship upgrading to choose from
AN ENGAGING SETTING
- An enthralling, romantic Caribbean sea setting
- A light touch of the fantasy genre: sea monsters, artifacts and more
FIERCE PIRATE SHIP BATTLES
- Fight battleships built by real players, not AI bots
- Ship battles with detailed visuals and graphics
- Dominate the arena and earn first place in the leaderboard
CAMPAIGN MODE WITH PVE BATTLES
- Take action in an exciting Caribbean story full of adventure
- Earn goods for PvP and get a chance to unlock legendary ships
Pirate Ships is a building and fighting PvP game.
Earn and craft pieces of equipment, discover the best combinations, upgrade your ship and test your skills against other players!
One does not simply sail into the Caribbean. You need to fight! It's time to raise the black flag, build your ship, and become a champion pirate!

bluejetty:00059903:ios.description:
MusicTGA is an AI-powered composition app that generates MIDI for chord progressions, melodies, and rhythms.
When you can’t decide on your first chord progression,
when you get stuck at the very beginning of a track,
or when you want to quickly explore multiple ideas—
MusicTGA helps you generate MIDI sketches to kickstart your composition.
MusicTGA does not automatically generate fully finished songs.
Instead, it creates MIDI data that you can use in your DAW, allowing you to edit and arrange the music yourself. It’s a composition support tool, not a one-click song generator.
It’s especially suited for creators who need to produce a lot of music,
as well as DTM users and track makers who want to speed up idea generation for chord progressions.
Spend less time staring at a blank page,
and more time moving forward with your ideas.
MusicTGA is a MIDI generation app designed to accelerate your creative workflow.
WHAT YOU CAN GENERATE
With MusicTGA, you can generate MIDI data for use in your music production workflow.
Key features include:
- Chord Progression MIDI Generation
- Melody MIDI Generation
- Rhythm / Beat MIDI Generation
- Mood-Based Composition Generation
For melodies, you can also fine-tune parameters such as pitch range and note length.
MusicTGA generates MIDI—not finished audio—making it easy to edit and integrate into your DAW workflow.
USE CASES
MusicTGA is designed for situations like:
- When you can’t decide on your first chord progression
- When you get stuck at the start of a track
- When you want to quickly generate multiple progression ideas
- When you need to produce a large volume of music
- When working on competitions or client projects under time constraints
- When you want to explore ideas beyond your usual chord patterns
- When sketching ideas on mobile and continuing later in a DAW
- When you want to experiment with melody and rhythm ideas together
MusicTGA isn’t about outsourcing full song creation—it’s about accelerating your initial creative decisions.
Start with chord progressions and MIDI ideas, then take full control of the final production.
WHAT MAKES MusicTGA DIFFERENT
MusicTGA takes a different approach from typical AI music generation tools:
1. Focused on MIDI for composition—not finished tracks
Most AI music tools generate complete audio tracks.
MusicTGA focuses on generating chord, melody, and rhythm MIDI to kickstart your composition process.
2. Fully editable in your DAW
Instead of finished audio, MusicTGA outputs flexible MIDI data.
You can import it into your DAW to modify chord progressions, expand arrangements, change instruments, and more.
3. Not “one-click complete songs,” but fast idea generation
What you need isn’t always a finished track—
it’s a strong starting point.
MusicTGA reduces time spent staring at a blank page and helps you move forward quickly.
RIGHTS & COMMERCIAL USE
All MIDI generated with MusicTGA is fully owned by the user.
You are free to use it for both commercial and non-commercial purposes.
This includes distribution, sales, social media, video content, competitions, and client work.
PRICING
Free Plan
Start creating chord progressions, melodies, and rhythms right away:
- Generate MIDI based on beat and mood settings
- Adjust melody range and note length
- Save generated ideas
Ideal for testing composition ideas or exploring chord progressions.
Creator Studio
A plan for integrating generated MIDI directly into your production workflow:
- Unlimited MIDI downloads
- Export melody, harmony, and rhythm separately
Perfect for users who want to bring MIDI into their DAW and continue full production.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00149477:ios.name: Baptist Health MyHealth
bluejetty:00149477:ios.summary: The Baptist Health MyHealth app allows you to manage your healthcare with useful, easy-to-use tools. View and manage your medical information in MyChart, find the most convenient care option for your symptoms, find a Baptist Health provider
bluejetty:00149477:ios.description:
The Baptist Health MyHealth app allows you to manage your healthcare with useful, easy-to-use tools. View and manage your medical information in MyChart, find the most convenient care option for your symptoms, find a Baptist Health provider or let us know you’re on your way to a Baptist Health Urgent Care.
With MyHealth, you can easily access:
MyChart
• Send messages to your provider and get answers to your medical questions.
• View your test and lab results.
• See information about a visit with your provider.
• Request a prescription refill.
• Pay your bill online.
• Begin a Baptist Health Urgent Care video visit or a scheduled video visit with your provider.
Providers and Urgent Care
• Search for physicians and other providers by ZIP code, name or specialty.
• Find a Baptist Health Urgent Care location near you or search by ZIP code.
• Check in online at an Urgent Care location.
• View a provider’s phone number and office location.
• Book Baptist Health Virtual Care appointments.
Locations
• Find a Baptist Health location by type, including hospitals, physical therapy offices, urgent cares and surgery centers.
• Get directions, or find an address, phone number and hours.
Features
• Take a health risk assessment online.
• Check in online at an Urgent Care.
• Find a provider online.
• See a provider through a video visit.
• Sign up for events and classes at Baptist Health.
• Read news and recently published blog posts.
• Find a clinical trial.
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the “Apple health app,” when enrolled in self-tracking programs.

bluejetty:00063498:ios.summary:

Meet Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey through Climb Canyon that takes him to w
bluejetty:00063498:ios.description:
Play the original classic Hill Climb Racing! Race your way uphill in this physics based driving game, playable offline!
Meet Bill, the young aspiring uphill racer. He is about to embark on a journey through Climb Canyon that takes him to where no ride has ever been before. With little respect to the laws of physics, Bill will not rest until he has conquered the highest hills up on the moon!
Face challenges in unique hill climbing environments with a wide variety of cars to choose from. Earn points from daring tricks and collect coins to upgrade your car and travel further distances. Watch out though - Bill's neck is not what it used to be when he was a kid! And his good old gasoline crematorium will easily run out of fuel.
Features::
Fresh Content
We are still actively developing Hill Climb Racing and adding new vehicles, new stages and new content! 
Unique Vehicles
Get behind the wheel of a wide variety of different vehicles. From the iconic Hill Climber to bikes, race cars, trucks and even some outlandish vehicles such as the creepy Carantula! Half car, half tarantula, do you dare drive it?
Play Offline
Race offline whenever and wherever you want! Hill Climb Racing is playable completely offline. Play it on a bus, plane or train! Play it anywhere!
Wacky Stages
Climb Canyon is full of unique challenges and stages for you to overcome with vastly different terrains and hazards. How far can you drive without running out of gas or crashing your vehicle?
Unlock and Upgrade
Tune up and fix your dream vehicle with custom parts, skins and upgrades!
Simulated Physics
We worked hard on creating a one of a kind in-game physics system where your vehicles will react to the terrain in a unique manner, can you use this to your advantage and conquer the hills? 
Daily challenges and events
Tackle the daily challenges and events to earn epic rewards! 
Follow Us:
* Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Fingersoft
* X: https://twitter.com/HCR_Official_
* Website: https://www.fingersoft.com
* Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hillclimbracing_official
* Discord: https://discord.com/invite/fingersoft
* TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@hillclimbracing_game
* Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@FingersoftLtd
Terms of Use: https://fingersoft.com/eula-web/
Privacy Policy: https://fingersoft.com/privacy-policy/

Welcome to the Next Generation in Mobile Cricket Gaming! Every cricket lover can now have the most advanced 3D mobile cricket game in the palm of their hands! You can play the maximum number of cricket shots including the famous Dil-scoop, the Helicopter shot and the Upper-Cut! This is a game built for you the cricket fan! You have loads to look forward to! You can customize your players and cheer your team with customized banners! You can also look forward to scintillating animations, more cricketing venues, new controls, and new camera angles! ‘World Cricket Championship 2’ has features that make it the most dynamic and versatile game in the world of mobile cricket. Be prepared for insane fun!!
Features:
· New Career Mode
· Ashes to Ashes Test Tournament
· 150 different batting animations and 28 different bowling actions
. Rain Interruption, D/L Method
. Hot-Spot & Ultra Edge for LBW and Edge
· Enjoy the Blitz Tournament for free!
· Electrifying fielding with stunning diving catches & quick throws to surprise the opponent.
· Challenging AI opponent
· Realistic ball physics which responds to the pitch (Dead, Dusty, Green)
· Player attributes – Players gain extra skills for consistent performance
· 18 different international teams, 10 domestic teams, 42 different stadiums. TEST Cricket, Hot Events and more than 11 tournaments including World Cup, 20 -20 World Cup, Blitz Tournament and ODI Series.
· The Gangs of Cricket mode where the user can form gangs and compete in challenges.
· Challenge A Friend mode enables the user to challenge your friends.
· Batsman may get injured for poor shot selection.
· The emotions of the fielders vary according to the circumstances of the match.
· Cinematic cameras and real-time lighting enhance the visual appeal.
· The 20- 20 World Cup 2024 mode with New Cricket playing countries.
- 3D Wagon wheel with dynamic game data
- Hawk-eye view for bowling summary & for LBW appeals
- 3D Bar chart for innings run scored
· Ultra slow motion Action replays with multiple camera angles
· Over 40+ in-game camera angles
· Two different batting controls (Classic & Pro)
· Two different batting camera settings (Bowler’s end & Batsman’s end)
· Fielders are configured with advanced ball - head coordination system
· Professional English and Hindi commentary with dynamic ground sounds
. Night mode in Quickplay and all tournaments with LED stumps
· Batting Timing Meter to time your lofted shots.
· Manual Field placement to control your opponent in All modes
. Share and save game highlights generated at the end of the match.
. A user can edit the playing 11 team, player names and their roles.
Terms of use: https://www.cricketbuddies.com/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://www.cricketbuddies.com/privacy-policy
NOTE: Recommended iOS version 11.0 and above

bluejetty:00129287:ios.description:
Have you ever dreamed of running your own business and making tons of money? Well, get ready to put on your boss hat and dive into the exciting world of Money Print Idle!
In this super fun mobile game, you get to be the boss of your very own money printing factory. You start out with a small factory, but as you make more money, you can upgrade your machines and hire more workers to help you print even more cash!
But here's the catch – this is an idle game, which means you don't have to play it all the time. In fact, you can even make money while you're not playing! That's right, you can build an Idle Bank and watch as your riches grow, even when you're taking a break from your phone to do homework.
And if you're feeling competitive, you can join in on the Boss Money feature and compete with other players around the world to see who can make the most money the fastest. It's like a race to become the ultimate money maker!
But that's not all – as you progress in the game, you can unlock new adventures and challenges that will test your skills as an adventure capitalist. With each challenge you overcome, you'll become a better and smarter money maker.
The game is easy to play and the graphics are bright and colorful, making it perfect for kids of all ages. And the best part is, it's free to play, so you can jump right in and start making money right away. If you enjoy My Little Universe, you will be ADDICTED to this money print idle game!
So what are you waiting for? It's time to get to work and become a money-making superstar in Money Print Idle!

bluejetty:00023177:ios.name: Dancebit: Home Dance Workouts
bluejetty:00023177:ios.summary:
Stay fit and healthy with fun and easy dance workouts. Enjoy dancing and lose weight at home!
It's time to dance your way to better fitness. With our dance workout app Dancebit, you move to the groove, have fun, and stay active at the same
bluejetty:00023177:ios.description:
Stay fit and healthy with fun and easy dance workouts. Enjoy dancing and lose weight at home!
It's time to dance your way to better fitness. With our dance workout app Dancebit, you move to the groove, have fun, and stay active at the same time. This 28-day weight loss challenge gets you moving and grooving as you slim down and tone up — what better way to work on your fitness than dancing?
From newbie to dancing pro level — no matter how skilled you are — Dancebit has it all! Forget busy gyms and boring routines. Just enjoy fun moves for you all the time. What could be better?! 
DANCEBIT KEY FEATURES:
- 28-day dance challenge to lose weight and train your muscles. Stay motivated with everyday dance workout goals.
- Special programs developed with pro dancers and experts will help you reach your goals - lose weight, keep up an active lifestyle, feel more confident, learn dancing, and much more.
- Tailored workouts for your stomach, thighs and more.
- 7 to 12 minutes easy dance workouts — so you don't need to spend hours working out and get bored.
- Wide collection of dance styles, including Latin, Dance Fitness, Hip-Hop, Country, High Heels, Aerobics, Kiat Jud Dai, and House! There's something for everyone!
- Progress tracking to motivate yourself and reach new fitness levels! Set your personal goals, track weight loss progress, and get instant motivation for when the going gets tough — all in one place.
- Sharing on large devices — broadcast workouts on TV with AirPlay support. Make it more comfortable to work out!
- Apple Health Sync. The information about your workouts and calories can be synchronized on Apple Health.
So, what are you waiting for?! Jive, hop, twist, turn, and rock — dancing is a great way to get fit! 
The app contains the following subscription options:
- Monthly at $29.99, 6 months at $59.99, 3 months at $44.99.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- The account is charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
- The cost of renewal is equal to the value that “Apple’s App Store Matrix” determines as the equivalent of the subscription price in $USD.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication.
Privacy Policy: https://www.dancebit.dance/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://www.dancebit.dance/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00039804:ios.description:
Filmy, seriály a televizní pořady dříve než v televizi, živé vysílání všech kanálů Primy i televizní program. To vše najdete v aplikaci prima+ a spoustu z toho zcela zdarma. Navíc s tarifem PREMIUM můžete vše sledovat úplně bez reklam. Tím to ale zdaleka nekončí.
Naše nabídka filmů a seriálů se vůbec neomezuje jen na produkci TV Prima. Najdete u nás zahraniční oscarové snímky i seriály konkurence a mnoho dalšího. Máme pro vás romantické, rodinné, akční kriminální, životopisné, dobrodružné i dokumentární filmy, komedie, dramata, thrillery i filmy a seriály pro děti. A nechybí ani sci-fi, horory, zábavné a soutěžní pořady, publicistika či zpravodajství. 
Čekají na vás zkrátka všechny žánry a k tomu pro nedočkavce řada pořadů a seriálů v předpremiéře.
Videa můžete přímo přehrávat, pustit si je kdykoliv třeba pomocí Chromecast i ve vašem televizoru.
Dívat se můžete opravdu kdykoliv. Videoslužba prima+ vám přehledně připomene všechny vaše rozkoukané pořady včetně času, ve kterém jste skončili naposledy. Navíc si můžete vytvořit vlastní seznam pořadů, které chcete zhlédnout v budoucnu.
Kromě aktuálně vysílaných filmů a seriálů je vám k dispozici rozsáhlý archiv televize Prima a samozřejmě živé vysílání Primy, CNN Prima News, Prima Max, Prima Love, Prima Krimi, Prima Zoom, Prima Cool, Prima Show a Prima Star.
Pro spoustu seriálů a pořadů úplně stačí, když se přihlásíte. Získáte tím bezplatnou nabídku prima+ FREE se spoustou zábavy zdarma. S placenými tarify však svůj divácký zážitek obohatíte o exkluzivní předpremiéry nových seriálů prima+ ORIGINALS a extra nabídky tuzemské i zahraniční filmové a televizní tvorby. Stačí si zvolit tarif prima+ PREMIUM, nebo prima+ LIGHT. 
Díky tarifu PREMIUM navíc můžete veškerý nabízený obsah sledovat zcela bez reklam a stahovat do svého mobilního zařízení.
Bavte se s aplikací prima+.

bluejetty:00019018:ios.name: Crossword+
bluejetty:00019018:ios.summary:
Start your day with a crossword and a smile!
Whether you’re a novice solver or a seasoned veteran, we’ve designed Crossword+ so that players of all abilities can enjoy solving our crosswords!
We release new crosswords every day and every
bluejetty:00019018:ios.description:
Start your day with a crossword and a smile!
Whether you’re a novice solver or a seasoned veteran, we’ve designed Crossword+ so that players of all abilities can enjoy solving our crosswords!
We release new crosswords every day and every single crossword in the app has a unique theme. For example, Monday’s crossword is music related, and Friday’s crossword is movie related. Even if you don’t know anything about the topic, you’ll still be attempt the crossword as the theme words are sprinkled into the crossword among other clues. So look forward to testing and expanding your knowledge of movies, music, food, books and much, much more!
Why Crossword+?
* Two new themed puzzles every single day (one maxi and one mini)
* Over 3,000 puzzles in our ever-growing collection
* Helpful hints when you need a little extra help
* Catches mistakes as you type with our AutoCheck function
* 100% ad-free. Just you and the puzzle
* Works offline
* Adjustable text size for readability
Join over 500,000 solvers who've made Crossword Plus part of their routine.
Is Crossword+ good for beginners?
Yes! Crossword+ is designed for solvers of all abilities. Start with our daily mini crosswords, make use of instant error checking, and use hints whenever you're stuck. We aim to make our clues challenging enough to be satisfying, but accessible enough to keep you moving forward.
How does it compare to other crossword apps?
We designed Crossword Plus to be simple, intuitive, and accessible to everyone. While there are many excellent crossword apps available, we focus on delivering a clean, distraction-free solving experience that feels natural.
Is every puzzle themed?
Yes! Every single crossword in Crossword+ is built around a unique theme.
What kinds of themes do you feature?
Everything from Trivia Delights and Hollywood Hits to Tasty Treats and beyond! With over 3,000 themed puzzles in our archive, there’s lots to explore and new topics every day.
Can I use Crossword+ offline?
Yes! Download puzzles and solve them anywhere! On planes, trains, or wherever your internet connection isn't reliable.
Do you have free crossword puzzles?
We publish a new free 5×5 mini crossword every day. We offer a subscription which gives you access to full-size maxi puzzles and our extensive archive.
Does Crossword+ have ads?
No. We're ad-free.
Is Crossword+ good for seniors?
Yes! The app automatically respects your device's text size settings. Additionally, you can zoom in on any puzzle grid for additional magnification.
Can crosswords help with vocabulary?
Definitely. Regular crossword solving strengthens vocabulary, reinforces spelling, and improves word recall. All while having fun.
Is this an American or British crossword?
Both! We use vocabulary and spelling that works for solvers on both sides of the Atlantic, making our puzzles accessible to a global audience.
Does Crossword Plus include easy and hard crossword puzzles?
We focus on a single, balanced difficulty level that appeals to most solvers. You can make puzzles easier or more challenging by toggling hints and assistance features on or off.
Can I use Crossword+ for quick puzzles?
Perfect for it! Our daily 5×5 mini crossword is designed for a quick mental break which is ideal when you just want a few minutes of crossword fun.
Does Crossword+ offer hints or help with clues?
Yes! Every clue comes with an optional hint to nudge you in the right direction. Fair warning: using a hint adds 30 seconds to your completion time.

AJNA - Third Eye Chakra
The sexto chakra is located one finger above the base of the nose, in the center of the forehead. It opens forward.
SAHASRARA - Coronal Chakra
The seventh chakra is located at the supreme point, above our head and in the center. It opens upwards.
