bluejetty:00100123:ios.description:
Mine, fight, and conquer! Miner Fighters is an epic idle strategy game where mining meets wave-based battle. Build your squad, defeat powerful bosses, and grow unstoppable with every wave.
The Core Loop That Hooks You
Mine gold → Recruit and upgrade fighters → Survive endless enemy waves → Pick powerful upgrade cards → Defeat massive bosses → Go deeper and get stronger. Simple to learn — endlessly deep to master. Every session pushes you further.
Recruit & Upgrade Your Heroes
• Fighter — high damage frontline brawler built for aggressive offense.
• Warrior — balanced power and solid all-round resilience.
• Tanky — the squad's shield, absorbs punishment so your damage dealers can thrive.
• Archer — precision ranged strikes that deal real damage from a safe distance.
• Wizard — area magic that clears groups and deals massive burst damage.
Upgrade core stats: Health, Damage, Defence, and Luck. Evolve your heroes and discover team combinations that feel unstoppable. No two builds play the same way.
Epic Battles & Boss Fights
• Face endless waves of enemies — each one tougher than the last.
• Defeat massive bosses with unique attack patterns, special mechanics, and epic rewards.
• Use smart strategy and card choices — brute force alone won't carry you far.
Choose Your Cards After Every Wave
• Pick a powerful upgrade card that shapes how your run plays out.
• Boost damage, accelerate spawns, summon extra miners, or unlock special abilities.
• Stack the right cards and feel unstoppable — every decision changes your run.
Maps, Boosters & Progression
• Discover new environments with fresh enemies and challenging boss encounters.
• Activate turrets, shields, and booster items when waves become overwhelming.
• Claim free daily rewards, special offers, and treasure chests every session.
• Endless replayability — new maps, new bosses, new card combinations to discover.
Whether you love idle games, wave survival, hero collectors, or upgrade strategy — Miner Fighters delivers an addictive loop that keeps you hooked for hours.
Download free. Your mine awaits. Recruit your fighters and defeat the strongest bosses!
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

bluejetty:00169286:ios.description:
Discover extreme value for every season and occasion by browsing products, weekly ads, new items, seasonal favorites, and more. From craft supplies to household essentials and beyond, you can find hidden treasures at every corner. Plus, you can also save your Dollar Tree favorites by adding them to a favorites list curated by you, for you. Add or remove items from your list at any time!
Even when you’re shopping at your local Dollar Tree store, our app can help you learn more about products with the barcode scanner feature. Scan with ease by simply hovering the scanner over a barcode to see product information and price details. The possibilities are at your fingertips!
Be the first to know about the latest and greatest. From trendy new items and exciting announcements to WOW deals and new releases, make sure you opt in push notifications. You can even stay connected with us through weekly emails by simply opting in directly in the app!
Your experience on the Dollar Tree app also includes tailored, thoughtful features that are catered to your preferences. You can sign in to your account, select your store to shop at, see the store amenities for each Dollar Tree, and much more.
Download the official Dollar Tree app now to start exploring exciting features and finds!

bluejetty:00071487:ios.description:
Hey there,
Welcome to Animal Hunter, the ultimate hunting adventure! Step into the wild and experience the thrill of tracking and hunting some of the most elusive animals on the planet. Whether you're a seasoned hunter or just looking for some exciting outdoor action, Animal Hunter has got you covered.
In Animal Hunter, you’ll explore stunning environments, from dense forests and icy tundras to arid deserts and lush jungles. Each location offers a unique set of challenges and a variety of animals to hunt. Get ready to track deer, elk, bears, wolves, and even exotic species like lions and tigers. Every hunt is a test of your skills and patience.
You’ll start with basic gear, but as you progress, you can upgrade your weapons and equipment. Choose from a wide range of rifles, bows, and other hunting gear to suit your style. Customize your loadout to enhance your tracking and shooting abilities. The more successful hunts you complete, the more rewards you earn to upgrade your arsenal.
Animal Hunter isn’t just about pulling the trigger. You’ll need to use strategy and skill to outsmart your prey. Pay attention to wind direction, animal behavior, and environmental factors to get the perfect shot. Stalk your prey quietly and aim carefully to ensure a clean, ethical kill. It’s all about respect for the wildlife and the thrill of the hunt.
What’s really cool is the realistic graphics and immersive sound effects that make you feel like you’re truly in the wild. From the rustle of leaves to the distant call of an eagle, every detail adds to the immersive experience. Plus, you’ll encounter dynamic weather conditions and a day-night cycle that affect your hunting strategies.
And let’s not forget the various hunting challenges and events. Test your skills in special missions and time-limited events to earn exclusive rewards. Compete with hunters worldwide and climb the leaderboards to prove you’re the best.
Ready to embark on the ultimate hunting adventure? Download Animal Hunter now and experience the wild like never before. Gear up, track down, and take the shot!
See you in the wild,
The Animal Hunter Team

bluejetty:00174178:ios.name: pianoscope – Piano Tuner
bluejetty:00174178:ios.summary:
pianoscope turns your iPhone or iPad into the ultimate assistant for high-quality piano tuning — for professional piano tuners and passionate pianists alike.
Free two-week trial. pianoscope Standard & Pro are available as in-app purchases.
bluejetty:00174178:ios.description:
pianoscope turns your iPhone or iPad into the ultimate assistant for high-quality piano tuning — for professional piano tuners and passionate pianists alike.
Free two-week trial. pianoscope Standard & Pro are available as in-app purchases.
FOR PROFESSIONAL PIANO TUNERS
With the Pro edition of pianoscope, you can increase your precision and efficiency and make your work less strenuous. Measure the inharmonicity of an instrument at lightning speed, or accelerate the pitch raising of strongly out-of-tune pianos. With pianoscope Pro, you will meet the expectations of even the most demanding pianists.
HOW IS PIANOSCOPE DIFFERENT FROM OTHER PROFESSIONAL PROGRAMS?
Conventional programs determine the required stretch similarly to piano tuners working aurally. They start with a temperament octave and go outward from there with fixed intervals. The disadvantage is that you, as a tuner, have to determine which intervals are suitable for the partial structure of an individual instrument.
With pianoscope, you only have to decide which intervals should generally be as pure as possible and choose the appropriate tuning style. Through thousands of calculations — impossible for a human — the program finds a tuning curve that optimally satisfies your requirements.
Find more information at www.pianoscope.app/features/pro
FOR PASSIONATE PIANISTS
Are you frustrated that your piano soon loses its finely balanced sound after being professionally tuned? With pianoscope Standard and some practice, you can create high-quality tunings yourself. You don't have to train your hearing for years. All you need is a little hands-on skill and the courage to learn something new.
Find more information at www.pianoscope.app/features/standard
STANDARD FEATURES (AVAILABLE VIA IN-APP PURCHASE)
- Measurement of the individual inharmonicity and partial strengths of an instrument
- Available tuning styles: Balanced, Octaves Pure, Fifths Pure, Twelfths Pure, Nineteenths Pure
- Concert pitch selection: 400.00 Hz – 480.00 Hz
- Numerical display of target pitch and current deviation in cents
- Fast-reacting automatic key selection
- Responsive graphical feedback with indicator scale and/or strobe
- Individual tuning documents for each of your instruments
- Synchronize documents across multiple iPhones and iPads via iCloud Drive, Dropbox, or similar cloud services
- Adjustable range, for example for tuning harpsichords
- Use one of over 80 predefined unequal temperaments
- Supports iOS Dark Mode
PRO FEATURES (AVAILABLE VIA IN-APP PURCHASE)
- Graphical representation of the calculated tuning curves
- Detailed deviation curves for fourths, fifths, octaves, twelfths, double octaves, nineteenths, and triple octaves
- Create custom tuning styles with individual weighting of single intervals
- Optional extra stretch, separate for bass and treble

pianoscope turns your iPhone or iPad into the ultimate assistant for high-quality piano tuning — for professional piano tuners and passionate pianists alike.

Free two-week trial. pianoscope Standard & Pro are available as in-app purchases.


FOR PROFESSIONAL PIANO TUNERS

With the Pro edition of pianoscope, you can increase your precision and efficiency and make your work less strenuous. Measure the inharmonicity of an instrument at lightning speed, or accelerate the pitch raising of strongly out-of-tune pianos. With pianoscope Pro, you will meet the expectations of even the most demanding pianists.


HOW IS PIANOSCOPE DIFFERENT FROM OTHER PROFESSIONAL PROGRAMS?

Conventional programs determine the required stretch similarly to piano tuners working aurally. They start with a temperament octave and go outward from there with fixed intervals. The disadvantage is that you, as a tuner, have to determine which intervals are suitable for the partial structure of an individual instrument.
With pianoscope, you only have to decide which intervals should generally be as pure as possible and choose the appropriate tuning style. Through thousands of calculations — impossible for a human — the program finds a tuning curve that optimally satisfies your requirements.

Find more information at www.pianoscope.app/features/pro


FOR PASSIONATE PIANISTS

Are you frustrated that your piano soon loses its finely balanced sound after being professionally tuned? With pianoscope Standard and some practice, you can create high-quality tunings yourself. You don't have to train your hearing for years. All you need is a little hands-on skill and the courage to learn something new.

bluejetty:00184377:ios.description:
Koristite mBanking, gde su usluge i proizvodi naše banke uvek uz vas, za sve što vam je važno, u pokretu, kod kuće, na putovanjima, bez potrebe odlaska u banku.

mBanking aplikacija UniCredit Banke dostupna je svim klijentima koji imaju otvoren tekući račun u UniCredit Banci.
• Obavljajte vaše svakodnevne bankarske transakcije i saznajte sve o vašim troškovima

• Plaćanje ka inostranstvu
• Koristite opciju skeniraj i plati, i ubrzajte unos cifara sa vaših računa
• Prenesi – prebacite novac drugoj osobi koristeći njegov/njen broj telefona iz vaše kontakt liste
• Kreiranje i izmena trajnog naloga

• Locirajte najbliže ekspoziture i bankomate
• Iskoristite mKeš opciju u aplikaciji i podignite novac sa bankomata, bez platne kartice
• Blokirajte i deblokirajte Vaše kartice, po potrebi
• Promena limita po kartici
• Pogledajte PIN vaše platne kartice
• Podela na rate transakcije kreditnom karticom
• Aplicirajte za proizvode banke, koji su vam potrebni za vaše planove
• Pristupite vašem eBanking nalogu, uz mToken
• Budite obavešteni o novitetima, kroz notifikacije u aplikaciji
• Izaberite na koji način želite da komunicirate sa bankom: mBanking/eBanking, E-mail i pošta.
• Kupovina Putnog osiguranja
• Virtuelna debitna i kreditna kartica sa svim detaljima neophodnim za uspešno plaćanje
• Dodavanje Mastercard kartica u Apple novčanik direktno iz mBanking aplikacije
• Tutorijali za lakše snalaženje u aplikaciji.
 -------------------------------------------------
Use mBanking, where Bank’s services and products are always at a hand, for all that matters to you, while you are on the go, at home, or while travelling, with no need to go to the Bank.
You will enjoy fast access to the app by using face ID or fingerprint, clear design and security.
UniCredit Bank’s mBanking app is available to all clients who have open current accounts in UniCredit Bank.
• Do your everyday transactions and find out all details about your expenses
• Favorable exchange rate for buying and selling Euro currency for users with Euro account
• Pay your bills, or shopping orders and have an overview of what are your biggest spending on a monthly basis, or make templates for most frequent payments
• IPS QR code for point of sale payment
• Foreign Payments on mBanking
• Use scan and pay option to speed up inserting data from your bills
• Prenesi - transfer money to another person using his/her phone number from your contact list
• Create and modify Standing order
• Have an overview of your accounts (current, savings), loans, payment cards and documents
• Find out where are our nearest branch offices or ATMs
• Use mCash option to withdraw money from ATMs, without using your payment card
• Block and unblock your cards, if needed
• Change limit on your card
• View PIN of your debit/credit cards
• Splitting credit card transactions into installments
• Apply for Bank’s products, for plans that matter to you
• Access your eBanking account, using mToken
• Stay informed on all novelties, by receiving app’s notifications
• Choose how you want to stay in touch with the Bank: via mBanking, eBanking, email or mail
• Purchasing and activation of Travel insurance
• Virtual debit and credit card with all details needed for successful payment
• Add your Mastercard card to Apple wallet from your mBanking app
• Tutorials.

bluejetty:00180872:ios.name: Animation Maker Kids
bluejetty:00180872:ios.summary:
Animation Maker Kids is an easy to use animation app for creating exciting animation sequences using drawings with fingers or with Apple Pencil. 
This app has all the traditional tools such as paint palette, auto-save, onion skin, brush era
bluejetty:00180872:ios.description:
Animation Maker Kids is an easy to use animation app for creating exciting animation sequences using drawings with fingers or with Apple Pencil. 
This app has all the traditional tools such as paint palette, auto-save, onion skin, brush eraser and frame controls for duplicating, inserting and copy/paste. You can make beautiful animations on your iPad in just a few steps and save out as an .MP4 to share with friends.
Using the thumbnail viewer at the bottom of the screen the user can adjust the timing and composition of each frame fast and easy. 
The animation feature is easy to use and even the youngest of users can soon master making animations in little time, unsupported by parents and teachers.
Upon opening the app, they are greeted by a welcoming splash screen with an accompanying tutorial. 
This helpful tutorial will take the user through the application and its features. The prompts and visuals are easy to follow and a young user can create their first animation unsupported.
Features:
*Easy and fast workflow, get up and started in minutes
*Export out creations as MP4 , share with anyone
*Import Audio(mp3, wav) and scrub on timeline to sync animation with sound.
*Onion skinning, frame controls and Apple Pencil support for creating high quality animations
*Designed by animation teachers using the principles of Montessori teaching as a guide "Learn By Doing"
*Bundled library of animations ranging from simple to complex so that kids can learn by watching
Animation Maker Kids is created by Appy Monkeys , the award winning studio behind Blox 3D,Animate Me and Draw 3D Junior which have collectively been downloaded more than 3 million times globally and been featured by Apple and Google. Our apps have worn awards from Children's Tech review and have been featured by Purdue University in their STEAM/STEM guide for parents.

bluejetty:00030277:ios.description:
Protect your privacy and stay secure with the Camera Detector app.
This app allows you to detect suspicious surveillance devices—such as unauthorized cameras, audio bugs, listening tools, or other covert equipment—in hotels, Airbnbs, vacation rentals, shared spaces, or any place that feels unfamiliar.
Ideal for travelers, renters, and anyone who values peace of mind, this tool empowers you to take control of your personal security—anytime, anywhere.
NETWORK SCAN:
>>> Connect to a Wi-Fi network.
>>> Activate Network Scan.
>>> Unearth unauthorized cameras through detected network devices.
BLUETOOTH DETECTION
>>> Enable Bluetooth on your device.
>>> Launch the app and enable Bluetooth Detection.
>>> Locate nearby suspicious devices using Bluetooth signals.
MAGNETIC FIELD ANALYSIS
>>> Harness your phone's magnetic sensor.
>>> Start Magnetic Field Analysis.
>>> Detect unauthorized surveillance tools like microphones, speakers, or cameras based on magnetic fields.
INFRARED SCANNING
>>> Activate Infrared Scanning.
>>> Identify suspicious devices emitting infrared signals, even in low-light environments.
Disclaimer:
This app is designed to assist users in detecting potentially suspicious surveillance devices using the available sensors on their phones (such as Bluetooth and Wi-Fi scanning). However, it does not guarantee complete accuracy in detection. Users are encouraged to remain vigilant and consider using additional inspection methods. The developer assumes no liability for any damages, losses, or consequences resulting from reliance on the app alone.
SUBSCRIPTION PLANS:
| Weekly Access
| Monthly Access
| Yearly Access
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. The cost depends on the selected plan.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://kainsuite.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service https://kainsuite.com/terms-conditions/

bluejetty:00014050:ios.name: myMail box: email client app
bluejetty:00014050:ios.summary:
Use myMail to manage messages in your Gmail, Hotmail, Live, Outlook, Yahoo, MSN, iCloud and AOL email accounts at once. Our app also supports any IMAP and POP3-enabled mailbox. 
myMail brings all your email into one simple, bright and frien
bluejetty:00014050:ios.description:
Use myMail to manage messages in your Gmail, Hotmail, Live, Outlook, Yahoo, MSN, iCloud and AOL email accounts at once. Our app also supports any IMAP and POP3-enabled mailbox. 
myMail brings all your email into one simple, bright and friendly interface whether its your iPhone or iPad.
myMail was created to keep your mail securely in one place. It makes communication light, fast and mobile-friendly. With a simple tap or a swipe, you can read, reply to, forward, add an attachment and do whatever else you need to with your email.
myMail has a number of unique features that make it stand out:
Push Notifications — Customized to best fit your work/life schedule
◆ Receive instant notifications of new messages – even if your email service does not support this feature 
◆ Turn notifications on or off for an account, or filter notifications based on folders, social networks, domains, or email addresses 
◆ Set a "quiet time" for each account to separate your work life from your personal life 
Your Inbox — More personal and visual 
◆ Navigate through the message list faster with your friends' avatars and icons for popular services 
◆ Customize the appearance of the message list on your device by turning on or off the message preview and avatars 
◆ Email Threads. View your entire email conversation on one screen! 
Search smarter
◆ Quick search through all messages 
◆ Use search filters to narrow results 
◆ Compose your query faster with search phrases and contact suggestions 
Enhanced security
◆ Set a PIN lock 
◆ Touch ID support
››› You can also register with @MY.COM with a cool new email address! ‹‹‹
All your contacts right at your hand:
When you create or forward a message, myMail will suggest contacts from your device’s address book. myMail also brings your contacts from all your email accounts’ address books. And we’ve added the most-frequently-used-contacts feature to help you get your emails addressed quickly. 
Send those pictures:
Share all those party photos with a few taps! Pick a bunch of pictures from your photo gallery all at once. 
Technical details:
We’ve worked hard to make the app incredibly fast and light. Written entirely in native code, myMail uses innovative data compression to save bandwidth and it benefits from our engineers’ expertise, research, and best practices.
Security is our top priority:
Whether you use myMail on a public or private Wi-Fi network, your data is always encrypted to protect all your email communications and information. myMail uses advanced security protocols and practices to ensure data integrity, security, and privacy.
myMail uses AdChoices. More information can be found here https://m.facebook.com/ads/ad_choices 
Follow us on social media:
Facebook: www.facebook.com/mymail.official

bluejetty:00071791:ios.summary:
► IT’S A MONSTER EMERGENCY
The armies of the undead have invaded your kingdom, and it’s down to you to win back your lands village by village. Hire warriors and head into to battle with the zombie hordes to rid your realm of the undead sc
bluejetty:00071791:ios.description:
► IT’S A MONSTER EMERGENCY
The armies of the undead have invaded your kingdom, and it’s down to you to win back your lands village by village. Hire warriors and head into to battle with the zombie hordes to rid your realm of the undead scourge. Turn your army of simple peasant soldiers into an elite squad of mighty knights by merging them, unlock all sorts of village buildings to earn passive income as you progress through the game, and invest your gains back into defense of your realm in this colorful and entertaining adventure game that combines time management with strategy and combat.
► ARE YOU READY FOR BATTLE?
◾What heroes are made of: To beat the zombies in battle, you’ll need to level up fast. Hire new troops and merge them with other warriors of the same level to increase their combat effectiveness.
◾Turn plowshares to swords: Your warriors start off having only simple clubs to bludgeon the zombies with, but as you level them up they get battle axes, armor, longswords and more, turning them into real knights and slashing the time it takes to deal with the undead.
◾Climb the tower: Liberate towers, and you’ll discover your warriors are just as useful with bows as they are with swords, dealing ranged attacks on zombies all around them.
◾What is that thing? If you think swarms of skeletal zombies are the worst you’ll have to fight in this game, wait until you see their leaders – each village you come to also has a fearsome monster boss you’ll have to do battle with before you can move on. Make sure you’ve got plenty of high-level warriors to face them.
► IT’S ALL ABOUT RESOURCES
◾Getting back to work: As you clear areas of the undead, the village will be able to start functioning again, and it’s you that gets the income from the buildings you rescue, including taverns, forges, sawmills and temples.
◾Coining it: Buildings will add to the coins you earn from beating zombies in battle. Be sure to collect your earnings regularly to maximize the amount you can invest in your army – hiring new knights gets expensive fast.
◾Joys of automation: Make your industries even more efficient by automating revenue collection so that you can enjoy truly passive income while devoting your energies and attention to defense of your kingdom and defeating the undead in battle.
◾If I had a hammer… The game has a second currency that can also be won in combat and earned from chests. In conjunction with collectible building cards, hammers allow you to upgrade buildings and further increase your earnings.
► PUT THEM TO THE SWORD
Looking for a fun casual adventure game that combines easily mastered gameplay with tactical challenges and time-management strategizing? Grab your sword, build an army of fearsome knights, and devote yourself to defense of the realm. Download Brave Merge now and get ready for adventure.

bluejetty:00149928:ios.name: Miter: Construction Time & Pay
bluejetty:00149928:ios.summary:
Miter helps construction and field service contractors manage time tracking, payroll, HR, expenses, scheduling, and field reporting in one connected system.

bluejetty:00149928:ios.description:
Miter helps construction and field service contractors manage time tracking, payroll, HR, expenses, scheduling, and field reporting in one connected system. 
Miter makes it easy for your:
- Field team to clock in, submit their receipts, request time off, and view their paystubs
- Foremen/Supervisors to submit their daily reports, create timesheets, and approve hours
- Payroll team to easily pay employees the right rates (prevailing wage, union, etc.), every week
- HR team to hire (ATS), train (LMS), and engage with your employees
MITER FEATURES
Time Tracking
- Field teams can clock in to jobs from their mobile phones or a kiosk time clock on the job site.
- Job supervisors can enter time for their crews in minutes from their tablets.
- Set up multi-level job based approval flows and apply flows to specific groups of employees
- Geofencing makes it easy to see who’s on site and where they’ve been while on the clock.
Payroll
- Process next-day direct deposits with zero fees, so your crew gets paid quickly and reliably
- Automatic tax calculations, filings, and payments across all states
- Generate certified payroll, union reports, and workers' comp documentation with a few clicks.
- Connect every hour worked to the right project, automatically – giving you real-time labor costs.
HR
- Get new hires job-ready instantly with digital I-9s, W-4s, and e-Signatures.
- Eliminate time off confusion with simple requests, job-costed tracking, and a PTO calendar.
- Stay ahead of certification deadlines with automated tracking and renewal notifications.
- Deliver training to your team’s phones & tablets, enabling them to complete courses on the go.
Scheduling and Attendance
- Schedule a crew in under 5 clicks – no spreadsheets, no confusion.
- Crews can check schedules, see who's on site, and get directions, all from the app.
- Sudden change of plans? Update the schedule and notify the crew instantly via SMS.
- Clock in from the schedule. Block off time with PTO. Everything stays in sync.
Daily Reports
- Empower your field team to enter time, equipment, quantities, notes, and photos via one tool.
- Securely capture and store unlimited job site photos and detailed notes for your records.
- Instantly generate professional, branded PDFs that you can quickly download, print, or share.
- Effortlessly obtain customer/supervisor e-signatures on-site so your company gets paid faster.
Per Diems, Reimbursements, and Corporate Cards
- Enable your team to submit mileage or receipts for reimbursement directly via the app.
- Automatically create per diems for team members based on distance traveled or hours worked.
- Associate spend with jobs and cost codes automatically, enabling real-time job costing.
- Ensure reimbursements are approved by the right foreman, super, manager – or any combination.
INTEGRATIONS
Miter integrates with all of the top ERP and project management platforms including: Sage 100, 300, and Intacct, Oracle NetSuite, Acumatica, Quickbooks, ServiceTitan, BuildOps, Procore, and more.
Beyond our native integrations, use Miter’s open API to get access to the data you need, when you need it.
WHAT OUR CUSTOMERS HAVE TO SAY
“Miter finally got us out of the paper time card world. It was 100 times smoother than I ever could have imagined.” - Jason Chenoweth, CFO, Green Mechanical Construction
“Our field team came in, did the training, and said, 'This is easy!' There was zero push back.” - Judy Marasco, Assistant Controller, W.J. O’Neil
“This is amazing… I’m speechless.” - Lia Portillo, Controller, Glacier Construction
Miter is the missing piece that brings your projects, payments, and people together, so you can build with confidence. 
GET A DEMO
Request a demo at: https://www.miter.com/request-demo/

bluejetty:00086987:ios.name: Brush DJ
bluejetty:00086987:ios.summary: The multi-award winning Brush DJ app is suitable for use by all ages and is recommended in the NHS 'Delivering Better Oral Health toolkit'. This toothbrush timer plays 2 minutes of music from your devices or cloud to make toothbrushing for
bluejetty:00086987:ios.description:
The multi-award winning Brush DJ app is suitable for use by all ages and is recommended in the NHS 'Delivering Better Oral Health toolkit'. This toothbrush timer plays 2 minutes of music from your devices or cloud to make toothbrushing for an effective length of time less boring!
Brush DJ has been developed by a dentist for anyone wanting to reduce their risk of gum disease and tooth decay. The app helps keep your smile healthy and breath fresh. Also, by 
using this app you will find new songs and rediscover your music collection - from guilty pleasures to holiday anthems!
Brush DJ works with either a manual or electric toothbrush and allows you to set reminders 
to:
• Change your toothbrush/brush head every 3 months
• Brush at least twice a day
• Floss/clean interdentally every day
• Use a mouthrinse at a different time to toothpaste
• When next to visit dentist, hygienist, orthodontist or dental therapist
You can choose the colour of the screen and timer to match your toothbrush, bathroom or just pick your favourite colour combinations. There are short, animated videos showing how to carry basic oral hygiene tasks such as flossing, using and interdental brush and a manual toothbrush. The latest evidence-based age specific information is given from the NHS toolkit ‘Delivering Better Oral Health’ in text and video format.
Feedback on how you feel Brush DJ can be improved is welcomed via www.brushDJ.com. 
Here you can also let us know your favourite song to brush to, which might make it into the weekly Brush DJ Top 5 chart!

bluejetty:00184109:ios.description:
Northern Birch Credit Union mobile banking app – easy and convenient access to your accounts, while you’re on the go. It’s like having www.northernbirchcu.com in your pocket.
Features
• View your account balances, activity, and recent transactions
• Quickly and securely deposit your cheques
• Pay bills or set them up for a future date 
• Send money easily with Interac e-Transfer
• Transfer money between your Northern Birch accounts
• Receive messages about your account
• Find nearby branches or surcharge free ATMs 
• Enable QuickView to see your balances at-a-glance 
Benefits
• It’s easy to use 
• You can download it for free*
• Fully compatible with iPhone and iPad 
• Access our app using your existing online banking login credentials
• Quick access options – Face ID  
*The app is free; however, data downloading and internet charges may apply. Please check with your mobile phone provider for details. 
Security
Your security is our top priority. Our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full online banking. 
Access 
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have previously logged into online banking. 
Not yet an online banking user? Contact your branch to get set up today. 
Not a member of Northern Birch Credit Union? Visit www.northernbirchcu.com to apply for membership! 
Permissions
The Northern Birch Credit Union Mobile App will ask for your permission to use the following on your device: 
• Take pictures and video- The app will need to use your camera for Deposit Anywhere for you to deposit cheques. 
• Approximate & Precise location – The app uses your phone’s GPS to help you find the nearest Branch or ATM.
• Full network access – The app needs to connect to the internet to allow you to do your mobile banking. 
• Contacts – Allows you to create new Interac e-Tranfer recipients by selecting from your device contacts. 
Use of the mobile app is subject to the terms and conditions found in our Northern Birch Credit Union Direct Services Agreement.

Whether you're
bluejetty:00159166:ios.description:
Your city is rewarding you for shopping local
Participating cities, counties, districts, and economic development organizations fund Open Rewards programs to support local businesses and keep more spending in the community.
Whether you're a resident or a visitor, you can earn cash back rewards on your purchases at eligible businesses in communities that have Open Rewards. 
Open Rewards is live in 100+ cities across the country. Find eligible businesses near you, discover new local favorites, and see how rewarding choosing local can be.
Rewards program for your whole community
With Open Rewards, your points are not tied to a single brand or store, but are usable across all eligible businesses throughout your community. 
This means you can earn rewards at one place and redeem them at another - for example, earn rewards at a restaurant, and redeem your rewards at the bookstore.
Earning is easy: either link your card to earn rewards automatically, or snap a photo of your receipt after you shop.
Once redeemed, you can cash out using PayPal, Venmo, Zelle, or check.
Where You Shop Matters
Every purchase is a vote with your wallet, and shopping local is a vote for your community. 
When you shop at a local business, you help support local jobs, neighborhood amenities, and the places that make your community home. 
Open Rewards makes it more rewarding to make that choice. 
Every purchase counts. Together, we can make a big impact in the communities we call home.

bluejetty:00169638:ios.description:
Welcome to Plant Guru—your reliable and tireless plant care assistant!
Looking for an app to effortlessly manage your care tasks, remind you of them on time, and expertly diagnose any plant issues? Look no more!
Whether you’re a seasoned gardener or a novice making your first steps in plant care, our app has you covered. Plant Guru offers a wide array of tools and features to help you look after your plants. Let the app free your mind and keep track of your plant care responsibilities for you.
► Learn what’s wrong with your plant—and how to keep it disease-free!
Unsure why your favorite flower looks sad and droopy? It’s okay if you can’t immediately diagnose all the weird symptoms your plants display—because Plant Guru can! The app is able to recognize various pests and widespread plant diseases, presenting an accurate plant diagnosis.
► Never miss any of your care tasks!
Having a tough time remembering to water or feed your plants because of your busy lifestyle? There's an excellent solution! With Plant Guru’s handy watering, misting, fertilizing, and rotating reminders, you can arrange your tasks a schedule convenient to you.
► Become a plant care guru with our blog!
Explore Daily Insights, Interesting Videos, Gardening Advice, Trendy Plants, and Care How-Tos. Learn the ins and outs of repotting and get inspired by the most spectacular gardens!
► Master gardening with handy tools!
• Estimate the appropriate amount of water and get the perfect watering schedule for any plant with Water Calculator.
• Measure the natural light intensity of any area and find the best spot for your plant with Light Meter.
• Learn how much you spend on your plants and take control of your budget with My Expenses.
• Use Plant Nanny to share care reminders with the people you trust and have your plants taken care of, even when you’re gone!
• Turn on Relocation Mode to snooze reminders while you’re moving.
• Enable Safety Control to remove all poisonous and pet-toxic plants from your search results and enjoy a stress-free gardening experience.
• Consult Moon Calendar to get expert plant care tips for each moon phase and let lunar energy help your plants thrive.
► Identify any plant by simply taking a photo of it!
Ever come across an unknown plant species on a walk? Plant Guru can help you with that. Just snap a picture of the unknown plant and let our plant identifier do the rest.
► Find the perfect green pet to diversify your indoor garden!
You can choose from one of our vast collections:
• Succulents
• Flowering Plants
• Herbs
• Leaf Plants
• Trees
• Bushes
• Fruits & Vegetables
Free yourself from constantly worrying whether you're taking good care of your green pets. Plant Guru will help you run the plant's health check, schedule care tasks, and estimate the appropriate amount of water. Let our smart assistant become your trusted guru and a guide to the exciting world of plant care!
Subscribe to Plant Guru Premium to get unlimited access to all the app’s features:
• Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate depending on the subscription plan.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:

http://aiby.mobi/plantguru_ios/privacy

bluejetty:00157579:ios.summary:

Get Certified:
Comprehensive specialty certifica
bluejetty:00157579:ios.description:
Become a part of PT Version 2.0 by learning to deliver world-class fitness forward, manual therapy skilled, and psychologically informed care for every age and stage of patient and athlete. 
Get Certified:
Comprehensive specialty certification tracts with in-person testing serve as the foundation of our curriculum. 
- You choose which patient population you want to specialize in, we deliver the focused combination of live and online courses to elevate your skill set beyond that of your competitors 
- Every certification has an intentional combination of in-person and online experiences to facilitate psychomotor excellence and a deep understanding of current best evidence
Individual Course Offerings:
The ICE course library has every option you’ll need to join the Physical Therapy Version 2.0 movement 
- Choose from cutting edge courses in any of these popular content areas: Dry Needling, Pelvic Health, Orthopedics, Geriatrics, Spine Care, Fitness Athlete Management, Persistent Pain, Endurance Athlete Management, and Primary Care. 
Industry Leading Faculty:
ICE faculty don’t teach across multiple divisions, they focus exclusively in each area where you’re seeking specialization. No one becomes a specialist learning from a generalist
- Our teachers are clinicians. We’re still active in patient care and facing the same daily challenges as you. Learn techniques and approaches developed in the trenches of clinic, not in the ivory towers of academia.
Modern Course Design:
ICE courses are meticulously organized and delivered. 
- Taking an online course? You’ll do so in our carefully curated platform built in partnership with the popular Circle platform where you’ll find our virtual ecosystem a joy to navigate. Engage in our courses via your browser or better yet on the ICE Physio app! 
- Taking an in-person course? Over the past decade ICE has developed an unbelievable network of preferred hosts across the nation whose facilities are perfect to showcase our unique fitness forward brand of coursework
- Lifetime access to all coursework as well as any future updates
Community:
Engaging in ICE courses isn’t only about becoming the premiere provider in your community, it’s about joining a like minded community unlike any other. 
- Our private community of ICE students boasts thousands of driven clinicians constantly eager to share input on your challenging cases, help you find your next job, troubleshoot business questions, or simply share in the crazy journey that is clinical practice. 
 - The PTonICE Daily Show podcast episodes are downloaded several million times every year across the entire globe leading to rich discussions within and beyond our nation’s borders. Wherever people are choosing fitness over sickness, you’ll find ICE Physio in the conversation. 
CEUs:
While “checking the box” is unlikely to be the primary motivation behind your taking an ICE course, making sure every course counts towards license renewal is something we’ve been delivering on for over a decade
- Every ICE course is pre-approved for CEU in any state where the course is physically hosted
- Live AND online offerings are pre-approved in California and every state which shares reciprocity 
- Specific state by state details as well as information for a wide variety of professional licenses beyond physical therapy can be conveniently found on our FAQ page at PTonICE.com

bluejetty:00028373:ios.name: Project Life
bluejetty:00028373:ios.summary: Bring your photos + stories together into a meaningful format without having to print your photos first, and without having to use crafting supplies! Documenting in the palm of your hand has never been easier, faster, or more convenient wit
bluejetty:00028373:ios.description:
Bring your photos + stories together into a meaningful format without having to print your photos first, and without having to use crafting supplies! Documenting in the palm of your hand has never been easier, faster, or more convenient with such stunning results that you ultimately get to HOLD IN YOUR HANDS!
Collage-style templates and pre-designed artwork allow for pages to come together in a snap. Pull in your photos from your Camera Roll, Photo Stream, or Dropbox. There are hundreds of fantastic designer card collections to choose from within the app. Add some quick journaling notes and you’re done! Editorial-style templates are designed for fewer (or no) photos and allow for longer journaling entries and stories.
Don’t allow your memories to stay trapped on your device. The best part of this game-changing method of documenting is seamlessly sharing completed pages with your friends and family — and of course getting those pages and photo books PRINTED directly THROUGH the app so that you can hold those memories in your hands! 
Follow @BeckyHigginsLLC on Instagram for ongoing inspiration.
FEATURES:
import photos from Camera Roll, Photo Stream, or Dropbox 
zoom, crop, edit, rotate, and rearrange photos
easy drag + drop photos and cards between spots
zoom in and around your page for closer details
adjust font style, size, color and more
colored background options
lots of page layout options
a huge library of card designs and kits available
corners can be rounded or square
several 4x6 and 6x8 collage options
use Speech-to-Text for fast journaling
all pages (including those in progress) automatically save to library
view specific Project Life card designs before purchasing
export, share, and print completed pages
organize pages into albums for various projects
order individual page prints or photo books
square pages and photo books available in 8x8, 10x10, and 12x12 sizes
search features allows for easy + fast access to the cards you’re looking for
The Project Life App offers a subscription service providing online backup and device-to-device syncing of the pages you create. This service is optional. The following details apply to the Online Backup subscription:
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. If you cancel your subscription your online page backups are kept for 90 days then deleted if the subscription is not resumed.
Terms of Service: https://www.beckyhiggins.com/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00095020:ios.description:
Unleash Your Inner Crafter with World of Skins!
Searching for the perfect Minecraft skin? Dive into a universe of millions of unique Minecraft skins with World of Skins! Whether you're a seasoned builder or just starting your Minecraft journey, we've got the skin that will make you stand out from the crowd.
Explore a Massive Collection: Browse through an extensive library of skins, categorized for both boys and girls, and discover everything from epic heroes and mythical creatures to everyday characters and quirky designs. Finding your dream skin has never been easier!
Powerful Skin Editor: Take control of your look with our built-in skin editor. Tweak every pixel, customize colors, and create your own personalized masterpiece. Save your creations to your collection and switch between them effortlessly.
Seamless Browsing Experience: Enjoy smooth and intuitive navigation. Preview skins in stunning 3D, zoom in for a closer look in 2D, and easily manage your favorites with a simple tap. Our smart system remembers your browsing position, so you can pick up right where you left off.
Key Features:
* Millions of Minecraft Skins: A vast and ever-growing collection of skins for all styles.
* Integrated Skin Editor: Customize existing skins or create your own from scratch.
* 3D and 2D Previews: Explore skins from every angle.
* Favorites Collection: Save and easily access your favorite skins.
* Easy Skin Sharing: Share skin numbers with friends.
* Smart Browsing: The app remembers your last viewed skin.
Download World of Skins today and transform your Minecraft character into a true reflection of your personality!

bluejetty:00121906:ios.description:
The Radio Ananda App is the essence of simplicity, offering a beautiful stream of music for healing, energization, and relaxation. Radio Ananda (Sanskrit for "joy") is produced by members of Ananda, a worldwide movement and community of souls seeking joy and inner freedom through the revolutionary teachings of Paramhansa Yogananda (1893-1952). Yogananda is well known as the author of Autobiography of a Yogi, a spiritual classic read by millions around the world.
The Ananda movement was begun by Nayaswami Kriyananda, a direct disciple of Paramhansa Yogananda. Kriyananda wrote some 400 pieces of inspirational music, which form the core of programming on Radio Ananda. Rather than merely stirring up one's emotions, this music takes the listener into states of calm feeling, where intuition and other soul qualities such as bliss, love, power, calmness, peace, and wisdom can blossom and grow.

bluejetty:00016579:ios.description:
Episode with Vampires and Werewolves! Your choices, your story, your romance!
Is It Love? Nicolae Vampire is an interactive game (choice game). A game with vampires, Witches, and werewolves.
Like in TV sitcoms, new episodes (chapters) are regularly released.
Story:
"You live with the Bartholys, a family full of secrets and mysteries. You're going to start to have strange dreams about the most bewitching of the three brothers, the eldest, Nicolae. In charge of protecting his siblings while their father is away, you will discover that he's far from being as reasonable as he pretends to be.
From past to present, dreams to reality, magic and hypnosis, hunting down and revenge, you will venture far beyond the strange city of Mystery Spell and wander through nineteenth-century London, discovering Nicolae's secrets as well as Ludwig's, his rival. In this new story, vampires and werewolves confront each other but nothing is what it seems. You will need courage and self-control not to lose your mind. But above all, will you have what it takes to reason both enemy clans and conquer the mysterious Nicolae's heart?"
Strong points:
• It's your game: Your choices influence the story.
• A 100% free Otome Game in English.
• Meet with Vampires, Werewolves, and Witches...
• A new visual adventure.
An Otome is a visual novel type game in which you are the heroine about to live true romance (a love story) with possible twists (Love, seduction, betrayal, marriage...) depending on the choices you make (choice game).
Download this vampire game, if you:
• Like love stories or stories about Vampires and Witches
• Watch romantic films
• Read Mangas with vampires or Werewolves
• Want to live an Otome love Story
• Discover a new choice game in English
Follow us:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/isitlovegames/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/isitlovegames
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weareisitlovegames/
Got any problems or questions?
Contact our in-game support team by clicking on Menu and then Support.
Our story:
1492 Studio is based in Montpellier, France. It was co-founded in 2014 by Claire and Thibaud Zamora, two entrepreneurs with over twenty years’ experience in the freemium game industry. Acquired by Ubisoft in 2018, the studio has forged ahead in creating interactive stories in the form of visual novels, further enriching the content of their "Is It Love?" series. With a total of fourteen mobile applications with more than 60 million downloads to date, 1492 Studio designs games that take players on a journey through worlds that are rich in intrigue, suspense and, of course, romance. The studio continues to provide live games by creating additional content and keeping in touch with a strong and active fan base while working on upcoming projects.

bluejetty:00042292:ios.description:
Welcome aboard! The GRTC On the Go app is a whole new way to get around the Richmond region — book on-demand rides in advance for LINK microtransit and CARE paratransit services. It’s the smart, easy, and affordable way to go door-to-door in your community.
With a few taps, book an on-demand microtransit or paratransit ride in the app and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way.
How it works:
Download the GRTC On the Go app.
Book a ride on your phone.
Get picked up at your door or designated pickup point.
The app will tell you when your vehicle is on its way.
Share your ride with others to your destination.
What we’re about:
CONNECTED

bluejetty:00009840:android.description:
What if 🇩🇰 Danish language learning would become a crazy fun game instead of the boring and old memorization techniques? With Drops, Danish language learning becomes an effortless and super fun game. Practical Danish vocabulary is cemented into your memory thanks to our beautiful images and quick mini-games. The surprising part? You only need 5 minutes Danish language practice a day! Sounds counterintuitive but it works like magic and you’ll be a Danish vocabulary pro in no time! :) 
Here’s our secret sauce for its success: 
👀 100% illustrated: Pictures identify a meaning right away– You no longer have to analyze its translation through your native language. Making your Danish language learning process faster and more effective in an extremely fun way. 
🏎 5 min sessions: Limited practice sessions might sound counter-productive, but it is what makes it incredibly addictive! A cool thing when it comes to learning, huh? You can’t have any excuses to skip your Danish vocabulary learning practice anymore! 
🕹 Effortless play: Drops’ essence is learning in a game-type setting that is addictive. Why? Because while you are playing you also get a truly immersive Danish language learning experience that is definitely a good investment of your valuable time since you get to build your Danish language knowledge. 
⚡Quick: Skip the painfully slow keyboard typing, and say hello to taps and rapid swipes! Every second counts during the quick Danish language learning session, and you’ll surely need that during the game. :) 
🎯 Vocabulary only: No grammar, only curated practical Danish words that you can use in everyday situations. This is our main focus and we are extremely good at it. 
💁Forge a habit: We want to make you an addict to Danish language learning with Drops. Effectiveness is irrelevant without an established habit, but with Drops, we help you build that habit too. 
We are proud of our Danish word pronunciations by our seasoned and professional Danish voice talents. 
Drops is everyone with more than 1700 Danish words in 99 topics (and we are continuously growing our list of words, by the way). Hardcore Danish language learners however, can easily opt-in to our premium plans to have unlimited learning time and progress faster. Plans starts at $2.99 monthly. 
🌍 Language knowledge is our goal here for people around the world, and we do it by providing a tool that uses the universal language that we all can speak: pictures! 
P.S. Be careful though, Drops can really get you addicted to learning the Danish language. :) 
________________________________________ 
😍 If you love Drops as much as we enjoyed building it, please leave us a review! :) Questions? Contact us at sup@languagedrops.com

bluejetty:00119267:ios.description:
JivoChat is an omnichannel business messenger built for teams to connect with their visitors wherever they are. With JivoChat, you’ll never miss a website conversion again: engage visitors via live chat, Facebook, voice services, email, and mobile. JivoChat’s omnichannel structure allows you to receive all your clients’ communications in one Agent App, keeping you organized. Website conversion rates get better too: proactive invitations hook your visitors so that you can provide the best customer service possible while gaining more and more leads. 
Interested? Here’s how to start increasing your online sales today:
1. Go to JivoChat website and sign up for an account
2. Install the JivoChat script code onto your website
3. Install the app and choose who will be online to chat with customers: just you or all your team members
4. Connect other communication channels that you’d like to use to talk to your customers through Jivo (Facebook, Viber, Telegram, mobile, etc.)
5. Get important information about your visitors in real-time (name, social profiles, their time on your site, the current page they’re on, etc.)
*NEW*
JivoChat is mobile! Check out some cool new mobile features:
• JivoChat registration
• Multi-agent chats: Users can now invite other colleagues to chat
• Common quick phrases
• File transfer capabilities
• Visitor monitoring
• Message archive
• Chat with colleagues
• Reminders
JivoChat helps more than 270k online businesses improve their client communication. 
A FREE Live Chat indeed, but not just that... 
A complete communication tool to turn your online business into a sales machine!
Go to JivoChat website and start converting your visitors into clients.

bluejetty:00085639:ios.description:

THE DEVIALET FAMILY, REUNITED.
One unique app for all your Devialet home products: Phantom I, Phantom II, Devialet Dione and Devialet Mania.
STRAIGHT TO SOUND.
Access to music has never been this quick and seamless. Install and set up your Devialet speaker in a few easy steps.
VOLUME YOU CAN HANDLE.

Bring another Phantom into play and create a stereo pair, on the fly. But only if you think you’re ready for immersion. Stereo pairs are only possible between products of the same power: a pair of Phantom I 103 dB for example.
FUTURE-PROOF.
Stay one step ahead with regular updates for all your Devialet speakers.

bluejetty:00161332:ios.summary:
Experience the Miracle of Life—From a Single Cell to Your Baby’s First Smile
Step into the incredible journey of motherhood with Pregnant Mom, Birth Simulator—a beautifully interactive, week-by-week pregnancy development game that brings t
bluejetty:00161332:ios.description:
Experience the Miracle of Life—From a Single Cell to Your Baby’s First Smile
Step into the incredible journey of motherhood with Pregnant Mom, Birth Simulator—a beautifully interactive, week-by-week pregnancy development game that brings the wonder of life to your screen. Whether you’re expecting, planning, or simply curious, this immersive experience offers a unique blend of education, emotion, and interactive fun.
• Follow Your Baby’s Growth, Week by Week
Watch your little one develop from the very first moment of conception to the joy of birth. With realistic 3D visuals, a dynamic baby growth tracker, and detailed animations of embryo and fetal development, Pregnant Mom, Birth Simulator lets you witness every heartbeat, every ultrasound peek, and every milestone throughout all 40 weeks of pregnancy.
• Your Personalized Pregnancy Journey
Navigate your trimesters with ease using our interactive prenatal care system. Log prenatal checkups, track nutrition, count contractions with our built-in timer, and stay on track with a due date countdown. From mini-games that prepare you for childbirth to engaging quizzes that test your pregnancy knowledge, every step feels personal, informative, and fun.
• Virtual Baby Bump & Mommy Avatar
Customize your journey with a growing baby bump simulator. Create your own “Mommy to Be” avatar and watch her transform week by week. Feel the first kicks, monitor baby’s movements, and celebrate progress as your pregnancy calendar advances.
• Learn Through Play
Explore the fascinating biology of pregnancy through intuitive gameplay. From fertilization to fetal development, dive deep into the science of life with easy-to-understand, engaging visuals. This educational pregnancy simulator is perfect for moms-to-be, partners, and anyone wanting to understand the miracle of birth in a fun, interactive way.
• Welcome Your Baby and Start Parenting
Once your baby arrives, the journey continues. Choose a name, dress your newborn in adorable outfits, decorate the nursery, and guide your baby through their first words and milestones. From diaper changes to feeding time, experience the early days of parenthood in a joyful, heartwarming way.
Enjoy free daily rewards, unlock booster packs, and enhance your gameplay with optional upgrades like ad-free experiences and refillable perks.
Download Pregnant Mom, Birth Simulator today and join millions on a life-changing adventure through pregnancy and beyond. With its powerful blend of baby growth tracking, prenatal care features, and realistic birth simulation, this game lets you connect to the miracle of motherhood—one beautiful week at a time.
Disclaimer:
This app is intended for educational and entertainment purposes only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the guidance of your doctor or other qualified health professional with any questions you may have regarding your pregnancy or a medical condition.

bluejetty:00021243:ios.description:
The Bible Multi-Version Comparison is a tool to assist in reading the Bible, allowing you to easily view different versions of the scriptures, compare the differences through comparison, and facilitate the study of the Bible. At the same time, the APP also provides three comparison methods to adapt to various reading scenarios.
## Compare function
Provide three comparison methods: one-to-one comparison, one-to-three comparison, menu-type comparison
One-to-one comparison: sentence-by-sentence comparison, which is convenient for comparison, and is also a commonly used comparison method
One-to-three comparison: You do not need to compare every verse, just swipe right on the verse you want to view to display three different versions of the comparison
Menu comparison: support up to 7 versions, click the menu bar to switch between different Bible versions
Up to now, more than 30 versions have been supported, and they are still being added, including: Chinese Union Version, New Chinese Version, King James Version (KJV), New International Version (NIV), AMP, Authoritative Standard Version (ASV), New American Standard Version (NASB), English Standard Edition, etc.
In addition: French, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Greek, Spanish, etc.
## It also has the following functions
- Favorites: Swipe left verses to favorite verses, or select verses and click the sharing method to favorite
- Search: Quickly find keywords, support book title chapter search, such as: Matt. 19:28; John 3:3,5,7;
- Table of Contents: Provides two styles to quickly locate scripture chapters
- Offline reading, text language
- Dictionary lookup
- iCloud data sync
- History record, each of your directory operations will be automatically recorded for your convenience
- Daily Verse Desktop Component
More functions are waiting for your discovery. . .

From th
bluejetty:00095774:ios.description:
Once Human: RaidZone is the first high-intensity, no-holds-barred PvP spin-off in Once Human. In this brutal survival jungle, only the echoes of gunfire, hidden traps of enemies, and the constant threat of losing everything remain.
From the moment you enter the world, the battle begins. Rely on your combat skills, team coordination, and the power of Deviations to survive in this ruthless land, strengthen yourself step by step, gather resources, and rise to dominance.
This is a world made for raiders.
Are you ready?
Survival Through Raiding — Where Only the Ruthless Survive
Step into the RaidZone, where chaos reigns and survival is everything. Every gun, resource, and piece of land must be seized from someone else. Death means losing everything. Want to stay alive? Keep fighting — and never trust too easily.
Start from Scratch — Survive with Your Own Hands
From bows and axes to tactical gadgets, from long-range rifles and sniper weapons. In the vast selection in RaidZone, customize your unique weapon and armor build to create a tailored combat experience. Utilize the terrain, tactics, and your understanding of combat to engage in exhilarating skirmishes.
Build Freely — Shape Your Fortress, Command the Battlefield
Establish bases anywhere on the map. Plan your defenses and traps as you see fit. Set traps, raise walls, build your impenetrable stronghold — or a nightmare for your enemies. Your territory is your safe haven and your tactical edge. Defend it. Expand it. Use it to strike back hard.
Fair Competitive Environment — No Inheritance, No Overpowering, Pure Skill
Everyone starts on equal footing. No external weapons, resources, or blueprints can be brought in. All gear, armor, and Deviations must be discovered and fought for within the scenario. Victory comes from skill, planning, and your ability to adapt—nothing else.
Power of Deviations — Turn the Tables with Tactical Abilities
Seize rare resources and unlock powerful Deviations to dominate the battlefield. Pyro Dino helps you with firepower and Zeno-Purifier lets you dash forward and cut down your enemies. You can even summon Manibus to precisely destroy target areas. Turn the tide with one decisive move — and crush your enemies.

bluejetty:00139718:ios.name: Prison Boss 3D: Idle Police
bluejetty:00139718:ios.summary: Take on the role of a policeman managing a prison. Can you handle the flow of criminals coming your way? Prepare to cater to all the needs of your clients – manage different facilities inside of your own reformation institution to maximize
bluejetty:00139718:ios.description:
Take on the role of a policeman managing a prison. Can you handle the flow of criminals coming your way? Prepare to cater to all the needs of your clients – manage different facilities inside of your own reformation institution to maximize profits. Control your guard character and do various chores around the prison. Navigate cells, buy new equipment and stations to earn money.
With enough money saved you can purchase new buildings to expand your territory and gain access to different areas! Unlock the kitchen, gym and mines! Manage your time, find the most efficient routes to get everything done! Don’t make your prisoners wait. Turn profit into upgrades for your warden. Move faster on a hoverboard and increase the amount of items you can stack. Become the ultimate boss of the prison by hiring employees to do the work for you.
Here’s all the ways you can earn money in your prison!
• Check inmates in and out of the building
• Upgrade cells and buy new beds for mafia men to stay!
• Bring the soap to the showers! Watch your step, you better not drop it!
• Pump the water – or build a machine to do it for you!
• Produce batteries by running on treadmills!
• Feed your cellmates and clean up after them
• Let them play ball & dance at the disco
• Build your own stone mines!
Get ready to explore the premises and get that cash!
FEATURES
• Simple arcade controls. Move your character around with one hand
• Cartoony 3D graphics! Watch funny inmates move around. Oh, the kawaii eyes!
• Earn money while offline! Progress the game to earn passive income!
• Get pets! A 3D companion to follow you around, from a dog to a capybara… and even a chicken!
• New locations to discover! Collect all the facilities and buildings!
• Hire help! Automate your business for an ultimate idle experience!
What are you waiting for? Download and play!

bluejetty:00174843:ios.description:
Dieting is hard enough. But when you work hard, hop on the scale, and see a number that’s higher than yesterday? Well, that’s just not fair!
It’s time to tame the scale!
Happy Scale helps you make sense of the frustrating ups and downs of weigh-ins by using mathematical analysis to make sense of your scale weights.
You’ll:
• understand your true trend,
• take the sting out of plateaus, and
• be able to predict what you’ll weigh for an upcoming event
• SEE YOUR TRUE PROGRESS: Happy Scale uses sophisticated math to learn the true trend of your progress. You can see what you’re really losing each week.
• NO MORE PLATEAUS: Use the moving average progress tracking options to see steady progress every day!
• SLOW AND STEADY WINS THE RACE: Have a lot to lose? Break your weight loss goal into small, incremental milestone goals so you can focus on short-term, achievable goals!
• THE PERFECT SUPPLEMENT: Use this app in conjunction with other popular apps. Weight entries can be automatically imported from apps that support exporting to the Apple Health app, and Happy Scale will export all your weights to Apple Health so other apps can see them.
• IMAGINE YOUR SUCCESS: See predictions about what you’ll weigh in the future if you keep up your current trends, and set commitment goals for yourself!
• KNOW YOUR NUMBERS: Our new BMI calculator shows you exactly where you stand and what weight ranges you need to hit for different health categories. No more guessing if you’re almost there!
• WORKS ON ALL YOUR DEVICES: Seamlessly sync between your iPhone and iPad!
So, have your previous diets failed because you lost motivation? Try Happy Scale today and join thousands of users who use this app to TAME THE SCALE!

This app optionally integrates with Apple Health. It is an opt-in feature that’s accessible from the Settings menu.
------------------

You can turn off auto-renewal at any time by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00114672:ios.name: Quran Unlock
bluejetty:00114672:ios.summary:
Quran Unlock blocks your distracting apps until you have read Quran. Join 300,000+ Muslims building better habits through faith.
Struggling to read Quran consistently? You are not alone. Social media, games, and endless scrolling steal our
bluejetty:00114672:ios.description:
Quran Unlock blocks your distracting apps until you have read Quran. Join 300,000+ Muslims building better habits through faith.
Struggling to read Quran consistently? You are not alone. Social media, games, and endless scrolling steal our time. Quran Unlock flips the script: your apps stay locked until you prioritize what truly matters.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose the apps that distract you most: Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, or whatever pulls you in.
2. Pick your prayer times: Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha.
3. After each prayer, your apps stay locked until you have read 5 minutes of Quran.
4. Read. Listen. Reflect. Your apps unlock automatically.
No willpower battles. No guilt loops. Just a gentle nudge that turns every prayer into a moment of remembrance.
INSIDE THE APP
Reels Mode: TikTok-style vertical verse feed with word-by-word recitation highlighting. Swipe through ayahs, listen to the Quran like never before.
Mushaf Reader: full 604-page canonical layout, tap any verse to hear it recited by Mishary, Husary, Alafasy and more.
Per-Prayer Goals: each prayer is its own commitment. Complete Fajr's 5 min and your apps unlock until Dhuhr starts. Then a fresh window opens with the same threshold and a new opportunity.
15 Languages: Arabic, English, French, Urdu, Indonesian, Turkish, Spanish, Malay, Farsi, Russian, Hindi, Bengali, Italian, Portuguese, German. Translation, transliteration, recitation: all in your language.
Streak Tracking: see your daily progress, unlock badges, build a habit that lasts.
Custom Rules: set your own challenges. Block Twitter until I finish Surah Al-Mulk. No social media until I read 10 ayahs of Al-Baqarah. Your goals, your rules.
Friday Al-Kahf: automatically armed every Friday.
Daily Azkar: morning and evening remembrances integrated into your routine.
WHY IT WORKS
We do not preach. We do not shame. We use the same psychology that makes social media addictive, but in reverse. By placing 5 minutes of Quran between you and Instagram, every reach for your phone becomes a chance for dhikr.
Whether you are starting your journey or rebuilding consistency after years away, Quran Unlock meets you where you are. Some users start with 1 prayer per day. Others lock all five. Your pace, your path.
PRIVACY FIRST
We use Apple's Screen Time framework to lock your apps locally on your device. We do not see what apps you use. We do not track your reading. Your spiritual journey is between you and Allah.
No ads. No data selling. Premium subscription unlocks unlimited blocked apps and custom rules, but the core habit-building experience is free forever.
OUR MISSION
We built Quran Unlock because we needed it ourselves. Every line of code is dua. Every feature is a small act of love for the Ummah.
300,000+ Muslims. 15 languages. One mission: bring the Quran back into our daily lives.
Finally an app that actually helps me read Quran daily.
Changed my relationship with my phone.
Best Islamic app I have ever used.
DOWNLOAD NOW
Start with Fajr tomorrow. InshaAllah, your future self will thank you.
May Allah accept it from us all. JazakAllahu khayran.

bluejetty:00128231:ios.description:
WHAT’S NEW:
• Full control over sessions 
To allow your partner to connect to your device, simply enter the code they provided into the ‘Join Session’ box. You control access to your device and end the session whenever you choose.
• Easy for your eyes and your battery 
You asked, we listened. QuickSupport now features dark mode for a more comfortable experience and better battery life.
• Rotate your screen with ease
Vertical or horizontal — the app adapts seamlessly to your preferred orientation.
• Get onboard quickly
Discover all the new UI features with our guided tour, making it easy to get started. 
• Improved transparency
Connect only with users you trust. The app will provide you with user details, such as name, email, country, and license type, so you can verify the identity before granting access to your device.
The QuickSupport app by TeamViewer allows you to get instant IT support for your iPhone or iPad. 
In just a few easy steps, QuickSupport enables your trusted remote partner to connect to your device to: 
• provide IT support
• transfer files back and forth
• communicate with you via chat 
• view device information
• adjust WIFI settings, and much more. 
It can receive connection requests from any device (desktop, web browser or mobile). 
TeamViewer applies the highest security standards to your connections, ensuring you are always in control of granting access to your device and establishing or ending sessions.
To establish a connection to your device, you need to do the following: 
1. Open the app on your screen. Connections can't be established if the app is running in the background.
2. Share your ID with your partner or enter a code into the ‘Join Session’ box.
3. Accept the connection request every time. Without your explicit permission, the connection can’t be established.
QuickSupport is available to install on any device and model, including Samsung, Nokia, Sony, Huawei, Lenovo, Honeywell, Zebra, Elo, MobileBase, Fujitsu, Philips, Hisense, Doro, TCL and many more. 
Key features include: 
• Trusted connections (user account verification)
• Session codes for fast connections
• Dark mode
• Screen rotation
• Remote control
• Chat
• View device information
• File transfer
• App list (Start/Uninstall apps)
• Push and pull Wi-Fi settings
• View system diagnostic information
• Real-time screenshot of the device 
• Store confidential information into the device clipboard
• Secured connection with 256 Bit AES Session Encoding.
Quick startup guide: 
1. Your session partner will send you a personal link to the QuickSupport application. Clicking the link will start the app download. 
2. Open the QuickSupport app on your device. 
3. You will see a prompt to join a session created by your remote partner. 
4. When you accept the connection, the remote session will begin.
"Information on Optional Access*
● Microphone: Fill the video feed with audio, or used to record message or session
*You can use the app even if you do not allow the optional permissions. Please use in-app settings to disable the access."

Download Shanghai Mahjongg Tile today and enjoy the perfect blend of challenge and serenity.

bluejetty:00030378:ios.summary:
SINGA KARAOKE APP – MORE SONGS, BETTER QUALITY
Singa takes your karaoke to the next level. If you've ever wanted to sing along to your favorite songs exactly like they were recorded by the artists, Singa is the karaoke app for you. With Si
bluejetty:00030378:ios.description:
SINGA KARAOKE APP – MORE SONGS, BETTER QUALITY
Singa takes your karaoke to the next level. If you've ever wanted to sing along to your favorite songs exactly like they were recorded by the artists, Singa is the karaoke app for you. With Singa, you gain access to a huge library of high-quality karaoke songs, featuring an always growing selection of artist original recordings. Try singing along to them – you'll recognise original recordings from the purple seal.
You can sing solo, make it a party with friends or find the nearest Singa-powered karaoke venue and hit the stage. Give it a spin for free, and sing without limits with Singa Premium – free 30 day trial included!
NEW: SING ON THE BIG SCREEN WITH AIRPLAY
Connect to your device to a smart TV with AirPlay, navigate the song library with your device and enjoy the crisp and clear singing experience.
FEATURES
- Big screen karaoke: Connect your device to a TV with Airplay or use the Singa Apple TV app to take your karaoke to the next level at home.
- Full karaoke song catalogue available to all users: Frequently updated library of high-quality karaoke songs from timeless classics to the latest hits. New tracks are added daily.
- Original recordings: Studio-quality tracks direct from the original artists, making the Singa karaoke experience unmatched. You’ll recognise the artist originals by the purple Original tag in the app.
- Hundreds of themed singlists curated by Singa karaoke professionals: Find the right songs for special occasions, get inspired by moods, sing through the essential tracks from legendary artists and tear it up along to period classics ranging from 1960s to the most recent releases.
- High-definition background videos: Crisp backgrounds and karaoke lyrics on screens of any size.
- Transposition: Adjust the song’s pitch to suit your vocal range.
- Guide vocals: Sing along with your favourite artists or sing your way through an unfamiliar song.
- My Library: Save your favourite songs and singlists into your library for faster and easier access; or make your own custom singlists.
- Singa-powered karaoke venues: Find the nearest karaoke venue using the Singa mobile app, request a song, and hit the stage.
Singa karaoke app takes you from boredom to karaoke stardom. Whether you’re a pro or just starting out your karaoke journey, you’ll feel at home with Singa.
You can visit our website at https://singa.com/.
Follow us on Facebook @singamusic
Follow us on Instagram @singakaraoke
SINGA PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION – FREE 30 DAY TRIAL INCLUDED
Singa Premium is an auto-renewable monthly or yearly subscription that lets you sing karaoke as much as your heart desires. Free 30 day trial is available to new subscribers only. The free trial will auto-renew into a paying subscription at the end of the trial period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the trial period ends. Payments will be charged to your iTunes Account. You can cancel a subscription anytime by turning off the auto-renewal through your Apple ID account settings. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of a subscription period to avoid being charged.
For complete terms and conditions, please visit https://singa.com/terms-of-use.
For privacy statement, please visit https://singa.com/privacy-policy.

bluejetty:00161907:ios.summary:

KidneyDiet helps people with kidney disease make better choices. Watching your nutrient intake and educating yourself about your nutrition needs changes during the cours
bluejetty:00161907:ios.description:
KidneyDiet® helps you watch the 3Ps. 
Phosphorus. Potassium. Protein.
KidneyDiet helps people with kidney disease make better choices. Watching your nutrient intake and educating yourself about your nutrition needs changes during the course of kidney disease. Whether you are on dialysis or not, you must become aware of the following in your diet:
PHOSPHORUS
POTASSIUM
PROTEIN
SODIUM
FLUIDS
KidneyDiet makes it easy to personalize your Daily Diary Guidelines and compare your nutritional intake against your doctor's recommendations.
- KidneyDiet provides an extensive, comprehensive research-quality food and nutrient database.
- Charts and tables provide clarity on your nutrition.
- Nutrient tracking is comprehensive and shows insight into your intake of carbohydrates, glycemic index, glycemic load, fat, cholesterol, vitamins and minerals in the foods you eat.
- Personalized guidelines tailor the app to meet your specific needs.
- Keep a list of favorite foods.
- Email your Daily Diary to yourself or your healthcare provider.
** Free 2-week trial! **
During the trial period all features are available. After the trial period, you will still have access to the "learning" section of the app which provides educational information about nutrients and you will still be able to search for foods, accessing an extensive database. Upon subscribing, you will once again have access to all features, unlocking your diary, favorites, charts, and customizing your nutrient guidelines.
You will not be inconvenienced by advertising interrupting your app usage, ever.
Eat right. Enjoy life.
