bluejetty:00137878:ios.summary: Experience unparalleled weather guidance with the 1DegreeOutside Weather Network App, your direct link to New England's renowned meteorologists, Matt and Danielle Noyes and their team. Known for their accurate forecasts, engaging delivery
bluejetty:00137878:ios.description:
Experience unparalleled weather guidance with the 1DegreeOutside Weather Network App, your direct link to New England's renowned meteorologists, Matt and Danielle Noyes and their team. Known for their accurate forecasts, engaging delivery and decades of recognition on New England television, Matt and Danielle's expertise for New England and beyond is now yours, 24/7, on your mobile device. The forecast data in this version of our app is hand-picked by Matt and Danielle, but the 1DegreeOutside team is working on their own detailed, high-quality, proprietary data for release in the coming months!
The 1DegreeOutside Weather Network App includes:
* Exclusive forecasts and personalized weather insight from Matt & Danielle
* Live Stream video analysis when available
* Opt-in for direct alerts from Matt and Danielle
* An updated feed of 1DegreeOutside blog posts and updates
* An interactive community to share videos, photos & reports with Matt & Danielle
* A personalized experience with favorite locations and fully integrated GPS
* Weather awareness with current conditions, weather imagery and severe weather alerts from the U.S. government
* Customized weather tools including the most detailed radar available, data overlays and predicted radar to 24 hours
* Hourly forecasts for precise detail and a 14-day outlook for an idea of upcoming weather trends

bluejetty:00159357:ios.summary:
Make a breakthrough in your wellness journey.

bluejetty:00159357:ios.description:
Make a breakthrough in your wellness journey.
In today's fast-paced world, stress, anxiety, and other mental health conditions have become common challenges for many. To ease the tension and bring back balance, Sensa offers complete support while you work on your mental health goals. 
Experience the complete support of Sensa as you embark on your mental health journey. 
Explore a range of plans based on your needs, discover techniques and tools based on cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), understand yourself better, and use science-backed methods to get better on your own terms.
Meet your pocket-sized mental health assistant:
Self-paced lessons
What is troubling you the most? Pick a long-term plan with daily lessons that will help you learn about your emotions, thinking patterns, and how they affect your behavior. Learn about yourself and untangle negative thinking patterns through exercises recommended by our mental health professionals.
Mood journal
Shed light on the complexity of your emotions by tracking your mood, exploring your emotional well-being, and journaling about your experiences. Daily mood tracking will help you notice emotional triggers and behavioral patterns, and you’ll begin to feel more in control of your feelings.
Habit-building strategies
Bring your physical, emotional, and mental health to another level by creating consistent routines and lasting habits – create schedules, set reminders, and make your mental health app work for you.
Weekly assessments
Get data about your well-being directly in your mental health app with the DASS-21 assessment. Measure your feelings of anxiety, stress, and depression every week, see your progress, and set new mental health goals.
Quick-relief exercises
While building long-term strategies for coping, take advantage of quick stress relief in moments of need. Engage in guided deep breathing and grounding exercises, and find your inner peace in moments of need.
Sensa is a subscription-based app that offers several subscription options, starting from $30.99.
The subscription automatically renews unless canceled 48 hours before renewal. The subscription can be canceled by logging in to your personal account in the app, going to the subscription management page, logging into the Sensa subscription management page through the website, or contacting the customer support team via hello@sensa.health. If the subscription is purchased through the App Store, it can be canceled only through your Apple account. Deleting the application does not automatically cancel the subscription.
Disclaimer: Results may vary due to individual differences. In addition, mental self-help apps like Sensa are not a replacement for or a form of therapy, nor are they intended to cure, treat, or diagnose medical conditions, including psychiatric conditions. Please consult a qualified healthcare provider for a medical treatment plan.

bluejetty:00120283:ios.developer: Singing Lessons & Vocal Training Academy Learn Singing with Pro Vocal Coaches & Voice Trainers
bluejetty:00120283:ios.summary: Sing Sharp is your personal vocal coach — singing lessons, vocal training and a complete voice studio in one singing app. Learn to sing with real-time feedback, take the vocal range test, build perfect pitch with ear training, and unlock th
bluejetty:00120283:ios.description:
Sing Sharp is your personal vocal coach — singing lessons, vocal training and a complete voice studio in one singing app. Learn to sing with real-time feedback, take the vocal range test, build perfect pitch with ear training, and unlock the voice you have always wanted.
From singing lessons for beginners to advanced technique for experienced singers, every exercise adapts to your voice, your range and your goals.
REAL-TIME FEEDBACK ON EVERY NOTE
Sing Sharp listens while you sing, powered by advanced AI audio analysis. The built-in pitch detector analyzes your voice in real time, shows every note you hit or miss, and doubles as a precise voice tuner — check your pitch any time, on any note. Ever wonder whether you are singing in chest voice or head voice? Watch your vocal resonance visualized inside your body as you sing.
PERSONALIZED SINGING LESSONS
These are voice lessons that listen. No static, pre-recorded drills: Sing Sharp generates music dynamically — like a singing teacher playing the piano just for you — and keeps every vocal exercise inside your safe range, so you improve without straining your voice.
VOCAL RANGE TEST
Start with a quick voice test to find your true vocal range in minutes. See your lowest and highest notes, and watch your range grow as your vocal training progresses.
VOCAL WARM UP & DAILY VOCAL EXERCISES
Six focused programs full of vocal exercises for singers at every level:
• Daily Workout — build a strong vocal foundation with daily singing exercises
• Recovery Warmup — protect vocal health with gentle vocal fry exercises that improve vocal cord closure, release tension and prevent strain
• Sing High Notes — build on vocal fry and relaxation technique to expand your vocal range and explore every quality of your high notes, from light falsetto to powerful belting, without voice cracks
• Mix Mastery — blend chest voice and head voice into one smooth mixed voice
• Vibrato Pro — coordinate vocal cords and diaphragm to unlock a natural, beautiful vibrato
• Harmony & Trio — learn to sing vocal harmony, from simple thirds to multi-part arrangements, and train solfege through major and minor scales
PERFECT PITCH & EAR TRAINING
Think you are tone deaf? Almost nobody is — most voices are just untrained. Start with a simple tone deaf test, then build your musical ear and a real sense of solfege with daily pitch training and ear training exercises: recognize notes, match pitch and sing in tune, every time. From your first do re mi to a working feel for music theory, your ear grows as your voice does.
INTERACTIVE LESSONS WITH VIDEO DEMONSTRATIONS
Learn how to sing better, step by step, with video lessons from professional vocal coaches, built on a proven vocal coaching method — vocal warm ups, breathing exercises for singing, breath support and the technique behind falsetto, high notes and more.
RECORD YOUR PROGRESS & TAKE ON CHALLENGES
Record audio and video of your performance for a complete assessment, unlock achievements, and share your best takes with friends or the global vocalist community. Detailed progress tracking keeps your singing practice consistent and shows your voice training pay off, day by day.
You know that one song — the one you sing with everything you've got when nobody else is around, the one that makes you feel, just for a moment, like a true singer. Now imagine singing it in front of people: not perfectly, but beautifully, confidently, proud of your own voice. That moment is not about talent. It is about training.
Preparing for an audition, choir practice or karaoke night? Ready to become a singer at last? No schedules, no expensive in-person vocal lessons or singing classes — your vocal coach lives in your pocket. Download Sing Sharp, start your vocal training today, and give that one song the voice it deserves.
Terms of Use: https://www.singsharp.com/terms-of-service

TWO POWERFUL MODES
bluejetty:00062833:ios.description:
RETRAIN THE BRAIN to move the eyes correctly by scanning from left to right across the screen. Strengthening this essential skill can improve reading, concentration, memory, attention to detail, and speed of processing. 
TWO POWERFUL MODES help brain injury and stroke survivors with left neglect improve at home while also helping occupational therapy (OT) and speech therapy (SLP) professionals to efficiently assess for right or left neglect and provide more effective treatment.
* Use the Test mode to determine if and where a visual attention deficit exists.
* Use the Practice mode to train scanning by finding targets in order.
++ SEE HOW IT CAN HELP – Download Visual Attention Therapy Lite for FREE! ++
-----------
CANCELLATION TASKS JUST GOT BETTER. This professional cognitive training app takes a familiar format for treating left neglect and transforms it into a dynamic, interactive tool for all ages. Visual Attention Therapy offers benefits that can only be achieved through technology: 
* Targets must be tapped from left to right, top to bottom in Practice mode, which trains users to slow down and scan the entire screen before they move on.
* Immediate feedback with visual and auditory cues keeps users engaged.
* Timed exercises increase motivation to work quickly and accurately.
* Stop wasting time counting errors! Automated scoring includes data for accuracy by quadrant, time for completion, and mistakes in professional e-mailed reports.
* Adjustable layouts and 10 levels of difficulty allow you to customize the experience to meet changing needs or multiple users.
* Sidebar signal can flash in a variety of colors to draw attention to the left or right.
* An endless variety of combinations eliminates the need to photocopy exercises, with the option to print screenshots when you need a traditional exercise.
* Use only one target to focus on scanning, or use two targets at once to challenge users with working memory and alternating attention deficits. 
-----------
RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK to improve scores while improving cognitive and reading skills. Levels featuring letters can support literacy goals, while symbol-based levels challenge visual memory skills. It’s an occupational therapy dream come true!
Visual Attention Therapy was developed by a certified Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) and is used worldwide in speech and occupational therapy (OT) to help adults with left neglect after stroke and brain injury. It is also used with children with dyslexia and attentional deficits by reading specialists and neuropsychologists.
DON’T JUST TELL YOUR PATIENTS TO LOOK TO THE LEFT – TRAIN THEM. Modernize your occupational therapy or speech therapy exercises with a left neglect training tool that improves stroke and brain injury rehab. 
DOWNLOAD IT NOW!
-----------

listings.name: Visual Attention Therapy
listings.description:
RETRAIN THE BRAIN to move the eyes correctly by scanning from left to right across the screen. Strengthening this essential skill can improve reading, concentration, memory, attention to detail, and speed of processing. 

TWO POWERFUL MODES help brain injury and stroke survivors with left neglect improve at home while also helping occupational therapy (OT) and speech therapy (SLP) professionals to efficiently assess for right or left neglect and provide more effective treatment.

* Use the Test mode to determine if and where a visual attention deficit exists.
* Use the Practice mode to train scanning by finding targets in order.

++ SEE HOW IT CAN HELP – Download Visual Attention Therapy Lite for FREE! ++

-----------

CANCELLATION TASKS JUST GOT BETTER. This professional cognitive training app takes a familiar format for treating left neglect and transforms it into a dynamic, interactive tool for all ages. Visual Attention Therapy offers benefits that can only be achieved through technology: 

* Targets must be tapped from left to right, top to bottom in Practice mode, which trains users to slow down and scan the entire screen before they move on.
* Immediate feedback with visual and auditory cues keeps users engaged.
* Timed exercises increase motivation to work quickly and accurately.
* Stop wasting time counting errors! Automated scoring includes data for accuracy by quadrant, time for completion, and mistakes in professional e-mailed reports.
* Adjustable layouts and 10 levels of difficulty allow you to customize the experience to meet changing needs or multiple users.
* Sidebar signal can flash in a variety of colors to draw attention to the left or right.
* An endless variety of combinations eliminates the need to photocopy exercises, with the option to print screenshots when you need a traditional exercise.
* Use only one target to focus on scanning, or use two targets at once to challenge users with working memory and alternating attention deficits. 

-----------

RACE AGAINST THE CLOCK to improve scores while improving cognitive and reading skills. Levels featuring letters can support literacy goals, while symbol-based levels challenge visual memory skills. It’s an occupational therapy dream come true!

Visual Attention Therapy was developed by a certified Speech-Language Pathologist (SLP) and is used worldwide in speech and occupational therapy (OT) to help adults with left neglect after stroke and brain injury. It is also used with children with dyslexia and attentional deficits by reading specialists and neuropsychologists.

DON’T JUST TELL YOUR PATIENTS TO LOOK TO THE LEFT – TRAIN THEM. Modernize your occupational therapy or speech therapy exercises with a left neglect training tool that improves stroke and brain injury rehab. 

DOWNLOAD IT NOW!

-----------

Looking for something different in a stroke therapy app? Tactus Therapy offers a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at https://tactustherapy.com/find

When you tap a magnet link, iOS redirects you to this app, where you can easily copy the link to your clipboard. From there, you can share it or use it with your preferred tools and services—no hassle, no workarounds.
Whether you're organizing files or sharing links, Magnet Linker makes managing magnet:// links on your iPhone or iPad fast and simple.
Note: Magnet Linker is a utility for copying and sharing magnet links only. It does not download or manage torrent files.

Whether you're organizing files or sharing links, Magnet Linker makes managing magnet:// links on your iPhone or iPad fast and simple.

Note: Magnet Linker is a utility for copying and sharing magnet links only. It does not download or manage torrent files.

bluejetty:00023746:ios.description:
Activity Plus helps you track your activity rings, protect your Move streak, review workouts, compare progress, and stay motivated every day.
Follow your Move, Exercise, and Stand goals, recover missed ring days, customize widgets, unlock awards, and see your activity history across iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch.

- Siri: Ask Siri to check your activity rings, daily metrics, and nutrition, compare weeks, or open your latest workout.
- Energy & Nutrition: Compare calories consumed and burned, and view protein, fat, and carbs from Apple Health.

- Activity Rings: Track your Move, Exercise, and Stand progress throughout the day.
- Home Screen Widgets: Keep rings, steps, distance, workouts, energy, and nutrition in view on your Home Screen.
- Awards & Monthly Challenges: Stay motivated with goals, badges, and achievements.

- Workout Insights: Search your workouts and review routes, pace, distance, energy, and monthly results.
- Global Challenges: Compete with friends and users around the world.
- Global Leaderboard: Compare Move, Steps, Distance, and Exercise results.
- Goal Notifications: Get notified when you reach your daily goals.
- Share Your Progress: Share activity rings and workout stats with photos or videos.
- Custom Goals: Set personal goals for Move, Exercise, Stand, Distance, Steps, and Floors.
- Light & Dark Mode: Choose the look that works best for you.
- Custom App Icons: Personalize Activity Plus with your favorite icon.
Apple Watch Features:
- Use Activity Plus directly on Apple Watch.
- Review activity from previous days.
- Add activity details to your watch face with complications.
- Join the global leaderboard without adding contacts.
Privacy:
Activity Plus requests access to your Health data, including Activity, Steps, Distance, and Workouts, to show your stats, progress, widgets, goals, and workout history. Nutrition and energy data from Apple Health are also used to display your nutrition and calorie summaries.

bluejetty:00182850:ios.description:
Ever wanted to run a cult? Summon legendary demon gods? Control hordes of unwashed monsters? Craft a tower so tall it defies all laws of physics? Or… destroy the world?
No? Well, why not give it a try anyway?
Idle Apocalypse is the best cult, clicker apocalypse simulator of 2018! Craft your tower and build it high into the sky and deep underground. Tap to create hordes of goblins, demons and beasts to do your bidding. Cast spells on any brave heroes foolish enough to get in your way. Summon the legendary Idols – a feared group of gods – and bring about the End Times in this novel idle tapper game.
Idle Apocalypse is a game about resource management, strategy and evil!
- Features -
Craft Your Tower
- Collect materials to unlock over 40 new rooms!
- Unlock research stations to discover technologies.
- Tap generators to accelerate progress!
- Build mines, juicers, kitchens and factories.
Create Monsters
- Craft over 20 unique monsters to do your bidding.
- Evolve, upgrade and improve them.
- Collect goblins, beasts and demons.
Incremental Action
- Play as much or as little as you like!
- Your monsters keep fighting even while you’re offline!
- Resource management gameplay. Watch as your tower evolves with just a few taps!
Endless Idle Game
- Summon Idols to bring about the Apocalypse!
- Prestige to unlock valuable chants and grow your tower higher.
- Evolve and craft your tower on multiple play-throughs, unlocking new mechanics!
Lovers of simulation games and incremental clickers won’t be able to put down this idle monster breeding RPG. And if you do you’ll pick up again a few hours later, because it’s an idle game and there’s loot to collect!

bluejetty:00060880:ios.summary: Ava uses captions to live transcribe voice to text to provide accessibility for people who are Deaf or hard of hearing (HoH). Ava's speech-to-text app provides 24/7 real-time audio transcription with about 5 errors in 100 words based on AI,
bluejetty:00060880:ios.description:
Ava uses captions to live transcribe voice to text to provide accessibility for people who are Deaf or hard of hearing (HoH). Ava's speech-to-text app provides 24/7 real-time audio transcription with about 5 errors in 100 words based on AI, and the highest possible accuracy with Ava Scribe at about 1 error in 100 words. 
Use Ava to transcribe or live caption voice to text for classrooms, business meetings, doctor’s appointments, shopping, events, and more. Ava's speech-to-text app makes transcribing any live communication easy for friends, family, and organizations to be inclusive, accessible and ADA compliant!
How Ava live captions work:
• Download Ava on your phone to instantly transcribe voice to text from up to a meter away. Teach Ava to improve and learn your vocabulary as it transcribes voice to text by tapping on words to correct them or adding your own custom vocabulary.
• To use voice to text in group conversations, invite users to download the Ava app with a QR code or link so they can connect with you instantly. Ava shows a real-time color-coded transcript of who says what. 
• Need accessibility for people who are HoH or Deaf in more complex situations? Use the ‘Discover’ menu to learn how to set up Ava to live transcribe voice to text in any situation! 
Why Ava is the best speech to text app:
• Ava uses your smartphone’s mic to transcribe voice to text so you have live captions, in your pocket – it's always available, anytime, anywhere. 
• Communicating with hearing people is faster than ever with Ava's text-to-speech technology! Simply type what you want to say, and have Ava read out loud for you
• Never miss out on podcasts, live videos, live conversations, and more with Ava's dictation!
• Use Ava in the workplace or in the classroom to live transcribe voice to text for voice memos, conference calls, lectures, business meetings, and more!
• Use this Ava mobile app along with Ava CC, our companion computer app. It's perfect for online meetings or hybrid classes using any videoconferencing service including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet. 
Questions? Suggestions? Speak to our trusty customer support team through email at help@ava.me! 
Ava Free plan (for occasional users):
• Live caption any conversation with unlimited basic captions per month and up to 40-minute-long sessions.

bluejetty:00027143:ios.summary:
BURNOUT MASTERS is the official game of the world famous extreme motorsport series. 
The Burnout Masters competition game features more than 40 real life competitor cars plus over 100 stock cars you can build and customise to create the ult
bluejetty:00027143:ios.description:
BURNOUT MASTERS is the official game of the world famous extreme motorsport series. 
The Burnout Masters competition game features more than 40 real life competitor cars plus over 100 stock cars you can build and customise to create the ultimate burnout machine!
Skid your own car, or legendary Burnout Masters rides, at internationally renowned events including the iconic Summernats. Shred tread on burnout pads at all major Burnout Masters series events such as Red Centre NATS, BRASHERNATS at Western Sydney International Dragway, Tropical Meltdown at Springmount Raceway, the Capricorn Coast’s RockyNATS, Motorvation at Perth Motorplex, Darwin’s top end GAZZANATS, Rapanats in New Zealand, POWERCRUISE plus the DDE Block!
Build your car, and bring it on with BURNOUT MASTERS!
The Burnout Masters game features:
- Insane multiplayer with up to 10 cars skidding together!
- Cruise the biggest burnout event in the world - Summernats! 
- Intense burnout physics with realistic smoke, engine explosions and popping tyres!
- Built not bought. Install engine upgrades, customisations and even engine swaps to create the ultimate burnout car.
- Custom tune your engine and manage temps as you push your car to the limit!
- Build your favourite engine in detail, choose from 4cylinder, v6, v8 or even rotary engines!
- 25+ detailed burnout pads to tear up and explore including official real life events, a free roam city to explore and even lockdown skids in your driveway!
- 70+ different cars to build and drive!
- Leaderboards to compete with friends and the community!
Real life events at real locations!
- Bathurst AUTOFEST!
- POWERCRUISE raceway and Burnout Pad!
- The DDE Block!
- Summernats 34! Summernats is back and we’ve built the entire arena!
- Summernats 33! The biggest burnout competition in the world!
- GAZZANATS in the Northern Territory! 
- Red CentreNATS! Head over to Alice Springs and tear up the RCN event!
- Burnout Masters at Western Sydney International Dragway!
- Tropical Meltdown at the Springmount Raceway in Cairns!
- Motorvation at Perth Motorplex! 
- RockyNATS in Rockhampton! 
- Rappants in New Zealand!
- LOO5ENATS!
Real life competitor cars!
Burnanza winner GAMBLE
FULLONX - Fuller is back with FULLONX!
ONGROG - Insane burnout ute!
KEEP IT REET join the party!
1320, ATRISK, BLOUP, BLO202, BLWNLUX, LUXIFER, TUBSHP
AGROXA, UCSMOKE, ULEGAL, LYNCHY, CEMBLO, S1CKO, GM176
FULLON, UNWANTED, IBLOWN, EVILXA, LSONE, FILTHV, CLIKB8, HAMMERTIME
FRONTBACK, PROPSI, HOLDON, NUTOUT, LOOSEQ, ZEPHYR, USA502, LOO5E
SKIDMA, EVIL69, DSPRING, ZEROY, Adam LZ’s Barra Turbo build!
Plus many more to come.
Join our community:
FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/BurnoutMastersGame
INSTAGRAM: @burnoutmastersgame
Web: https://www.burnoutmastersgame.com/

bluejetty:00078854:ios.description:
The Summary App allows you to turn any long text or website into a short and simple summary. It lets you break down lengthy documents or web content into easily digestible summaries. Ideal for getting the main points without wading through a sea of words. With our accessible and user-friendly AI-powered tool, you'll turn 'tl;dr' (Too Long; Didn't Read) into 'brief but got it' in no time.
Life's fast-paced. Why spend time skimming excessive text when you can get a snapshot view? With The Summary App, you don't have to. Paste in your text or link, and a get a neat summary. It's great for everything from long-form news articles to detailed research papers.
And guess what? The app is not constrained by language. Choose from multiple languages to summarize your text. The app also lets you pick your summary style. Broken down bullet points? Check. Digestible dialogue? Yep, we got that too. Simple, straightforward paragraphs? Of course. Customize your summary the way you like it.
Key features of The Summary App:
* Powerful Text Summarizer: From elaborate articles to lengthy reports, transform any content into concise summaries.
* Efficient TL;DR Extracts: Get the essence of comprehensive texts in bite-sized 'tl;dr' summaries.
* Versatile Source Inputs: Summarize information directly from a URL or textual content.
* Multilingual Support: Access summaries in multiple languages, bridging the gap in your multilingual text comprehension needs.
* Variety of Summary Styles: Choose your preferred summary style - traditional, list format, dialogue style - you name it!
In short, The Summary App reshapes your reading experience by providing apt, easy-to-understand summaries. It's more than just a text summarizer. It's a time saver, a bridge to foreign content, and your personalized information tool.
Download The Summary App today and pave your way to easier, quicker information absorption!

bluejetty:00147402:ios.description:
Easy bullion trading with instant access to vaulted gold, silver, and platinum, built by industry leaders in APMEX and Sprott.
◾ Trade bullion 24/7 through the OneGold mobile app
◾ Buy Gold and Silver, and platinum at fraction of retail premiums
◾ Live Gold and Silver prices
◾ Interactive charts, real-time alerts, daily news, and more!
Investing in gold and silver has never been easier, or more secure. If you’re looking for an all-encompassing precious metals investing platform built by industry leaders, you’ve come to the right place. Our precious metals investing app allows you to buy Gold, buy Silver bullion, or buy Platinum, in your choice of top-tier vaults around the globe. With a free download, you can access Silver and Gold prices live, 24/7 trading, and unique investment tools such as AutoInvest, custom market alerts, and more! Capitalize on gold price movements or sell silver in a matter of seconds with the OneGold mobile app. To be clear, this is not a gold stock, or a digital gold investing app. The OneGold app is offering real vaulted precious metals that are secured, audited and insured.
Features of the OneGold App:
As a one-stop resource for your Precious Metal prices and investing needs, our mobile app offers instant access to vaulted bullion around the world, daily market news, live Precious Metals prices, portfolio tracking, market alerts, AutoInvest, and more. Get alerts when the Silver or Gold price hits your buy or sell targets to lock in gains.
OneGold Advantages
Track Live Gold and Silver Prices:
See the Gold price live as it changes throughout the day. Set alerts to be ready when Gold and Silver prices rise or fall. With Precious Metal prices constantly updating during market hours, the OneGold mobile app provides a great place to view live Gold and Silver prices on the go. Get your Gold news update on the same screen as the online Gold price page. OneGold is the most convenient app for tracking Precious Metal prices.
Security:
OneGold customers' Precious Metals holdings are stored at their choice of top-tier global vaults with companies such as Loomis, Brinks, RCM, CNT, and APMEX. All Gold, Silver, and Platinum products are fully insured by the Lloyd’s of London and undergo regular third-party audits.
Seamless Trading:
OneGold customers can take a bullion position in minutes. You can trade, buy or sell, 24/7, even when markets are closed. We offer the ability to link your checking account, so you can lock in when you want, without pre-funding the account. Funds can be withdrawn easily, free of charge. We make investing in Precious Metals easy.
AutoInvest:
OneGold customers can dollar-cost into a position, or easily build a bullion-backed savings account by using our unique AutoInvest feature. This auto invest feature allows you to tailor an automated trade for a number of Gold or Silver ounces or a fixed dollar amount at intervals you choose.
Physical Redemption:
OneGold customers can sell bullion or convert to a physical delivery in Gold, Silver, and Platinum. OneGold customers can redeem for any Gold, Silver, or Platinum product that APMEX offers, and the order will be shipped within 1-2 business days.
Ultra-Competitive Premiums:
With industry leaders as partners and relationships around the globe, OneGold provides customers access to trade at what was once only an option for institutional investors. OneGold customers can trade, buy and sell bullion products at a lower cost compared to traditional retail products. Buying Gold and Silver has never been more affordable.
IRA Eligible:
Our bullion products are ideal for Precious Metals IRAs. Given the low cost of ownership and ease of use, OneGold is a streamlined solution for a retirement account or Precious Metals portfolio. OneGold has many custodial options for those wishing to fund a new account or rollover an existing IRA. Start your Gold and Silver retirement account today!

bluejetty:00134963:ios.description:
War Tanks is probably the best free army tank games that you can imagine! 
This is a truly exciting and dynamic modern war game for free, where you can take part in exciting and fast tank battles.
Millions of players from all over the world participate in a large military battle, controlling various types of battle tanks and other combat vehicles. Everyone can take part in tactical battles on different huge maps!
Truly exciting tactical battles and a realistic arena for online battles are always with you! Tank games is a free multiplayer (MMO) wars game multiplayer that combines two types of amazing gameplay: on one side, it is a realistic tank simulator, and on the other, it is an addictive arcade war game action.
Just imagine that you always have a realistic online military game action in your pocket, in which you can control heavy combat vehicles and any of their modifications available right now! So what are you waiting for? Join dynamic tank battles with modern graphics and endless action for free!
 VARIETY AND VARIABILITY 
Depending on the conditions and characteristics of each particular battle, you can choose which technique is more suitable:
- fast and maneuverable light machines
- universal war tanks the middle weight category
- powerful and crushing heavy battle tanks company
Choose any machine from dozens of available vehicles and take part in PvP battles!
 CONTINUOUS DEVELOPMENT AND PROGRESS 
Upgrade your machines - change all sorts of guns and cannons, install additional equipment on your combat vehicles to crush your opponents on the battlefield. Explore new modifications and 
War Tanks progressing in the development of technology from light entry-level vehicles to crushing and heavy machines of the max level.
 ONLINE BATTLE AND MULTIPLAYER SHOOTER 
Play online in multiplayer mode, unlock new mobile combat vehicles and upgrades, explore the landscape and terrain features in a variety of realistic fun arenas and enjoy stunning graphics.
Playing online, you will find yourself in completely different locations:
- WWII coasts
- snowy winter plains
- endless hot deserts
- huge cities and quiet villages
- river valleys, mountain passes and many, many others.
 PERFORMANCE AND OPTIMIZATION 
Tank game action supports most modern phones and gaming devices. The Shooting game of war is automatically optimized for each model so that you can enjoy the match in the best quality - with cool effects and maximum detail. With manual settings, you can find a balance between picture quality and high FPS.
We are constantly working to improve our matches and fun gameplay. Therefore, in addition to optimization in our War Tanks , there is constantly updated content, including vehicles, new maps and missions, temporary events and much more

bluejetty:00088182:ios.description:
Get mobile access to your Brilliant Control(s) by downloading and pairing the Brilliant App. 
The Brilliant Control replaces an existing light switch to give you touch and voice control over all of your smart home products. From lights, music, climate, security, and doorbells to whatever comes next, Brilliant connects everyone in the home with controls that are easy to access and use.
With Alexa built in for voice control, a personalizable high resolution display for touch control, and a camera with a privacy shutter for room-to-room video chat, your home is now more than just smart. It’s Brilliant.
The Brilliant App gives you remote/mobile access to your Brilliant Control(s), so you can see and adjust the status of your connected smart home products, turn on/off lights, activate scenes, upload personal photos, and more.
Don’t have a Brilliant Control yet? You can download the app and use our “demo mode” to simulate the mobile experience. 
Key Features
Remote Access
- Control your smart light, climate, and lock devices all from one place - anywhere and anytime.
Live View
- Stay connected via two-way talk with anyone in your home such as kids, guests, housekeepers, and nannies – regardless of whether you are home or away.
Navigate your home the way you want
- Access your smart home devices by room or by device type.
Execute your home automation
- Execute scenes you have created on your Brilliant remotely through your smart phone.
Personalize your Brilliant
- Upload up to 25 personal photos to turn your Brilliant into a digital photo frame.
Access Demo Mode
- Explore how Brilliant can unify and automate your home before you buy. 
Some features require a working internet connection/Wi-Fi on your phone and/or Brilliant.
Product currently sold in the United States and Canada.

bluejetty:00083363:ios.name: Merge Forest - Sky Island Saga
bluejetty:00083363:ios.summary:
Meet legendary fairy tale characters in the world of "Merge Forest - Sky Island Saga". Through matching and merging, open up new islands, unlock unknown items, and come to a wonderful fairy tale journey exclusive to you!
In a mysterious wo
bluejetty:00083363:ios.description:
Meet legendary fairy tale characters in the world of "Merge Forest - Sky Island Saga". Through matching and merging, open up new islands, unlock unknown items, and come to a wonderful fairy tale journey exclusive to you!
In a mysterious world hidden among the clouds and mists, Sky Island was once a dreamy fairytale wonderland. Until the evil wolf wizard came and broke the tranquility of Sky Island, he used witchcraft to turn everyone into token crystals. Little Red Riding Hood is safe and sound because of the merged magic power of the magician grandma.
You will follow in the footsteps of Little Red Riding Hood to reawaken everyone in Sky Island, save characters such as Snow White, the Mermaid, Cinderella and Pinocchio, and help Granny the Sorcerer fight the Wolf Wizard to prevent him from destroying Sky Island! You can rebuild Sky Island by merging three identical items into one new item, or five identical items into two new items!
Game Features:
Match items, merge and upgrade
- Everything can be merged! The magical merge magic allows you to merge all items and upgrade them into a better existence, helping you explore and rebuild the island.
- Use merge magic reasonably to save more fairy tale characters!
Decorate the room, have fun with friends
- Carpets, green plants, sofas, decorative paintings... Choose your favorite furniture and decorate your room as you like.
- Visit your friend's room and steal his cake!
Classic fairy tale, beautiful Encounter
- With the continuous exploration of the new area of Sky Island, after using the merge magic to meet more fairy tale characters, what kind of stories do they hide?
- Unlock more uncharted areas along the way, rebuild and decorate Sky Island in an exciting adventure-merging fairy tale!
Delicious recipes, rich rewards
- Refer to the recipes to help the fairy tale characters cook delicious food and get rich rewards. See what everyone likes to eat!
- Dozens of delicious foods are waiting for you to cook.
Lots of activities and lots of fun
- When exploring in the Sky Island, you will get treasure chests, mine mines, and harvest new resources.
- Complete limited-time challenges to earn tons of rewards, unique magic items and cosmetics!
By judiciously arranging these resources, merging and upgrading them, Sky Island will be brought back to its former glory, eventually becoming an amazingly wonderful wonderland that your fairytale friends will cheer for!
This is a fun-packed merge game and casual game where you can merge everything!
Merge to build the fairytale wonderland of your dreams and save Sky Island, there's no time to wait!

apple-macos:6759252269.description:
MiaoYan is a native Markdown note app for Mac, iPhone and iPad. Your notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, so what you write on the Mac opens on iPhone through iCloud Drive, folders and all.
There is no account to create and nothing to import or export, and iPhone, iPad and Mac show the same notes.
Reading
• Long notes are typeset like a book, with justified text, hyphenated English, and serif, sans or rounded faces in three sizes
• Tables, footnotes, task lists, images, quotes and Mermaid diagrams render the way they do on the Mac
• Code blocks are highlighted, and dark mode follows the system
Writing
• Plain Markdown, with headings, lists, links and code highlighted as you type
• Every change is saved as you go; when another device edits the same note, MiaoYan asks which version to keep
• A note moved to the Trash can be brought back with Undo for five seconds
Library
• Browse your iCloud Drive folders as they are, or open any folder from the Files app
• Search matches note titles and the text inside them
• On iPad, the note list and the page sit side by side

By using the app’s built-in interactive radar, you can zoom down to your neighborhood, including Brevard, Flagler, Lake, Marion, Orange, Osceola, Polk, Seminole, Sumter and Volusia counties, or zoom out to check radar anywhere in the country. Location based storm alerts will direct you to the latest severe weather warnings.
The WFTV Weather App focuses on complete Central Florida weather coverage for WFTV viewers and News 96.5 listeners.
Summary of Features:
- There is a new radar in the weather app that matches the radar found on other digital platforms and also includes future radar to provide you with a likely path and outlook of storms. The radar has 250 meter resolution, the highest available.
- New tracks - We added earthquakes and storm tracks as layers in the radar. Now you can track the location and magnitude of earthquakes as well for storms the speed, direction and type. Tap the “storm symbols” icon in the radar to see the list.
- Push alerts are FREE for more than 25 alert types including everything from tornado warnings to winter storm warnings and tropical storm alert types. 
- Now you can scroll through the home screen to access most of what you need or want on one tab. 
- Place a location pin precisely where you want it for a specific address or any position on a map. When saving a location you can name it exactly how you want it. 
- The app works with identical features on tablet and handset.
- Additional items added seasonally
*Data and alerting available for the United States only.
